articleTitle: General particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to make full use of the individual extreme information of each particle, and promote optimization performance of particle swarm optimization algorithm, a new particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed and named as generalized particle swarm optimization (GPSO). GPSO algorithm modifies the standard PSO algorithm speed update formula, in the current particle, cognitive part of speed update formula introduces the rest particles individual extreme information, it makes every particle get n (particle swarm size) update speeds and n corresponding location update values, and GPSO chooses the particle which has optimal adaptive value as the final iteration particle. similar to the PSO algorithm, Global extremum of GPSO and individual extremum of particle are updated. the nature of the GPSO algorithm is analyzed, GPSO algorithm enhances the capacity of information exchange and sharing between the particles and has a downward compatibility for the PSO algorithm, which theoretically ensures that the GPSO algorithm has better search performance than the PSO algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of UART, SPI and I2C
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays there are many hardware communications protocols to choose from, UART, SPI, I2C three protocols are the most representative, they are widely used. They have different characteristics, and how to choose the right choice is a problem that has been bothering people for a long time. In this article, the composition of the three protocols, how they work, and their advantages or disadvantages are described separately. And through the comparison of their transmission distance, it will be found that today's SPI protocol can transmit a longer distance, in the comparison of transmission rates SPI protocol has a faster rate but many limited conditions, UART has a more stable performance, SPI has a variety of transmission modes to choose from. In terms of transmission power consumption, UART has a huge advantage, outperforming the other two protocols. Through the article, we hope to provide a new way of thinking from the purpose required for the design. This leads to a new perspective on protocol selection

articleTitle: Light-YOLOv5: A Lightweight Algorithm for Improved YOLOv5 in PCB Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: When the object detection algorithm faces the chanllenge of PCB defect detection, we need to consider the speed and accuracy of detection under the condition of limited computing resources. This paper provides an improved object detection algorithm to enhance the detection efficiency of small objects with defects and achieves efficient model lightweighting with little loss of detection accuracy. First, GSConv and VoV-GSCSP networks are introduced to replace the original Conv and C3 network modules in the feature extraction part and add an attention mechanism module to enhance the dimension of information and reduce redundant information candidate boxes. The attention module of the Shuffle backbone network is used to extract information effectively without losing too much information. The number of invalid extracted features is reduced by improving the feature extraction capability of the backbone network and the effectiveness of feature fusion. The final experimental results show that the improved lightweight model in this paper reduces the weight of the yolov5s6 model size by 51% on the PCB defect detection dataset published by Peking University. Our proposed method can improve the model's mAP.5 by 2-3%. For defect detection, the small object recognition effect is significantly improved, and the lightweight effect is remarkable.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of Asynchronous FIFO and Synchronous FIFO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern integrated circuits, modern CPUs are running faster than ever. Nowadays FIFO often serves as the buffer for sending and receiving data on the hardware. This paper focuses on the respective characteristics of synchronous FIFO and asynchronous FIFO through comparative analysis. In general, synchronous FIFOs are mainly used as data caches to solve the problem of mismatch in read and write speeds, and asynchronous FIFOs can solve many problems across clock domains, transferring data quickly and easily between systems with different clock domains, but requiring clock periods to be adjusted for stable operation. It is believed that this paper can provide a reference for IC designers when designing interface circuits, and provide guidance and templates for beginners.

articleTitle: An Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm of Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of target recognition of mature apples, and solve the problem of apple picking robot quickly avoiding irregular obstacles to effectively pick mature apples in complex environments. Based on the Yolo v5 network spatial coordinate system and the feature information network, an adaptive scaling mechanism and position focal loss function are used, an improved YOLOv5 algorithm is proposed. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the improved algorithm is improved by 8.1% and the speed of pattern recognition is improved by 3.9 frames per second. It provides a solution for apple-picking robot to efficiently recognition mature apples and positioning it in complex environments.

articleTitle: Modulation identification method based on time-frequency analysis and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: For the problem of modulation recognition method of high complexity and low recognition rate under low signal-noise ratio (SNR), this paper presents a modulation recognition method based on time-frequency analysis and support vector machine (SVM). This method uses characteristic parameters of time domain, frequency domain and wavelet energy entropy as the input of the support vector machine classifier, and can effectively identify three signal modulation types of Frequency-shift keying (FSK), Frequency Modulation (FM) and Amplitude Modulation (AM). The results show that the AM modulated signal can be accurately identified by this method even under low SNR. Relatively speaking, FM and AM do not perform well at low SNR, but the correct recognition rate can still reach 85%. At the same time, the proposed method has a better recognition performance than the traditional single feature extraction method, the no feature processing method, and the decision tree classification method.

articleTitle: A Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring Model Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the field of non-intrusive load monitoring, many existing research methods have some load disaggregation error when dealing with multi-modal devices. To solve this problem, we proposed a non-intrusive load monitoring model based on Graph Neural Networks. The model uses the graph structure to characterize the correlation information between data nodes and combines Long Short-Term Memory to extract the time-domain features of the data. As a result, the model can capture the correlation between different modals of devices while preserving the time characteristics of the power data and reduce the error of the disaggregation results. Experiments on the data sets of UK-DALE and REDD showed the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction of Diabetes Based on Spark and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Diabetes is one of the fastest growing global health emergencies in the 21st century. Therefore, this paper uses random forest model to improve the detection and prediction of diabetes. The data set containing age, gender, polydipsia and other attributes of 520 diabetic patients downloaded from the website of AIMCO is selected and transformed into a training set and a test set according to the ratio of 7:3. Based on the spark big data computing platform, the random forest model was constructed by the training set and the model was validated by the test set, and the model prediction performance was evaluated by observing the goodness of several indicators. The accuracy of the model was 0.9712, the precision was 0.9841, the recall was 0.9688, the AUC was 0.9719, and the F1-Score was 0.9714. Comparing the prediction evaluation indexes with other algorithms, it was found that the random forest algorithm was better than other algorithms, and the effectiveness of the model was verified. The important predictors identified by the random forest classification algorithm in the experiment can provide useful information for predicting the risk of diabetes mellitus to promote the development of disease prediction technology.

Index Terms: Public Health Emergency Of International Concern

articleTitle: Working principle and application analysis of UART
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces UART and analyses its application. UART (Universal Asynchronous Transceiver) is used for serial communication and has a specific frame format, usually including start bit, data bit, check bit and stop bit. UART mainly includes three core components, namely transmitter, receiver and baud rate generator. In industrial production, UART chips are various. UART can be used in FPGA and MCU. The specific application fields involve military, medical, communication, industrial control and other fields. After years of development, UART technology tends to be mature, which has the advantages of low cost, stability and reliability, and it is not limited by load capacitors such as SPI. However, there is still much room for improvement. Compared with other serial ports, UART has low rate, cumbersome baud rate error setting, and unsatisfactory anti-interference capability, which may be the future research direction.

articleTitle: Prediction of Electric Vehicle Charging Demand in Rural Areas Based on Driving Track Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the disorderly charging behavior of large-scale electric vehicles can affect the economic operation of the power grid. An electric vehicle charging demand prediction model driven by driving track data in rural areas based on Beidou system is proposed. According to the predicted charging situation of rural electric vehicles, a mathematical model with different objective functions of the scheduling strategy is established, and the Particle Swarm Algorithm is used to find to the optimal charging plan. Based on the prediction, the optimized electric vehicle charging scheduling strategy can not only smooth out the load fluctuation of the grid, but also effectively reduce the peak-to-valley load difference and maximize the economic benefits for the participating users.

articleTitle: Application of data storage management system in blockchain-based technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The currently researched trusted data storage encryption methods for metering assets store too little data and have long encryption time delays. In order to solve the above problems, the trusted data storage encryption method for metering assets based on blockchain technology is proposed. blockchain technology can carry out the underlying network data support for the trusted data storage encryption of metering assets, and its data validation technology can be used for metering asset data block processing, and the data analysis is used to achieve storage encryption by comparing and validating the asset measurement results in the Ethernet virtual contract through each node within the blockchain node zone. This paper mainly applies blockchain technology in data storage management system, briefly analyzes the underlying logic of blockchain technology and its application in data storage management system, the core of the system is the storage of information and data, with features such as "unforgeable", "traceable", "open and transparent" and "collective maintenance". The core of the system is the storage of information and data, with features such as "unforgeable", "traceable", "open and transparent", "collective maintenance", etc. Finally, we show the application results of the technology in the system.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Load Forecasting Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Long Short-term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Accurate power load prediction at different periods can provide an essential basis for energy consumption reduction and power scheduling. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) and long short-term memory (LSTM) neural networks were introduced into the forecasting method of electric power load. First, aiming at the problem that it is difficult to select the LSTM hyper-parameters, hyper-parameters including the learning rate and the number of neurons were optimized by using the PSO algorithm. Then, the PSO-LSTM based prediction model was established, and the LSTM load prediction model with the optimal hyperparameter group was structured to predict the future change trend of power load. Finally, the historical load data of an electric power company was used to prove the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results demonstrate that, in compare with the traditional method, the load prediction model based on PSO-LSTM has a higher prediction accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: The Principle and Applications of Asynchronous FIFO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of integrated circuits, a complete system of integrated Circuits contains multiple clocks in a chip. Under the control of different clock domains, data can become metastable state between transfers or storage. This paper describes one of the effective methods to solve the problem about the metastable state, the method is asynchronous FIFO. We study Synchronous FIFO and Asynchronous FIFO in this paper. The article analyses the reasons for the emergence of sub-stability metastable state and how to use the Gray Code to solve metastable state problems effectively. We can generate empty/full status bits via Gray Code pointer, it can effectively reduce the probability of metastable state. This paper has the significance of guiding the use of FIFO.

articleTitle: Laser slam-based autonomous navigation for fire patrol robots
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The ship structure is complex, the area is closed, and there are many flammable and explosive materials, so there is a great potential risk of fire. Once a fire occurs, the economic loss is serious and the risk factor of manual fire fighting is large. Therefore, it is significant to reduce the risk factor and grasp the fire information in time. This wen designs and develops a ship fire patrol robot. The article gives a detailed description of the robot design overview, system composition and function description and completion and performance parameters, and gives a brief overview of what can be expanded in the future. The overall architecture of the project is divided into a hardware part and an algorithm part. The hardware part uses the stm32F407 as the main control board, and its main control system contains the mechanical device, WIFI digital transmission module, etc. The auxiliary part uses the Raspberry Pi as the auxiliary control board. In the algorithm part, the project is divided into a planning and decision layer, a motion execution layer, a sensing layer and an application layer. The main technical features of the project include the use of McNamee wheel, the use of Robot-Link V4.0 WIFI digital transmission module, the use of deep learning based regression methods, etc., and has optimized innovation in remote monitoring interface, autonomous navigation autonomous patrol and regulation.

Author Keywords: Robot-Link V4.0 WIFI Digital Transmission Module

articleTitle: Short-term power load forecasting based on PSO-GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of short-term power load forecasting, a short-term power load forecasting model (PSO-GRU) based on gated recurrent unit (GRU) neural network optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed. For the problem of difficult selection of GRU model parameters, PSO is used to optimize model parameters, which avoids the disadvantages of manual parameter adjustment The PSO-GRU prediction model is optimized on the basis of the GRU model, and is better at mining the characteristic information among non-linear and time-series data. The results of a case simulation analysis using power load data from a power company show that the PSO algorithm optimises the GRU model with higher forecasting accuracy compared to the GRU model and the LSTM model.

articleTitle: Research on Fruit Recognition Method Based on Improved YOLOv4 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low recognition rate, large storage space and slow detection speed of traditional image recognition algorithms and YOLOv4 algorithm, a fruit recognition target detection method based on improved YOLOv4 algorithm was proposed. The attention mechanism SE module is introduced into CSPResblock module. SPP module is improved to use pool core with different aspect ratio. The PANet structure was improved, input information was spliced at the corresponding feature level, and the three-layer output of the trunk network was mainly fused to improve the detection ability of fruit targets. The data set includes common fruits: bananas, grapes, apples, pears, mangoes, peaches, avocados and bananas. Each type of fruit is 1000 pieces, and the image size is uniformly processed into 608 pixels *608 pixels, a total of 8000 pieces. The results show that the MAP of the proposed method is 98.02%, the accuracy is 95.62%, and the frames per second (FPS) is 28.56. MAP improved by 16.6% compared to YOLOv4. The research can meet the requirements of high detection accuracy and detection speed, and has important reference value for the improvement of fruit recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Multimodal emotion recognition based on feature fusion and residual connection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition is widely used in human-computer interaction, medical care, education, human resources, and other fields, and is one of the important technologies in current research. The existing research is based on single-modal emotion recognition, which has the problems of low accuracy of emotion recognition, key information missing, and gradient disappearing. Based on this situation, this paper proposes a multimodal emotion recognition model based on feature fusion and residual connection, which uses Bi-LSTM and Muti-head attention to extract key features in voice, text, and video, and combines residual connection mechanisms to prevent gradient from disappearing. The average accuracy of this model on the IEMOCAP dataset can reach 61.4%, and the F1 value can reach 61.7%. Compared with other single-modal emotion recognition models and some baseline models, the emotion classification effect of this model is better.

articleTitle: Research on A Route Planning Method for Military Transport Aircraft Based on GWO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To increase the optimal allocation level of military transportation resources, on the basis of built aviation network, a route planning method based on Gray Wolf Optimization (GWO) algorithm is proposed for military transport aircraft. First, applying the relevant knowledge of graph theory, the aviation network model is established; then, GWO algorithm is introduced to optimize the flight path on the built aviation network for route planning of military transport aircraft. The simulation shows that the proposed method has the characteristics of fast convergence, high efficiency, practicability and easy implementation, and can solve the route planning problem of military transport aircraft well.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent agricultural environmental big data collection system based on ZigBee and NB-IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to enhance the collection capability of agricultural environment monitoring big data, this paper established an intelligent agricultural environment big data mining system integrating ZigBee and NB-IoT technologies, and solved the problems of easily influenced by natural environment, thereby leading to low yield and high cost in traditional agricultural production. The system took STM32 as its core, adopted the coordinator ad hoc network with terminal nodes connecting multiple sensors, constructed three interconnected but independently operated working hierarchies of environmental data collection, transmission and processing to collect greenhouse environmental indexes. Besides, it took NB-IoT as bottom device to communicate with cloud platform, and used platform extension function to achieve the individualized design of web and cellphone apps, all which realized the real time monitoring and remote control of environmental parameters. The test results indicate that the environmental information sensors arranged in the overall structure built to collect and monitor temperature, humidity, illumination, gas and other factors that can affect agricultural production efficiency can accurately collect relevant information. This verifies that the agricultural environmental big data system constructed is capable of providing automatic monitoring technology and rich sensing information for production decision making.

articleTitle: Research on Corner Reflector Array Fitting Method for Ship Scattering Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As an effective passive decoy against radar detection, the special geometric structure of the corner reflector makes the incident wave reflect many times on it, so it has a large radar cross section. By placing corner reflectors on the target ship, the radar cross section of it can be effectively adjusted and controlled, which can play an important role in the electromagnetic countermeasure defense. In this paper, the scattering center synthesis algorithm and electromagnetic scattering calculation method are used to study the number and placement of angular inverse array elements in the best fitting method for target ship. The results show that the optimal fit is 87.79% when the incidence angle is 0°, the number of corresponding corner reflector array elements is 9, and the spacing is 1 m; when the incidence residual angle is 45°, the best fitting degree is 85.81%, the number of corresponding corner reflector array units is 7, and the spacing is 2m.

articleTitle: Aircraft Trajectory Prediction Based on Residual Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Accurate and efficient aircraft trajectory prediction is one of the important technologies developed in the aerospace field today. The high space-time complexity, strong uncertainty and changeable flight trajectories of aircraft flight have brought great difficulties to the modeling and solution of intelligent trajectory planning. Aiming at the problems of strong maneuverability and difficult trajectory prediction of unpowered aircraft, based on the analysis of trajectory characteristics, this paper proposed a trajectory prediction method for aircraft based on residual recurrent neural network (RESRNN) for trajectory prediction. First, our algorithm decomposes the 3D trajectory data of the aircraft in time series. Then, this paper uses RNN for loop calculation and RESNET for residual extraction to get the predicted result. Furthermore, in order to solve the problem of lack of simulation sample libraries, this paper proposes a sample generation method based on differential dynamics to generate a sample library for validating our algorithm. The simulation results show that compared with other prediction methods, our method has higher prediction accuracy, which has certain reference significance for intelligent trajectory planning, trajectory prediction, and interception of other large maneuvering targets.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Epidemic Big Data Visualization Platform Based on Vue + ECharts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Data visualization technology makes massive data more intuitive and easy to analyze. Based on the epidemic data from the National Bureau of Statistics of China, with the help of ECharts chart, elementUI component library and Vue technology, the data are visualized by using visualization technology and map integration. Through node. JS, Express The framework and MySQL technology realize the annual data management, regional data management and user management of the epidemic situation, display the epidemic situation of each region from multiple perspectives, and provide users with a reliable and convenient understanding channel and data management platform. It provides convenience for people to understand the data of the new coronavirus epidemic, analyze the development trend of the epidemic and manage the big data of the epidemic.

articleTitle: Research on Indoor Target Positioning System Based on Image Feature Extraction and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the complexity of indoor environment and the limitations of existing positioning methods on indoor target positioning, this paper uses improved ORB algorithm to replace the target detection and recognition system on the market based on SURF or SIFT algorithm, relying on the target detection data in the real indoor scene. The system takes the image characteristics of the target as the main basis for recognition, and optimizes the indoor positioning accuracy through image recognition and positioning technology, hardware verification and evaluation. The system can effectively reduce the amount of image processing, optimize the target feature extraction, and improve the recognition accuracy. The research on this system in this paper is expected to be applied to a variety of practical scenes, such as improving the indoor positioning accuracy of UAVs, and providing useful reference for improving the positioning accuracy of a variety of large indoor scenes.

articleTitle: Model Research of Energy Storage Resources Participating in the Electricity Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Energy storage resources have the advantages of fast response, flexible configuration, short construction period, etc., and they can play a variety of roles such as peaking, peak regulation, slope climbing, black start, frequency regulation, and other roles in power operation. Therefore it is an important part of the construction of a new type of power system. This paper mainly gives the mathematical model of energy storage resources participating in the electricity spot market and constructs a case study to prove the correctness and rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Research on voiceprint Recognition system based on ECAPA-TDNN-GRU architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Currently voiceprint Recognition systems are playing an increasingly important role in social life. The most popular voiceprint Recognition technology currently relies on neural networks to extract speaker’s features. The successful ECAPA-TDNN architecture is an improved time-delayed neural network based on the x-vector architecture, which explicitly models channel interdependencies by introducing the introduction of Squeeze and Excitation blocks, while the SEResNet block expands the frame layer context by adjusting the proportion of channels with global properties of the recording. In this paper, a number of improvements are proposed to the architecture based on the latest trends in the field of voiceprint Recognition-related issues. Firstly, the initial frame layer can be reset as a one-dimensional Res2Net module for skip connections. In consideration of the effect of the input data on the neural network, we pre-process the input audio data using the Melspectrogram approach. Secondly, a gated recurrent unit (GRU) network is introduced and embedded in the residual structure of the multilayer aggregation feature to further mine the temporal contextual information in the audio signal. The output of the GRU is aggregated with the output of the last SE-Res2Block module for subsequent feature extraction. Finally, the proposed ArcFace loss function is used in this paper to penalise the angle between the depth features and their corresponding weights in an additive manner, thus enhancing both intra-class tightness and inter-class variance and increasing the validation of our proposed model architecture for voiceprint Recognition.

articleTitle: Transfer learning for bearing fault diagnosis based on improved residual network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Up to now, the machine learning and deep learning algorithms discussed are usually designed to work alone. In the actual industrial operating environment, the working conditions are complex and changeable, so the model once trained in the source domain is used in the target domain, the diagnostic accuracy cannot be guaranteed, and it takes a lot of time to train the model. In view of the above two problems, this paper proposes a bearing fault diagnosis method based on the Transfer Learning Convolutional Neural Network (CRNN). Experimental results show that compared with other existing methods, the CRNN model proposed in this paper reduces the training time of the model while ensuring high accuracy, and the generalization ability of the model is improved, which has a good application value.

articleTitle: Short-term Prediction of Multidimensional Data in Power System Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous promotion of smart grid construction in China, the amount of data accumulated in the power system has increased significantly. It is important for grid state estimation and security situation assessment to mine relevant features from a large amount of time series data and predict future development trends. In this paper, a short-term prediction model of multidimensional data is established based on CNN. And one-dimensional convolution kernel is used to extract different dimensional features of data. Based on this model, single-step prediction and multi-step prediction methods are realized, respectively. In the multi-step prediction method, the direct output method is used to improve the prediction accuracy. The results show that the prediction model has high accuracy in different time scales. And the prediction error decreases with the decrease of time scales. Therefore, the prediction model can provide a reference for the short-term prediction of power systems.

articleTitle: Improved K-Nearest Neighbor Missing Data Classification Based on Interval Value Imputation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In reality, when processing data sets for classification, there are often missing data sets, which brings inconvenience to the classification work. To this end, this paper proposes a method to impute incomplete data based on the interval value of K nearest neighbors. The method uses the Euclidean distance between the incomplete data and the complete data to find the K closest complete data to the incomplete data, so that the nearest neighbor can be constructed according to the corresponding attribute value of the complete data to the missing attribute value of the incomplete data. interval. Next, the dataset is constructed into an interval-valued dataset. Based on the interval-valued distance algorithm, the incomplete data can be classified by the K-nearest neighbor algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved K-nearest neighbor algorithm based on interval value imputation is more efficient than the traditional 0-value imputation, median imputation and mean imputation K-nearest neighbor algorithm under certain circumstances.

articleTitle: Research on road image enhancement based on histogram equalization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the gradual development of urban traffic, there is a great demand for image enhancement technology with video surveillance as the mainstream. Therefore, it is of great scientific and economic value to study the enhancement algorithm of road images. Histogram equalization is a common method of image enhancement, which has 4 paths, which can deal with image enhancement under different environmental conditions. For pictures of road conditions that may require image enhancement, the histogram equalization of the four paths is used for image enhancement, and Python is used to compare the effect of the algorithm. Experiments show that the histogram equalization process has obvious effect on images with uneven gray distribution. And CHALE tends to work better.

articleTitle: Solving the Traveling Saleman Problem Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Combinatorial optimization problems are heavily studied in recent decades due to its broad applications. The traveling salesman problem (TSP) is among the best-known combinatorial optimization problems, which is NP-hard. A variety of methods have been proposed to find optimal solutions to TSP. Recently, the development of reinforcement learning techniques brings a new approach to TSP, which finds the optimal iterations of all nodes in a graph with no requirement to analytically solving the intractable graph optimization problem. This paper demonstrates the algorithm of solving TSP using q-learning, an off-policy reinforcement learning method and show an example of optimal path finding among warehouses.

articleTitle: Analysis of control strategy of three-phase bridge fully controlled rectifier circuit based on PID principle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the context of the national "double carbon" strategy, the power system is gradually developing towards a high proportion of new energy generation and a high proportion of access to power electronics. In this context, the reliable operation of rectifier circuits in power systems becomes particularly important, and the study of their circuit control strategies can effectively improve the efficiency and safety reliability of power systems. Therefore, this paper establishes a simulation model of a three-phase bridge fully controlled rectifier circuit based on PID closed-loop control from the viewpoint of the operating principle and PID closed-loop control strategy of the three-phase bridge fully controlled rectifier circuit constructed by IGBTs. By comparing and analyzing the three-phase AC voltage source waveform, trigger pulse waveform and output current waveform with different trigger angles under the no control strategy, PI control strategy and PID control strategy, it is verified that the PID control strategy proposed in this paper has a good rectification effect. At the same time, the PID parameter values are derived by comparing and analyzing the parameter regulation methods to solve the output waveform distortion problem in the rectifier circuit, which is of great significance to the rectification operation of the grid system.

articleTitle: Research on Automotive TSN network Scheduling Analysis and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to study the end-to-end delay characteristics of various types of traffic in time-sensitive networking (TSN) in automobiles under different scheduling algorithms, the algorithm and scheduling model of the corresponding TSN scheduling mechanism are given, and a TSN simulation model is built based on RTaW to analyze the traffic delay simulation results under different scheduling mechanisms and the delay characteristics of traffic under each scheduling algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Dispatching Method of Integrated Energy Network in Agricultural Industrial Park Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The demand for energy in agricultural parks is concentrated and the sources and loads are diversified. When a variety of distributed devices are connected to the rural power grid, it will inevitably have an adverse impact on the benefits of agricultural parks. Aiming at the above problems, an optimal scheduling method of agricultural industrial parks considering demand response is proposed. Firstly, the energy flow analysis of the energy system structure of the agricultural park is carried out, and the equipment on both sides of the park's source and load are refined and modeled. Then, the demand response optimization model of the park is put forward, and the objective function is established with the best economic operation of the whole park and the maximum renewable energy consumption. Finally, an improved second-order oscillating particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the objective function, and the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by simulation. The results show that this method realizes the optimal operation of the multi-energy complementary system in the agricultural park, and improved the friendly interaction of the source and lotus in the park.

articleTitle: Research on Grid Connection of Virtual Synchronous Generator and Diesel Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A control strategy of virtual synchronous generator based on power angle characteristics of synchronous generator is designed for independent distributed generation system, which enables the inverter to be connected in parallel with diesel generator in the form of voltage source. The designed control strategy realizes the seamless switching of the inverter to the power grid, and the inverter can adjust the active power output according to the command during grid connected operation. The inverter can quickly respond to the required output power when suddenly adding/removing load, effectively reducing the voltage amplitude and frequency fluctuation of the microgrid. Finally, the effectiveness of the designed control strategy is verified by Matlab/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Prediction from Breast Cancer Images by Logistic Regression and AlexNet Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Since the breast cancer makes big influence of human’s health, the prevention and treatment of breast cancer is very important. Artificial Intelligence is widely used in prediction based on database. In that paper, Artificial Intelligence is used for prevention and treatment of breast cancer based on patients’ cell images. Logistic Regression and AlexNet models are used as examples. Matrix calculation and rotation are used for data pretreatment. In the experiment, 5547 images with shape 50 × 50 × 3 are used as training and testing datasets. Comparing to the CNN Tensorflow model from Kaggle, AlexNet has higher test accuracy with longer training time, and Logistic Regression well reflects the relationship between specific part of cell and the breast cancer.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Visualization Logistics Intelligent Scheduling System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper puts forward and studies the dispatching management system based on the concept of digital twin into the dispatching management. Then the architecture and function structure of the system are established and the construction content and method of scheduling process digital twin are proposed. Finally, the basic digital twin model of scheduling process, the digital twin model of packing planning and the digital twin model of scheduling process optimization are designed and constructed. This paper demonstrates the function of digital twin scheduling management system with a scheduling example. Experimental simulation shows that the system can improve the packing effect and optimize the scheduling process reasonably.

articleTitle: Research on EEG signal emotion recognition based on improved GAPSO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This study improves and combines genetic algorithm (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO), optimizes the penalty parameter C and kernel function parameter g of support vector machine (SVM), and proposes an emotion classification and recognition model of EEG based on improved GAPSO-SVM. The classification accuracy of γ band energy data was up to 88.8889 %, and the classification accuracy of SampEn data was up to 77.7778 %.

articleTitle: AC fault ride through control strategy for hybrid HVDC system considering renewable energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: LCC-FHMMC hybrid DC transmission is a new type of hybrid DC transmission system that combines the advantages of two converters, and has broad development prospects in engineering. When the sending AC side failure will lead to DC power transmission is affected, thus affecting the safe and stable operation of the entire system. Therefore, based on the working characteristics of the converter, this paper considers the related issues of new energy consumption. Firstly, the full-bridge sub-module is used to realize the flexible adjustment of the MMC DC voltage, so that the DC power transmission can be quickly restored and the DC inrush current caused by the fault can be reduced. Secondly, the frequency of the passive network can follow the DC voltage change of the inverter side. Because the new energy consumption will actively reduce the unbalanced power of the system, the number of load shedding will be reduced. Based on the RTLAB OP5600 real-time digital simulation platform, the LCC-FHMMC two-terminal hybrid DC model is built to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A New Porosity Prediction Method Based on Deep Learning of TabNet Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Porosity is one of the core parameters in the process of understanding subsurface fluid flow, reservoir characterization, and reservoir evaluation. Due to the limitation of the number of cores taken, conventional experimental analysis can only obtain a small amount of porosity data. How to improve the accuracy of porosity prediction has always been an issue. It is one of the hotspots in the study of reservoir parameter prediction. This paper proposes a porosity prediction method based on Tab Net, and compares it with traditional machine learning and LSTM porosity prediction methods. The results show that the RMSE of the three porosity prediction models are 3.48,3.67, and 3.95 respectively. Therefore, this paper believes that the model based on the TabNet network can more effectively predict the reservoir porosity and provide a new method for reservoir evaluation ideas and methods.

articleTitle: Automatic Diagnosis of COVID-19 Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The lives and health of individuals are significantly threatened by the extremely infectious and dangerous Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID-19). For the containment of the epidemic, quick and precise COVID-19 detection and diagnosis are essential. Currently, artificial diagnosis based on medical imaging and nucleic acid detection are the major approaches used for COVID-19 detection and diagnosis. However, nucleic acid detection takes a long time and requires a dedicated test box, while manual diagnosis based on medical images relies too much on professional knowledge, and analysis takes a long time, and it is difficult to find hidden lesions. Thanks to the rapid development of pattern recognition algorithms, building a COVID-19 diagnostic model based on machine learning and clinical symptoms has become a feasible rapid detection solution. In this paper, support vector machines and random forest algorithms are used to build a COVID-19 diagnostic model, respectively. Based on the quantitative comparison of the performance of the two methods, the future development trends in this field are discussed.

articleTitle: A Dual Coupling LCC-LCC Topology Based WPT System for Wireless Slip Ring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The traditional contact slip ring has the shortcomings of wear and heat, and the wireless slip ring can solve this problem. In this paper, a concentric solenoid type wireless slip ring structure is designed, and a dual coupling LCC-LCC topology WPT system suitable for this coupling mechanism is proposed. Compared with the single coupling LCC-LCC topology WPT system, this system is superior because its output current is larger under the same conditions. The effectiveness of the proposed system has been verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: An Ansible-based Distributed Application Architecture Rapid Deployment Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This article proposes a platform of containers based on high availability Kubernetes cluster. The platform let containerized applications work continuously. The solution can be used by increasing master nodes or based on the original Kubernetes cluster in order to reduce cost. The article also providers installation scripts for quickly deployment.

articleTitle: A regulated identity management system based on blockchain platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The objective of this study is to propose a new regulable blockchain trusted management identity system, which can solve the fundamental problem of blockchain node identity management with large gaps in application requirements, trust models, and regulatory compliance. To achieve this goal, firstly, a hierarchical CA system framework is established, using cross-domain nodes to store hash lists of certificate chains, and achieving node identity authentication and authority management through the division of certificate functions. Secondly, the certificate designed in this study is used for cross-domain authentication and interaction of business terminals. This study designs dynamic authority access of terminals and authority-based authentication mechanism to realize identity access and cross-domain authentication of terminal entities between domains. While ensuring security and certificate validity, it reduces the number of hash operations and verification signatures and improves the efficiency of cross-domain authentication compared with existing blockchain cross-domain authentication schemes. It provides a systematic solution for identity security and privacy protection when various facilities are connected to the blockchain system.

articleTitle: Research on Network Application Automation System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Wireless mobile channel is a typical time-varying channel. This paper designs a kind of substation automation network monitoring and control system based on wireless monitoring and control technology. Then the design of the system architecture and data storage are studied in depth. In this paper, browser/server/database is used to construct the substation network communication automation system based on Web. In the System View design environment, the wireless mobile channel is simulated and the simulation results are obtained. The research results show that the system can transmit the data information collected by the system to the monitoring node with the help of wireless sensor network related technology. Intelligent substation communication system can realize real-time monitoring.

articleTitle: The Comparison and Analysis of Autonomous Food Delivery Robot Based on Artificial Potential Field and Breadth-First Search Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The autonomous food delivery robot, as one of the most popular products of Artificial Inteligence, is to plan the path accurately from the chef to the customer’s table while avoiding unnecessary collisions with the obstacles like tables, chairs and pedestrians. This paper makes a comparative analysis of the path planning technology in the process of robot food delivery in the restaurant environment. Firstly, the restaurant environment is analyzed and simulated in Webots. Then, according to the environmental requirements, the effects of Artificial Potential Field(APF), improved APF and Breadth- First Search (BFS) on path planning and obstacle avoidance are compared and analyzed respectively. Subsequently, the whole scene is simulated in Webots and the comparison is generated based on the operation time, traveling distance, completeness, and the smoothness of the robot’s motion. Finally, by comparing the experimental results, the advantages and disadvantages of each algorithm are analyzed. It is concluded that in small-scale restaurant environment, BFS algorithm will achieve better results in route planning.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Travel Website Based on Java Web
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's living standards, China's tourism industry has developed vigorously, and various tourism websites have sprung up. However, due to the late start of informatization in China, compared with developed countries, the degree of informatization in tourism in China is relatively low. Therefore, this paper realizes the system of travel website based on JavaWeb. The system generally adopts a relatively convenient B/S structure, including the front end and the back end. The front-end adopts Ajax, JQuery, HTML, CSS and other technologies, considering the response speed of users. The back-end mainly uses the technologies of Web containers such as Sevlet and Filter, and refers to the design pattern of three-tier architecture to process the back-end, which effectively standardizes the development process and provides convenience for testing and maintenance. In the aspect of database, MySQL database and Redis cache are used to store data hierarchically, and Durid connection pool is used to manage database connection resources and further improve the response performance of database.

articleTitle: A Chinese NER Method Based on Chinese Characters' Multiple Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A Chinese named entity recognition method that integrates multiple information is proposed for the inadequate prior knowledge of word vectors in the pre-trained model-based Chinese named entity recognition method. Based on the existing BERT model, the feature representation of Chinese character vectors is enhanced by constructing a table of bias and word frequency vectors of all Chinese characters in the dataset, embedding them into an improved word fusion model for encoding, and finally, feeding them into CRF for decoding. The experimental results show that the proposed method has improved F1 values over the public datasets MSRA, Weibo and Resume while maintaining fast decoding speed and low computer resource consumption, and performs better in terms of robustness and generalization ability than models such as BiLSTM-CRF and Lattice-LSTM.

articleTitle: Data mining algorithm based on particle swarm optimized K-means
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To improve the clustering accuracy of massive data, a particle swarm optimized K-means is proposed. High operating efficiency and fast convergence speed are the advantages of K-means, but it is sensitive to the initial clustering center and easy to fall into the local optimal solution. Particle swarm optimization is used to optimize the initial clustering center to improve the clustering accuracy of K-means algorithm. The validity and reliability of particle swarm optimization K-means algorithm are verified by the clustering comparison of UCI data sets.

articleTitle: A DDoS attack detection algorithm based on improved grid search to optimize SVM in SDN environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Software defined network has proposed a new architecture idea, but the controller is vulnerable to distributed denial of service attacks, resulting in a single point of failure. This paper proposes a DDoS attack detection algorithm based on improved grid search optimization SVM in SDN environment. Firstly, according to the characteristics of DDoS attacks and information of flow table items, the most relevant six-dimensional features are selected, then use the improved grid search algorithm to calculate the optimal penalty coefficient and kernel function parameters of SVM model, finally use SVM algorithm to detect DDoS attacks and improve the performance of intrusion detection algorithm. The experimental results in the same scene show that the improved SVM has higher detection rate and recall rate than the SVM algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of UART Communication Protocol Based on Frequency Multiplier Sampling Technology and Asynchronous FIFO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter, commonly known as UART, is a serial, asynchronous, full-duplex communication protocol, which is widely used in the embedded field based on this protocol, this paper uses Verilog HDL Designed and improved on traditional methods. The design of the UART receiver module and UART transmitter module and the corresponding improvement methods are discussed emphatically. The core problems of improvement are as follows. 1)This paper uses the isolation characteristics of asynchronous FIFO to avoid the complexity of design and constraints caused by transmission across clock domains. It is solved the problems that the data transmission data belongs to different clock domains and different transmission rates, and the width of the data interface is different. 2)This paper creates a data buffer to address the issue that, if the device is out of sync, the remaining data would be lost or rewritten because of the time difference between the transmitting and receiving ends. 3)This paper establishes a communication network control system model, uses the previous buffer to fix the delay time, and solves the optimal sampling times and upper limit of each data bit, avoiding the large delay of the signal in the system. 4)This paper uses the optimal frequency multiplication sampling technology to improve the receiving accuracy of the receiver and avoids the problem of decreasing the transmission efficiency between devices by adding multiple cycles to each round of oversampling. Finally, the designed and improved UART protocol has passed all functional simulations in Modalism SE-64 and is superior to the traditional method in many aspects such as transmission efficiency, bit error rate, and anti-interference.

articleTitle: Design of a Docking & Charging Device for Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Marine robots such as unmanned surface vehicles (USV) and autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV) are urgently to be applied to improve the automation and intelligence of various marine tasks, including oil exploitation, pipeline maintenance, water quality monitoring, search & rescue patrol, etc. A design of a docking&charging device for unmanned surface vehicle is proposed in this paper. The unmanned surface vehicle (USV) is applied in the cooperative operation with autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) to provide the AUV with lunch&recovery, contactless power transfer (CLPT), data transmission and task assignment, so as to improve the endurance and autonomy of AUVs. The docking and charging device is placed on the USV near the water surface for the AUV to dock in. A semi-spherical electromagnetic coupler and corresponding N-SP compensation are designed and applied in the CLPT system. The feasibility of the design is verified through prototype and in-water test, achieving power transfer efficiency up to 80%.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Offshore Wind Power Transmission System via MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: High voltage direct current transmission technology based on modular multi-level converter (MMC-HVDC) has become the mainstream scheme of offshore wind power transmission. This paper proposes a method to improve the system stability and optimize the power operation range, ensure the balance between wind turbine mechanical power and DC electromagnetic power, control the constant amplitude and phase of AC voltage, and have the ability to prevent the converter from locking due to sudden changes in wind power. The digital physical hybrid model of eight doubly fed wind turbines is built, and the simulation results show that the designed control method has good dynamic and stable characteristics.

articleTitle: Detection of bolts and nuts of automobile sheet metal parts based on YOLOV7
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Bolts and nuts are the most common parts on automobile sheet metal parts. Due to the complex shape of plate parts, traditional detection methods mostly rely on manual work, and there are problems such as slow detection speed and low accuracy. To solve these problems, this paper uses a target detection method based on YOLOV7 to realize the automatic detection of bolts and nuts on automobile sheet metal parts. By training the automobile sheet metal parts data set for 300 epochs, the final map0.5 reaches 94.89%, and the MAP0.5:0.9 reaches 75.26%. Compared with the test of the model in the coco data set, the map0.5 increases from 69.7% to 94.89%. It shows that the detection effect of the model is very good for this task.

articleTitle: Control strategy of three-phase PWM rectifier based on improved double closed loop sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low dynamic response performance and low anti-interference performance of three-phase PWM rectifier under conventional control mode, the project plans to design a new double-closed-loop sliding mode controller with sliding mode control in both the outer loop and the inner loop, and improve the convergence of the sliding mode inner loop. This control strategy can effectively improve the convergence speed of the system and effectively suppress the jitter of the system; The improved PID controller is compared with the double closed-loop PID controller and the conventional index controller, and it is concluded that the improved PID controller is superior to the conventional double closed-loop PID controller and the conventional index controller in response speed, buffeting suppression effect, anti-interference and harmonic suppression.

articleTitle: Research of Boosting Algorithm Machine Learning in Logistics Enterprise Financial Risk Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The financial risk of logistics enterprises not only affects the survival and development of enterprises but also damages the interests of creditors and investors. Therefore, financial management and financial risk prediction are essential. Firstly, this paper selects targeted financial indicators for screening and data collection, establishes predictive risk identification of the financial risk early warning model of logistics enterprises, and adopts machine learning based on Boosting regression algorithm to achieve reliable prediction of the financial risk of logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: Pure azimuthal passive positioning model for UAVs flying in circular formation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Today, the research on UAV formation flight and cluster control is of great practical importance, and it can be applied to many fields such as wide-range surveillance, rescue search and environmental detection. To avoid external interference during cluster formation flight, UAVs should reduce the frequency of external electromagnetic wave signals, i.e., maintain electromagnetic silence. In order to make all UAVs reach the ideal position during the formation process, this paper adopts the pure azimuth passive positioning method to carry out the research of UAV position adjustment and establish the effective positioning model and position adjustment model of UAVs in circular formation.

articleTitle: Research on azimuth-only passive location technology of UAV carrying formation based on Newton iterative algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The problem studied in this paper is put forward on the basis of avoiding external interference and maintaining formation when UAV cluster is flying in formation. Newton iterative algorithm is used to establish multivariate nonlinear programming model. By analyzing the characteristics of passive positioning model, the sine theorem of UAV in formation is established to obtain the position of UAV in polar coordinate system. Understand the distribution of UAV, establish the nonlinear programming model, use Newton iterative algorithm, carry out the coordinate changes of UAV in the process of continuous adjustment, proofread the result and the standard position difference, more and more accurate, so as to get the final optimal strategy; Newton iteration method in classical iterative algorithm was used to sort out the location model of passive signal receiving UAV.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Reduction System of 110kV Substation Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The demonstration and optimization of the power system planning scheme and operation mode in the complex power grid environment is of great significance for improving the energy saving and economic efficiency of the power system and reducing the carbon emission intensity of the system. This paper puts forward the analysis and evaluation technology of energy saving and economic operation of power system for low carbon target and develops the software system. It realizes the refined operation simulation of the power grid day by day throughout the year by considering the combination of safety constraint units coordinated by multiple types of power sources. On this basis, multi-dimensional evaluation indexes such as system operation cost, energy consumption, emissions and power grid efficiency are constructed. To realize the multi-dimensional evaluation of power system energy saving and economic operation.

articleTitle: Meteorological Data Transmission Management System Based on Multi-source Satellite Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s meteorological industry, the construction of the meteorological data transmission management system is also increasingly perfect, and higher requirements are put forward for the real-time, accuracy and reliability of the data. The meteorological information center is an important hub for the transmission and storage of regional meteorological data, and its task is to ensure the transmission of meteorological data. However, the current meteorological data transmission and monitoring system has some problems, such as poor comprehensive monitoring ability, decentralized business, low security efficiency, and poor fault analysis ability. Multi-source satellite data can combine multiple detection methods such as multiple time phases, multiple angles, and multiple spectral bands to improve the accuracy and robustness of meteorological data collection. Therefore, this paper aims to study and design a meteorological data transmission management system based on multi-source satellite data.In this paper, the design of meteorological data transmission management system based on multi-source satellite data is proposed, the specific modules of the system are described in detail and the functions are explained, and the association rules are mainly applied in the alarm association to link the relevant data in the meteorological data to predict the future data meteorology. The experimental results in this paper show that when the meteorological data is 50 frames, the data transmission success rate of the system under the 10M document is 98%, and the data transmission success rate of the system under the 100M document is 93%. When the meteorological data is 300 frames, the data transmission success rate of the system under the 10M document is 96%, and the data transmission success rate of the system under the 100M document is 97%. It can be seen that the data transmission success rate of the system designed in this paper is very high.

articleTitle: Research on vehicle detection algorithm based on improved YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Given the large cost of the current vehicle detection implementation project, this paper reduces the cost of the project by modifying the Yolov5s backbone model to greatly reduce the number of parameters in the training process under the premise of ensuring accuracy. First, MobileNetV3 is used to replace the Yolov5s backbone network, which reduces the number of parameters from 14.4M to 3.1M and the mAP from 0.984 to 0.977. The accuracy of the model is only reduced by 0.007 with the greatly reduced number of parameters, and the model is greatly improved. The SE attention module of the inverted residual structure is replaced by the CBAM module, and the parameters and mAP are further optimized, thus reducing the parameter quantity to 2.4M and the mAP to 0.978, which makes the model better improved and can better meet the vehicle detection put into use.

articleTitle: Research on real-time path planning and obstacle avoiding for mobile robot swarms based on an advanced artificial potential field method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Unmanned mobile robots have broad application prospects in space exploration. In order to meet the increasing technical requirements, it is of great practical significance to study robot cluster work, path planning, and obstacle avoidance. A method is proposed in this paper to achieve the functions mentioned above built on an improved artificial potential field (APF). By introducing a dynamic attractive factor based on the number of obstacles and setting different goal point information for leader and follower robots, obstacle avoidance navigation and cooperative following function can be achieved under the force of the potential field. Finally, using webots to build an environment and robots for simulation. The results and planned path map testify to the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on a shipborne ionospheric scintillation detection method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces the research status of ionospheric scintillation, and analyzes the impact of the upcoming 25th solar cycle on radio tracking. Aiming at the abnormal problem of solving ionospheric TEC data in low-latitude regions in the ship-borne mobile scenario, this paper uses the Kriging interpolation method to improve the Kalman method, and proposes an improved Kriging-Kalman method. Finally, three days of experimental data are selected to compare the difference between the ionospheric VTEC value output by the measuring equipment and the IGS/GIM data. The results show that the Kriging-Kalman method has a better calculation effect of the ionospheric VTEC value.

articleTitle: Survey of line selection algorithms for low current single-phase-to-ground fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Distribution network takes the role of power supply to power users. When single-phase grounding fault occurs in distribution line, it is required to be found and eliminated in time. In the past years, some research work has been carried out on the principle and analysis, and systematic research results have been obtained. In this paper, the methods of single-phase-to-ground fault line-selection for medium and small current in distribution network are summarized, and the principles of four kinds of line-select are analyzed.

articleTitle: Optimization of additional heat production performance of air conditioning compressor based on hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, for the current problem of temperature regulation and optimal energy consumption in the confined space of the factory, we use neural network algorithm and hybrid particle swarm algorithm combined with heat conduction equation to construct models such as LSTM neural network model and hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm model, and use Matlab, Python and other software languages to solve the model, and derive the relationship between cooling scheme and temperature, and the adjustment scheme of compressor and fan when the power consumption is the lowest is shown below, and at the end of the paper, we combine the actual situation and give rationalization suggestions to the model.

articleTitle: Research and Design of an E-Commerce Platform for Ceramic Crafts Based on UML Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology and the improvement of people's income level make the e-commerce platform integrate into people's daily life, and at the same time, due to the improvement of people's aesthetic level, various crafts with aesthetic value gradually become hot, and most of the traditional e-commerce platforms involve a wide range, and it is difficult to subdivide a single category. Based on this situation, this paper designs an e-commerce platform for ceramic handicrafts based on UML model, including functional design and data structure design. The platform can provide people with an online shopping platform for ceramic crafts, and at the same time, it can provide new sales channels for related enterprises and improve their operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Infrared Target Detection Based on the Fusion of Attention Mechanism and YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Infrared images have the characteristics of strong anti-interference ability and all-weather work, and are used in many fields. This paper improves the infrared target detection based on the YOLOv5 deep learning algorithm. Since the attention mechanism has the function of ignoring irrelevant information and focusing on key information, this paper integrates the attention mechanism with the YOLOv5 algorithm to improve the feature extraction ability of the algorithm. Increase the multi-scale detection strategy; this paper conducts experiments on the public infrared data set. The test results show that the YOLOv5 algorithm based on the fusion of attention mechanism and multi-scale detection improves the target detection accuracy by 3.2%, and also has good performance in small infrared target detection.

articleTitle: PISA architecture chip resource scheduling algorithm design and implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to speed up the efficiency in designing PISA, a series of resource constraints are imposed. The resource scheduling situation under data dependency, control dependency, and various resource dependency constraints is to be explored. In this regard, a mixed integer programming model is developed and the optimization objective is determined to keep the number of occupied pipeline stages as short as possible. On the one hand, the data pre-processing work can be carried out, and the data can be transformed into a matrix of 0-1 variables to facilitate the control of the basic information in each module, and the processed data are judged to determine whether the decision variables can satisfy the constraints; on the other hand, the constraints limiting the objective function already in the problem are determined, and the corresponding equations are listed for the three different data dependencies of read-after-write, write-after-read, and write-after-write. At the same time to find the constraints implied by the problem itself, according to the linking relationship of the basic blocks in each board to adjust the order of the boards, due to the directed basic block linking information determines between adjacent boards, any basic block of the latter board must be linked with a certain basic block of the previous board, that is, the remaining hidden constraints can be found by the Big M method. After determining the complete decision variables, constraints and objective functions, a mixed integer programming model can be established to optimize the minimum number of occupied pipeline levels as the objective, and the results are calculated by using the lingo solver, and finally the results are optimized and verified by the heuristic algorithm - particle swarm algorithm to obtain the pipeline of problem one The number of basic blocks is the most when the number of levels is 4, and the corresponding number is 57, and the total number of pipeline levels is 53 at this time.

articleTitle: Design of GIS Based Mobile Data Acquisition System for Agricultural Green Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of agricultural modernization, the traditional agricultural production model has been gradually subverted, and traditional planting is no longer the main way to increase farmers' income. Under the traditional mode, farmland management and control mainly rely on planting experience, fertilization technology, production mode, etc., which cannot adapt to the modern environment, improve production efficiency, and promote farmers' income. Based on the application of mobile and intelligent platforms, real-time information collection, storage and analysis can be realized. In order to reduce the use of chemical fertilizer and other substances in agricultural production and improve the level of agricultural environmental management and sustainable development capability, this paper designed a GIS based mobile data collection system for agricultural green development.
