Based on modern information technologies such as Internet of Things and cloud computing, the system converts relevant data into geographic information maps and remote sensing images, and combines Sql database to achieve data intelligent analysis capability, which can query and analyze the collected data in real time and efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on glass relics based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The degree of weathering, chemical composition and classification of glass relics are of great significance to the research of archeologists. In this paper, the classification rules of high-potassium and lead-barium glass are constructed using the decision tree algorithm, and then the data set is determined according to the forecast demand. The problem of predicting the type of glass relics is defined as a general binary problem, which is trained by a classical neural network, multi-layer perceptron (MLP). Due to the small amount of data, the parameters were optimized by using the five-fold cross validation, and the sensitivity test was carried out. It was found that the overall robustness of the model was very strong, and the parameters had little influence on the results. After finding the optimal parameters, the prediction of MLP is highly matched with the prediction results of the decision tree, which proves that the model is reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on Software Reliability Evaluation Based on Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This research systematically analyzes the reliability of the software and the complete process of the current software reliability testing, and proposes the concepts of redundant architecture, branch architecture, serial architecture, cyclic architecture and reliability calculation methods, and uses the reliability calculation method of the basic architecture to evaluate the entire system. Finally, a specific example analysis is given, and the results show that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Air Conditioning Energy Consumption Simulation and Optimization Strategy Based on TRNSYS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays, China's building energy consumption accounts for about 20% of all energy consumption, of which the energy consumption per unit area of public buildings is about 2-4 times that of other buildings. In the energy consumption of public buildings, nearly half of the building energy consumption is reflected in the air conditioning system. Therefore, reducing the energy consumption of HVAC system is of great significance for reducing the energy consumption of public buildings and the total energy consumption in China. This paper focuses on building air-conditioning system, to construct the mathematical model of energy consumption of each equipment and uses the modular system transient simulation software to build the simulation model. From the perspective of the overall energy consumption of the system, the control strategy to achieve energy-saving and efficient operation of the building air-conditioning system under the existing equipment configuration is studied. By comparing and analyzing the energy consumption before and after the optimization of the control mode of indoor air conditioning, it is concluded that the energy consumption of the optimized air conditioning system is about 12% reduction compared with that of the existing system.

articleTitle: Method for Initial Point Positioning of V-bevel Welding Seam Based on Binocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the positioning problem of welding the initial point in the process of welding medium-thick plate V- bevel, a method for positioning based on binocular vision is proposed in this paper. The binocular cameras are arranged in an eye-to-hand manner to capture images included the initial point of the workpiece weld, using YOLOv5 neural network to localize the area included the welding initial point. Then the image of positioned area is preprocessed, using the straight line detection method to extract the workpiece edge on the image captured by the binocular camera to find the starting point of the tack weld. Then get the data of stereo calibration the binocular camera and eye-to-hand calibration between robot and camera to determine the relationship between the picture pixel coordinate system and the robot base coordinate system. Finally, the coordinates of the starting point of the welding seam in the robot base coordinate system are calculated using the calibration results and the pixel coordinates on the starting point picture of the welding seam. After comparison with the coordinates demonstrated by the robot, the precision of the guidance method proved to be able to meet the requirements for the use of subsequent seam tracking welds.

articleTitle: Study on Wind Power Prediction Based on EEMD-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Accurate prediction of wind power generation is important to achieve user-friendly interconnection of large-scale wind power generation networks. Given the intermittency and instability of wind power, an ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) and long and short memory neural network (LSTM) method is proposed to predict wind power generation. First, the original wind power sequence was decomposed into multiple intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) using the EEMD method, then LSTM-based prediction models were built for each IMF separately to obtain prediction results for each subset component, and finally the prediction results for each subset were superimposed to reconstruct the resulting wind power sequence. The case simulation results showed that the EEMD-LSTM prediction model had higher prediction accuracy than the LSTM prediction model and the EMD-LSTM prediction model, and three evaluation indicators, RMSE, MAE and MAPE, were superior, validating the accuracy and superiority of the combined EEMD-LSTM prediction method.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Distribution Route Optimization Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In real life, how to solve the path planning in the process of logistics distribution is the primary problem faced by logistics enterprises. The ant colony algorithm of path planning can solve the scheduling problem of logistics allocation and find the optimal path. When establishing the model, we should consider various constraints. The ant colony algorithm is used to analyze and calculate the distribution path in the actual case. The optimal distribution path is obtained. Therefore, the algorithm can help enterprises achieve higher economic benefits and pave the way for the long-term development of logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: Energy consumption prediction of public buildings based on PCA-RF-AdaBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The influencing factors of public building energy consumption are complex, and accurate prediction of public building energy consumption is of great significance for energy conservation. Studying new energy consumption prediction methods can simplify the prediction process and improve the prediction accuracy. Taking the energy consumption data of a large public building as the sample, the principal component analysis is carried out to remove the information redundancy and eliminate the correlation between input quantities; Based on the analysis of random forest and AdaBoost algorithm, the RF AdaBoost prediction model is constructed. The results show that the prediction model has better prediction effect, which can be used to predict and supervise building energy consumption, improve energy consumption facilities, and achieve effective energy utilization.

articleTitle: Identification of Grape Leaf Diseases and Insect Pests Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the grape planting industry and the growing area of grape planting in southern Jiangsu, effective identification and control of pests and diseases is one of the important issues to ensure the economic income of fruit farmers. This paper studies the identification of common black rot, ring spot and brown spot on grape leaves, and uses image processing technology to preprocess images of grape leaf diseases and insect pests. The experimental results show that the DenseNet121 convolutional neural network has the best recognition effect, the shortest recognition time and the highest efficiency for the grape leaf disease and insect pest images with complex background.

articleTitle: A Text Classification Model Based on Gaussian Multi-Head Self Attention Mechanism for Chinese Medical Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the matching level of the Q&A system, text classification methods are used to classify user questions. Therefore, this paper proposes a text classification based on a hybrid model of CNN and Transformer in chinese medical dataset. Unlike the existing traditional CNN-based methods, we use a Gaussian multi-head self attention mechanism to obtain the text’s spatial features. On the chinese medical dataset ,experimental results show that compared with the baseline model the proposed model performs better in accuracy,recall,precision and F1, in which the accuracy achieves 93.20% and the F1 value achieves 94.66%.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Chinese Spelling Check Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Chinese spelling error correction technology is an important technology that teachers of Chinese as a foreign language should master. The research on Chinese spelling error correction technology can not only be applied to Pinyin input method, document editing tools, search engines, chat robots, voice assistants, etc., but also help Chinese learners at home and abroad to learn Chinese, improve learning efficiency and reduce learning pressure. However, the existing Chinese spelling error correction technology has some problems, such as insufficient context information of word vector, and the generated candidate words are limited to the confusion set. This is an urgent need for new Chinese spelling error correction technology to automatically detect and correct data to improve the error correction performance of text., In this paper, we propose a Spell model based on machine learning. After obtaining the final candidate words, we extract the feature information of the candidate words and their sentences, and use XGBoost classifier to filter out the correct words. The experiment shows that the performance of Spell model is significantly improved compared with the traditional model.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Twinning Technology in the Construction of Computer Digital Logistics Intelligent Twinning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, under the framework of digital twinning, a cross-unit digital logistics twinning linkage decision information architecture is proposed. Then this paper establishes the logistics intelligent system through the dynamic accurate mapping and real-time feedback control of "physical environment-virtual model". At the same time, this paper adopts the objective cascade method to systematically coordinate the "transport-warehousing - transfer" decision units with independent decision making and linkage operation in the virtual layer with the mode of global optimization and distributed control. The model realizes the online linkage decision of logistics intelligent twin system. The results show that the proposed method can effectively realize multi-unit synchronous operation and reduce the total operation cost and order time.

articleTitle: Improvement of IIR Digital Band-Pass Filter by the Digital Frequency Band Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the IIR digital band-pass filter manufacturing technology. The relationship of angular frequencies between analog prototype low-pass filter and digital band-pass filter is deduced by the method of the digital frequency band transformation in this paper. A new method of designing infinite impulse response (IIR) digital band-pass filter by converting directly from digital band-pass filter indicator to analog prototype low-pass filter indicator is proposed. Also, we take an example to illustrate this technology. Compared with the reported methods, this measure is more rigorous and simple.

Author Keywords: Method of digital frequency band transformation

articleTitle: The Research of Development of New Energy Industrial Internet Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: There are various technical and management barriers in new energy monitoring, operation and maintenance, trading, on-demand manufacturing and other businesses. To realize the double closed loop control of new energy equipment on-demand manufacturing and new energy power on-demand production, we must build a new energy industrial Internet platform, in terms of relevant technical standards and business processes, and establish a novel new energy management system. According to White paper on industrial Internet platform, Industrial Internet Architecture-version 2.0 and Internet of things information and communication conceptual model, the technical architecture of new energy industrial Internet platform is constructed from six domains: user domain, physical entity domain, perception control domain, service provision domain, operation and maintenance control domain and resource exchange domain.

articleTitle: Study of binocular parallax estimation algorithms with different focal lengths
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Existing binocular parallax estimation algorithms all use standard stereo cameras, which are unable to achieve high definition for monitoring both near and far objects due to the camera's own parameters. In order to solve this problem, a parallax estimation method is proposed for images taken by cameras with different focal lengths, which can directly calculate parallax maps for near and far views. A calibrated stereo correction method is proposed to parameterise the binocular image scaling for direct image correction at different focal lengths; the monocular portion of the results is calibrated by comparing the parallax results in the binocular range and introducing monocular parallax correction parameters. Experimental results on the Middlebury Stereo public dataset, which was used to simulate images of different focal lengths, show that the proposed parallax estimation algorithm was able to generate both far-field and near-field parallax maps with an avgerr of 8.33%, which is significantly better than the monocular parallax estimation method.

articleTitle: Pure azimuth passive localization in attempted formation flight of UAVs under different constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Each UAV in a UAV formation has its own team number and maintains the same relative position to the rest of the UAVs during the formation flight. The UAV cluster needs to choose a suitable formation shape, a suitable navigator and an excellent position adjustment scheme to ensure flexible maintenance of the cluster formation in various complex environments. In this paper, on the basis of maintaining circular formation, the flight positioning model of UAVs passively receiving signals is established when signals are transmitted by the central UAV and two other UAVs and the position of the UAV transmitting signals is not deviated and the number is known, and the position of the remaining UAVs is deviated; on the basis of maintaining circular formation, a certain position UAV receives signals FY00 and FY01 as transmitting signals when it is also On the basis of maintaining circular formation, when all UAVs deviate from their positions, how to reasonably and accurately develop a UAV position adjustment plan to ensure that each time the number FY00, FY01 and any maximum of two remaining UAVs are selected to transmit signals, the remaining UAVs can adjust their positions according to the agreed direction information received The UAV will adjust its position according to the agreed direction information received.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Prediction with LSTM and BPNN Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As global demand for electricity is increasing, attention is focused on clean renewable energy sources such as wind power. The rapid development of wind power generation puts forward higher requirements for wind speed prediction. However, it is already very difficult to collect accurate wind speed data. It has certainly become more difficult and challenging to predict. In this paper, the data of a meteorological station in Qinghai Province is taken as an example. Firstly, the collected data is preprocessed, and then Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) are used to build the model before and after, and the pre-established model is trained, and the fitting results are obtained in the training set. Finally, the test set is predicted, the result is obtained and the graph is drawn. Experiments and comparisons are illustrated to show that the experimental effect of BPNN is stronger than that of LSTM.

articleTitle: RSSI-KNN: A RSSI Indoor Localization Approach with KNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Nowadays, with the rapid growth of wireless communication technique, Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) is not only satisfied in measuring distance, but also be used in indoor location frequently. The article focuses on one technology which is called Trilateration, which measure the energy of the RF signal to determine the distance of the transmitter and the desired point. Furthermore, this article also provides a more precise memoryless method-K-nearest neighbor (KNN), which makes an excellent matching of the test point in the test set through the fingerprinting-localization model constructed for the dataset. Based on a complex indoor scenario with several corners and shelters, this article has made a comprehensive comparison of these two technologies through giving an accuracy and precision analysis in three familiar wireless technologies: ZigBee, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and WiFi. However, according to the experimental results, KNN is significantly better than Trilateration at Indoor Localization. The average of MSE using KNN in three technology was 1.1613m with a variance of 0.1633m. The average of MSE using Trilateration was 2.2687m with a variance of 4.8903m. By comparing the minimum mean square error (MSE) and variance (σ<sup>2</sup>) when providing different values of k to this scenario, this article gets the optimal is 3 to make the k-value which was chosen won’t lead overfitting or underfitting. Under these circumstances, the MSE and the variance of the indoor scenario can be reduced to 0.9577m and 0.1288m respectively. In terms of the various wireless technology, WiFi has a higher accuracy under Trilateration and KNN, which the MSE and the variance are 1.7109m and 1.8182m.

articleTitle: Field Distribution in Shielding Case from Space Electromagnetic Interference during Switching Operation in Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Transient electromagnetic field generated by switching operations in substations is one of the main sources of electromagnetic interference in substations. In order to ensure the normal operation of secondary equipment, an electromagnetic shield is often required. In this paper, a model is established by using electromagnetic simulation analysis software to analyze the influence of the position change of the disturbance source, the size and number of openings in the shield, and the materials constituting the shield on the electric field inside the shield. The results show that: in the short range, the farther the disturbance source is from the horizontal distance of the shield, the better the shielding effect of the shield; the smaller and more the number of openings in the shield, the lower the electric field inside the shield. The larger the relative permittivity of the insulating material, the stronger the insulating ability, and the better the shielding effect of the electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Intelligent Agricultural Data Collection and Analysis System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid economic development, the development of emerging technologies is changing with each passing day, and the process of agricultural informatization has been further promoted. At present, the intelligent application represented by the intelligent agricultural data collection and analysis system has been widely used, and the degree of agricultural informatization has been improved. The purpose of this paper is to study the design and implementation of the smart agricultural data collection and analysis system based on the Internet of Things technology. Research and analyze the business requirements in smart agriculture, and choose the MongoDB database with the built-in GridFS file system as the best storage solution. Then, combined with the characteristics of agricultural data and the document characteristics of MongoDB, a MongoDB-based agricultural data storage model is constructed. An agricultural big data analysis algorithm based on clustering is proposed. Using this method, the massive agricultural production data generated by the agricultural Internet of Things can be analyzed, and the data of the remote monitoring terminal can be clearly obtained in the remote monitoring module. The system meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Research on HPLC Technology System of Client-side Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The paper is guided by the company’s energy Internet enterprise strategic goal, and in-depth study of HPLC deepening application, online monitoring and fault diagnosis, HPLC and HRF dual-mode integration, HPLC IoT sensing equipment efficient access and processing, etc. Key technology. The thesis develops HPLC online monitoring and fault diagnosis system and handheld measuring device, deep application module prototype based on HPLC and HRF integration, HPLC-based power Internet of Things platform, and proposes HPLC technical system design plan and business operation model. The thesis provides strong support and guarantee for the power Internet of Things technology promotion and deepening application of HPLC on the customer side.

articleTitle: License Plate Character Recognition with Lightweight Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Character recognition is a crucial step in license plate (LP) recognition. Traditional methods based on template matching and human feature extraction are not robust enough. The Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) based algorithm can automatically extract the character features through the deep network and significantly improve the correct recognition rate. This paper investigated data augmentation and a lightweight CNN-based algorithm for character recognition. The lightweight network is proposed to enhance character feature extraction by optimizing the convolutional network. In addition, various data enhancement methods are applied to increase the number of data samples to improve the robustness of recognition and enhance the model generalization ability. The experimental results showed that the character recognition accuracy of the proposed approach reached 99.8% with high precision, recall, and specificity. The recognition time for a single character was 6.9 ms on CPU and 0.46 ms on GPU, which meets the demand for real-time LP recognition and has specific reference significance in intelligent transportation.

articleTitle: Data Analysis of Abnormal Harmonic of Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on online monitoring data, the harmonic problem of the offshore wind farm is analyzed and studied. Firstly, the operation state of the wind farm and the harmonic emission level of the wind turbine are analyzed. Then, according to the daily statistical data of wind farm harmonics, histogram analysis and quantification of statistical indicators such as skewness and kurtosis are carried out to grasp the statistical data distribution characteristics of wind farm harmonic current. Finally, based on the minute-level data of typical days of harmonic problems, the correlation analysis between the harmonic data and the wind farm operation state is carried out to clarify the corresponding relationship between the harmonic anomaly and the wind farm operation state, which provides new ideas and directions for harmonic management.

articleTitle: LoRa-based smart greenhouse control system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of the intelligent society, smart greenhouses are also developing rapidly in the direction of intelligence and precision, realizing intelligent monitoring of the growth environment of each crop in the greenhouse, and making up for the high labor cost, high labor intensity and high labor intensity of traditional greenhouse planting. Disadvantages such as low production efficiency. The LoRa-based smart greenhouse control system adopts wireless communication technology, uses a variety of sensor modules to realize real-time monitoring of the growth environment, and combines the terminal display of various webpages and small programs to realize remote monitoring and intelligent monitoring of various environmental factors in the greenhouse. Management, early warning reminders and other functions, so as to achieve the purpose of increasing crop yield, improving product quality, and improving production efficiency, thereby greatly improving the economic benefits of smart agriculture.

articleTitle: Construction of domain knowledge graph based on open source intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to deeply tap the potential information of open source intelligence, facilitate people to understand domain knowledge and build a domain knowledge graph. First, we use web crawler technology to crawl open source data, and then we use word segmentation and other methods to preprocess the data. Then we use deep learning methods to extract entities, attributes, and relationships from the data to establish a domain knowledge base. Finally, we build a domain knowledge graph to facilitate people to search and query related domain knowledge, and improve the efficiency and quality of network search.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of AEB System Based on Virtual Scene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to realize the simulation study of Autonomous Emergency Braking (AEB) system and solve the problems of traditional real vehicle verification, such as high test cost, long cycle, unreusable scene and unable to quantitative analysis, a simulation test method for AEB system is designed for SAE 2. Using the software CarMaker and Matlab/Simulink to build traffic scene, virtual sensor model and vehicle dynamic model. The results show that the proposed method verifies the effectiveness of the AEB system algorithm, and the risk degree can be predicted according to the collision time, and the vehicle can be kept within the appropriate safe distance range.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Archive Data Management System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Blockchain is an accounting technology that is jointly maintained by multiple parties, uses cryptography to ensure transmission and access security, and can achieve consistent data storage, hard to tamper with, and prevent repudiation. It is characterized by strong confidentiality, non tampering, and decentralization. Use blockchain HyperLedger technology to store archive data, extract the hash value of the original file and other key information and record it in the blockchain ledger, to ensure that the data can not be tampered with and the credibility of the stored data.

articleTitle: Mobile communication network site planning and regional clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of mobile communication technology, communication network planning in the site selection is more complex, in order to base stations to make reasonable planning can solve the problem of weak coverage area of the cover, this paper calculated the each existing base station site of two possible site type business ratios to determine the existing site is built acer station or micro base station, The proportion of macrobase stations and microbase stations is calculated by analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Finally, it is determined that 365 macrobase stations and 1109 microbase stations are built in the existing site, with a total cost of 4759 and a traffic coverage of 99.99%.Then, considering the cost and benefit factors, the optimization scheme eliminates 401 minimum revenue existing sites and uses particle swarm optimization algorithm to select 234 new sites to build microbase stations. 365 macrobase stations are built and 942 microbase stations are built, with a total cost of 4529 and a business coverage rate of 91.28%.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Technology and Digital Twin in the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of image recognition technology, more and more industries are benefiting from it, and the power industry is no exception. With the empowerment of image recognition technology, it can save human and material resources and improve digitalization. Meanwhile, digital twin technology is also being applied in various traditional industries. Digital twin technology and image recognition technology can promote each other and complement each other to achieve improved quality and efficiency. It is in this context that this paper discusses how image recognition technology and digital twin technology can contribute to the intelligent development of the electric power industry.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Structure Speech Coding Scheme Based on MELPe and LPCNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Although the conventional speech coding algorithms can achieve 1200bps, 600bps or even lower, the synthesized speech quality becomes worse and worse, and the improvement effect is limited. Several speech synthesis models based on deep learning proposed in recent years make it possible to synthesize high-quality speech. This paper integrates LPCNet into the traditional MELPe algorithm to finish the speech synthesis task. Experiments demonstrate that the quality of this scheme is similar to that of MELPe at 1.07kbps, which can be used as a new idea to study the ultra-low rate MELPe.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Parallelization of Spectral Clustering Algorithm Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Cluster analysis is an important research direction in data mining. In the past decades, a large number of clustering algorithms have been developed, among which spectral clustering has been widely used because of its excellent performance in nonlinear separable data. In addition, with the continuous development of the Internet, more and more data are generated in the network, forming big data. Therefore, how to apply spectral clustering algorithm to big data and mine useful information has become a very important research topic. With the explosion of data scale, some industries have reached terabytes or even petabytes of data. The storage capacity and computing capacity of a single computer can no longer meet the requirements. At the same time, the spectral clustering algorithm will spend a lot of time in the process of processing massive data, which seriously limits the efficiency of the cluster analysis of mass data by the clustering algorithm in tomorrow. Therefore, improving the computational efficiency of the spectral clustering algorithm has become a research focus. In addition to using sampling method to optimize spectral clustering algorithm and reduce its computational complexity, with the emergence and wide application of various distributed parallel computing frameworks such as MapReduce and Spark, researchers have gradually focused on the distributed parallelization of spectral clustering algorithm. In the big data environment, the parallelization of spectral clustering algorithm is realized. It can not only obtain better clustering effect, but also improve the efficiency of spectral clustering algorithm for largescale cluster analysis. For the massive data of various industries, how to improve the large-scale clustering of spectral clustering algorithm. It is of great practical significance to analyze efficiency so as to improve work efficiency. According to the problem of long running time of spectral clustering algorithm in processing large-scale data sets, based on the idea of data parallelism, we study the efficient parallelization of spectral clustering algorithm based on Dask+CPUIGPU platform, which effectively improves the efficiency of spectral clustering algorithm in processing large-scale data sets.

articleTitle: UAV Formation Positioning Model Based on Plane Geometry Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: UAV positioning plays an important role in the problem of UAV formation scheduling. With the increasing demand for UAVs, the concept of UAV formation has been proposed in recent years, which has higher working efficiency and better working ability. Therefore, the positioning of each UAV in UAV formation is particularly important. In this paper, two problems are analyzed. First, when the serial number of three UAVs transmitting signals is given, their positions in the UAV group are determined according to the direction information of the UAVs receiving signals. Second, when the number of UAV transmitting the signal is unknown, the minimum number of additional UAVs to locate the unknown UAU is obtained. For the first problem, an angle change determination model based on plane geometry analysis is constructed. The qualitative deviation of UAV relative to its own standard position is determined through the size relationship between the three angles received by UAV in real time and its own standard angle. Additionally, considering the error in practical application and the need for precise coordinates of UAVs, a fast-positioning model based on the geometric structure of equal chords and equal angles is then proposed, which may quickly calculate the current coordinates of UAVs. For the second problem, two models are constructed, namely the relative position determination model based on cosine theorem and the relative position determination model based on data comparison. The first model requires less calculation but requires larger number of additional UAVs and the second type requires more complicated calculation and requires smaller number of additional UAVs.

articleTitle: A fault diagnosis method for ship shaft system based on empirical wavelet transform and particle filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of excessive redundant information and low fault feature extraction rate of ship shafting vibration signal, a fault feature extraction method based on empirical wavelet transform and particle filter is proposed. Firstly, the original signal is processed by empirical wavelet transform to separate the redundant vibration components, and solve the defects such as end effect and modal aliasing inherent in empirical mode decomposition. Secondly, intrinsic mode functions are filtered and reconstructed based on kurtosis, correlation coefficient and energy ratio to highlight fault information and improve signal-to-noise ratio. Finally, particle filter is applied to the reconstructed fault feature components to eliminate the residual non-linear and non-Gaussian noise in EWT, and the fault type is analyzed by the envelope spectrum. Through the analysis of the experimental bearing signal, the feature extraction ability and noise suppression ability of the method are verified, which can be effectively applied to the fault diagnosis of the ship shaft system.

articleTitle: Design and research on resource management of scale edge data center
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper first introduces the requirements of the current State Grid for the management of edge sites, and then introduces the edge platform of the current business. Then, it introduces a logical architecture design scheme of the cloud edge platform, and carries out relevant tests on the scheme. Experiments show that the scheme achieves the expected design effect and has good performance. Finally, combined with the current dual carbon policy, the next research direction is pointed out.

articleTitle: Research on Image Analysis and Processing Technology Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the increase of information, the traditional image processing technology still has a big shortage in image quality and processing speed. Therefore, how to improve the image quality and processing speed is a research hotspot. To solve the above problems, we adopt the method of combining the generative countermeasure network with the super-resolution reconstruction, and use the open data set to train the model. Through the reasonable selection and optimization of the image processing algorithm, we can achieve the goal of improving the image super-resolution reconstruction effect. In order to improve the slow image processing speed, we set up Spark cluster to integrate computing resources. The experimental results show that the method based on the generation of countermeasure network has a good effect for high resolution image reconstruction, and this method can expand the resolution of low resolution image by four times; The cluster based on the Spark platform shows better performance advantages in processing a large number of image data. When the hardware indicators of the cluster environment and the stand-alone environment are consistent, the cluster based on the Spark platform can increase the running speed of the program by about 10%. When the data volume reaches the tera-byte level or even the petabyte level, the operation speed of the system can still be improved by increasing the overall running memory of the cluster.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology in Information Security Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper innovatively proposes a database access information security management method under the big data platform. This paper first designs and implements a network information security management system based on B/S architecture. The system consists of a safety management platform management center, a WEB console, an agency center and a processing center. At the same time, the system covers a total of five sub-modules including security monitoring management, security policy management, event analysis and processing, security incident response and system management. Secondly, this paper constructs an attribute-based multi-authorization encryption system, which reduces the number of matching operations and improves the efficiency of password utilization. Then, this paper builds a user hierarchical role key tree in the big data platform user role authentication center, and describes the relationship between the big data platform user role and the encryption key of extremely sensitive information. Finally, simulation experiments are carried out in this paper. The results show that the establishment of the encryption system enhances the security of web page access information, and realizes the security management of information platform access information under the big data platform.

articleTitle: A Review of Research on Testability Technology for Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Testability technology, an important design feature for easy testing and diagnosis, has a great impact on the availability of systems and equipment. Good testability equipment can improve the reliability and safety of equipment in time when facing failure or unexpected situations; it can quickly detect and isolate the failure during maintenance, shorten the time of failure detection and maintenance, and effectively reduce the maintenance cost. When studying the testability of complex systems, it is necessary to proceed sequentially from five aspects: testability hierarchy, failure mode sorting, test set selection, fault diagnosis, and testability verification. This paper briefly introduces these key technology their core concepts as well as their common methods.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-AGVs Cooperative Transportation Strategy in Warehouse Logistics Environment Based on HCA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of science and technology in the logistics industry, logistics robots have become the choice of more and more enterprises, which can reduce costs and improve work efficiency. Compared with the application of single AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) in logistics transportation, the multi-AGVs method is more widely used. The basic A-star algorithm can provide path planning for single AGV in the static road network. Furthermore, HCA (Hierarchical Cooperative A-Star Algorithms) introduces time quantity based on A-star to achieve path planning for multiple AGVs. This paper uses HCA algorithm and introduces Manhattan distance into grid map. Then, a multi-AGVs cooperative transportation strategy is proposed. The storage and transportation environment is simulated under the simulation environment of Webots. The multi-AGV cooperative transportation strategy proposed in this paper is verified and analyzed. Simulation results demonstrate the practicability of the navigation algorithm and the feasibility of the strategy.

Author Keywords: Cooperative Transportation Strategy Cooperative Transportation Strategy

articleTitle: High-speed Real-time Infrared Image Target Detection Method Based on Intelligent Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of infrared detectors, the high-speed detection data has grown exponentially, which bring great challenges to the real-time target detection processed by back-end. Aiming at this problem, we complete the target fast detection experiment in the sequence oriented infrared image based on YOLOv5 and intelligent platform, which is composed of cpu and smart chip. According to the experimental results, for 8K×8K 16bit quantized high-speed detection image can basically meet the real-time processing capability of Gb/s level, and for conventional images less than 2K×2K 16bit quantized high-speed detection image can basically realize the ability of simultaneous processing of less than ten detection images. According to the results of our experiment, the high-speed real-time infrared image target detection method based on intelligent platform will have a certain application in the actual space-based detection and the application processing.

articleTitle: Research on bank customer churn model based on attention network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the popularization of mobile devices and the rapid development of the mobile Internet, the growth of data has led to the obvious development of emerging industries such as Internet finance. In this context, the traditional financial industry has been severely impacted by the Internet finance industry. However, the growth of data is a "double-edged sword", which brings more management costs to enterprises and also contains more valuable information. User churn prediction is one of the most discussed issues in banking business. Exploring a user churn prediction model suitable for the existing data environment is of great significance to the development of banking business. In this paper, the attention weight is added to the three neural networks of LSTM and GRU after the data processing, and more accurate prediction results are obtained.

articleTitle: >Research on Risk Analysis of an Airport Based on QAR Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To strengthen the safety management and increase the risk management level of airports, the QAR(Quick Access Recorder) data related to airports were extracted to perform risk analysis. As a result, an airport risk analysis index system based on QAR data was established in this work, which involved wind shear analysis of the airport, flight quality risks, core risks of controlled flight into terrain (CFIT), and runway overrun & excursion. Meanwhile, the above-mentioned index risks were analysed based on an airport. From the extracted outcomes, it can be concluded that the wind shear risk of the airport mainly occurred in March. More specifically, more wind shear events relatively occurred at 6-7 o’clock and 7-8 o’clock (UTC time). The number of wind shear events in the final approach stage was also the highest and the Runway 20# witnessed the most wind shear events. The flight quality risks were analysed by taking B737NG for example. In addition, its index risks of touchdown speed, 50 feet-to-touchdown distance, decreasing rate from 500-50 ft, and lift-off speed exhibited obvious differences from the whole industry. The core risks of CFIT and the runway overrun & excursion also determine the specific time of alarm triggering and risk factors.

articleTitle: Research on location planning of 5G base station based on DBSCAN clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In China, the coverage of 5G network is increasing rapidly, and the cost of base station construction is huge. Therefore, reasonable and efficient site planning is an extremely important task.In this paper, based on DBSCAN clustering algorithm, Python software is used to build the model, and the traversal algorithm is used to solve the problem, and the site selection and planning work of 5G base station is completed.In practical application, the model has strong practicability and feasibility, and has a wide range of application.

articleTitle: Analysis of Operation Failure of Transformer Oil Chromatography Online Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to research the causes of failure in the operation of the transformer oil chromatography online monitoring device, combined with the situation that the transformer oil chromatography online monitoring device in an UHV substation did not detect acetylene when the acetylene content of transformer oil exceeded the standard, it is judged that the fault cause of the gas chromatography principle device is the detector problem, and the fault cause of the photoacoustic spectroscopy principle device is the acetylene sensor communication problem by means of on-site inspection, test detection and other ways. The fault phenomena of two kinds of principle on-line monitoring devices are verified by experiments. It is suggested that the self-check function should be added to the online monitoring device and the fault alarm list should be improved by optimizing the manufacturing process in the later stage. it can respond timely and remind operation and maintenance personnel to maintain the device when the online monitoring device has abnormal situation.

articleTitle: Navigation and obstacle avoidance technology for warehouse tracking AGVs based on multi-sensor information fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) is a device that uses various sensor technologies, automation, and multiple control systems. AGVs have many navigation methods, of which the magnetic stripe navigation system is well developed. The magnetic stripe navigation AGV positioning is carried out precisely and at a lower cost level. However, the magnetic stripe is prone to breakage, and the AGV can only travel according to the magnetic stripe and cannot be intelligently avoided or the task changed in real-time by the control system. This paper draws on magnetic stripe navigation tracking principles, using grey-scale sensors for stable path tracking; distance sensors are combined for timely obstacle avoidance; Bluetooth is used to obtain approximate indoor locations for path planning. The navigation system simultaneously combines multi-sensor information for navigation, ultimately enabling the AGV to be quickly positioned accurately along the prescribed path and return to the route in time to avoid obstacles.

articleTitle: CRM-SBKG: Effective Citation Recommendation by Siamese BERT and Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Citation recommendation focuses on recommending references to the given document automatically. While the existing works have achieved improvements in citation recommendation, their quality may still be degraded due to the cold-start problem or insufficient use of features. To alleviate these problems, we investigate the possibility of fully utilizing a document's features from different dimensions. Specifically, we present a citation recommendation model based on Siamese BERT and Knowledge Graph (CRM-SBKG), a mixture model that mines the text feature and entity feature to obtain the recommendation list. We use the BERT model with the Siamese network for text feature extraction and build a citation knowledge graph where entity feature is extracted. We apply the proposed model on Open Academic Graph (OAG) and DataBase systems and Logic Programming (DBLP). The results show that our model outperforms the baselines significantly. It reflects that the proposed model can extract features more effectively and make better citation recommendations.

articleTitle: LGA-based short-term power load time series forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Accurate power load forecasting is crucial to decide on the power grid's operation and customers' power consumption management. It can ensure the power system's reliable power supply and the grid economy's reliable operation. However, as population and electricity consumption continues to increase, the power system poses a huge challenge. Accurate power load forecasting is an effective way to solve the problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a short-term power timing prediction model based on LGA. First, the power data is fed into LSTM and GRU to improve the model robustness in a parallel way. Second, the output results of LSTM and GRU are weighted and summed to obtain the output results by the activation function. After experimental validation with separate RNN, LSTM, and GRU, the model in this paper has high prediction performance.

articleTitle: AureNet: A Real-Time Arbitrary-oriented and Ship-based Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, due to the bursting computing power, neural-network-based object detection algorithms are emerging in large numbers, which is very promising in monitoring the transportation, especially in remoting sensing of the sea where it is relatively easier to distinguish the background and foreground. But because of the arbitrary angles of the ships, the impacts of illuminations and the too large aspect ratio of the length with respect to width for the ships, ship detection has faced challenging. To improve the accuracy of ship detection, in this paper, we present a new network based on RetinaNet named AureNet where Yolox-HSV algorithm is adopted to simulate the different light intensities for data augmentation. We used RegNet as the backbone of AureNet to extract the features more efficiently. What’s more, we developed a client using C# and Python to lower the threshold to do ship detection for non-professionals. On ship detection dataset HRSC2016, AureNet achieves mAP of 0.5286, which is 1.2% higher than that of the original network RetinaNet, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed network.

articleTitle: Research of integrating prior knowledge into abnormal behavior recognition model of EV charging station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, the number of EV (Electric Vehicle) charging stations has surged, the safety literacy of charging personnel is uneven. However, the number of station O&M personnel is limited, which seriously affects the safe and efficient operation of EV charging stations. The AI algorithms can be used to detect the abnormal behavior happening in the station and alarm to intervene in time. Existing AI algorithms face the challenge of small sample size and many types of abnormal behaviors during the training process, which leads to poor generalization of the neural network model and large detection error. This study attempts to integrate prior knowledge into the abnormal behavior recognition model based on neural network, so as to improve the accuracy of the algorithm. The field data verification shows that the performance of the proposed algorithm is improved compared with the traditional algorithm, and the problem of small samples and low accuracy of abnormal behavior detection is effectively overcome.

articleTitle: Gaussian Wasserstein distance based ship target detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In remote sensing images, ship images are characterized by small target size, irregular arrangement and large scale difference, and the detection accuracy of existing target detection algorithms for small targets of ships is low. In order to extract the information in remote sensing target images more effectively and improve the detection accuracy of small targets, four models are constructed on the framework of GWD based on the dataset of HRSC16 in this paper. Firstly, the initial model based on GWD is trained, secondly, a cutout data enhancement strategy is added to GWD to further improve the robustness and overall performance of the convolutional neural network in the training process, then a ConvNeXt backbone network is introduced on the basis of GWD to improve the scalability and convergence of the network, and finally, the third model is based on the network is deepened, which can extract small target features more fully. The image recognition accuracy in HRSC16 dataset is improved from 54.1% at the beginning to 61.65%. Experiments show that the target detection algorithm proposed in this paper has good detection accuracy for small target detection of ships, and it is improved by 7.55% for small target detection after the improvement.

articleTitle: Intrusion detection of intelligent substation video surveillance based on average background interframe difference method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: According to the characteristics of intelligent substation integrated monitoring system, such as many kinds of equipment, large amount of information and wide range of involved fields, this paper studies the intrusion detection technology of intelligent substation video surveillance on the basis of intelligent substation. In this paper, moving target intrusion detection algorithm in video surveillance subsystem is deeply studied. Combining the advantages and disadvantages of existing detection methods, an improved interframe difference method based on average background is proposed. The performance of the algorithm before and after improvement is analyzed by simulation. The results show that the performance of the improved algorithm is significantly improved, the precision rate is increased by 30% and the recall rate is increased by 41.33% compared with that before the improvement, which has a certain promotion effect on the linkage of the monitoring system.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting based on PCA-ILSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To obtain accurate load prediction results from massive power data, a short-term load prediction method based on PCA and improved long and short term memory neural network is studied. Firstly, to reduce the degree of data redundancy and eliminate redundant attributes, the principal component analysis method is used to extract the main attributes that affect the power load, and the short-term load prediction model is established by using the obtained main attributes. To improve the prediction accuracy of long and short term memory network, a sparrow search algorithm was proposed to optimize the number of hidden layer neurons, learning rate and iteration times of long and short term memory network. The short-term load prediction model was established by sparrow search optimization of long and short term memory network. The simulation results show that the proposed method has better prediction effect than other algorithms, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified.

Author Keywords: Long and short term memory network

articleTitle: A Parameter-Optimized CNN Using WOA and Its Application in Fault Diagnosis of Bearing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Traditional bearing fault diagnosis is usually foundation on expert experience or manual selection. This diagnosis method has weak feature information and low Signal To Noise Ratio (SNR), which may cause the loss or redundancy of fault features; To solve these problems, this paper presents a training method of bearing fault diagnosis model based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Firstly, the original signal is transformed into a two-dimensional wavelet time-frequency transform to build a data set. Then, with the test error as the target, five population optimization algorithms such as WOA are used to search for the best parameter model of CNN. Finally, the AlexNet model is set with the best parameters. The network is trained and tested to creat a bearing fault diagnosis model. The experimental results show that this method can effectively enhance the adaptive feature extraction capabilities of the model and the troubleshooting accuracy, and has good generalization performance. Using WOA algorithm can not only complete the troubleshoot task of rolling bearing, but also its detection speed and accuracy are higher than other traditional diagnosis methods and other group optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in Korean Language Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a Korean multimedia teaching platform based on cloud computing. First, it analyzes the functional requirements, overall design, key technologies and advantages of cloud services in the sharing of multimedia teaching resources that should be met by the Korean multimedia teaching platform. Then this paper uses cloud computing technology to provide users with various services, and uses machine learning technology to analyze teaching data, thereby simplifying the process of course design and improving the learning efficiency of Korean majors. The implementation results of this platform in Korean teaching in colleges and universities show that the platform can improve the efficiency of resource sharing, maximize the use of excellent teaching resources, and improve Korean learning performance to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on Gender Difference of Car Following Behavior Based on Natural Driving Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Gender difference has a great influence on driving behavior, but at present, gender factors are less considered in various driving behavior analysis and modeling. In order to explore the mapping relationship between gender and driving behavior, a behavioral data acquisition system based on functional camera-millimeter wave radar was built to obtain the natural driving data of 22 drivers on structured road. Taking car following behavior as the research object, it was refined into five sub-scenes, deceleration car following, acceleration car following, steady car following, cut out and cut in. The key feature parameters of the sub-scenes correlation were obtained for mathematical statistical analysis. The results show that male drivers tend to slow down later, accelerate faster and have larger acceleration to obtain higher driving efficiency in various scenes. Female drivers have lower speed and relative distance in the process of steady car following, indicating that female drivers are not accustomed to high speed car following and will choose to change lanes in advance to avoid high speed car following. These differentiated key parameters can be used to improve the adaptability and accuracy of behavioral analysis and modeling.

articleTitle: Design of series voltage compensation device based on rectifier-inverter unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A series voltage compensation device based on rectifier-inverter unit is designed for the possible low voltage problem at the end of the distribution network. The compensation device adopts single-phase three-level rectifier unit and single-phase full-bridge inverter unit, and the control strategy of each unit is designed accordingly, so that the device can quickly ensure normal stability of the end voltage when low voltage problems occur. The voltage characteristics at both ends of the load before and after the compensation unit is connected are compared by simulation construction. The experimental results show that the proposed series voltage compensation device can significantly improve the end voltage of the grid and has good dynamic response capability, which can effectively solve the load-side low voltage problem.

articleTitle: Research on Security Protection of Space-Earth Integrated Network Wireless Link Based on Consortium Blockchain Technology and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The space-earth integrated network is an important strategic resource of China, but its wireless link is inherently vulnerable to cyber threats. Meanwhile, the traditional security protection technology is not suitable for its special network characteristics and lightweight deployment requirements. At the same time, the centralized security management model is prone to systemic risks of single-point breakthroughs. In order to effectively ensure the efficient operation, security and credibility of the space-earth integrated network, the consortium blockchain technology system is applied to the wireless link security protection of the space-earth integrated network to meet the current security requirements such as trusted access of space-earth integrated network terminals, secure interconnection of nodes and network attack supervision, and provides an exploration direction for the construction of the space-earth integrated network security protection system.

articleTitle: A study of base station establishment site selection based on cluster analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, to address the site planning and area clustering problems of mobile communication networks, the K-mean clustering algorithm, linear programming, K-mean clustering model, single-objective planning model, and simulation model are established, and python is used to program the solution to obtain the optimal site coordinates of new base stations and base station types, the optimal main direction angle of base stations and the total business volume of weak coverage points covered by base stations, how to cut and divide the area so that The paper features a series of conclusions such as how to cut and divide the area to minimize the total time complexity of clustering. This paper features the analytical processing of data and the establishment and application of K-mean clustering model.

articleTitle: Study on Passive Pure Azimuth Positioning Model and Position Adjustment Model of UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The context of this paper is that the UAV is proposed to avoid interference and maintain the formation by adjusting the passive pure bearing position. This paper focuses on the multi-station passive pure azimuth localization problem, which is mainly solved by two methods: precise localization without considering signal noise and probabilistic localization with considering signal noise. In this paper, we mainly consider the influence of environmental noise and use a passive pure azimuth positioning model based on Bayesian estimation and an adjustment model based on dynamic programming, and solve the model by mathematical methods and simulated annealing algorithms.

articleTitle: Lightweight Access Control Scheme for Attribute Change Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Cryptographic policy attribute based encryption (CP-ABE) has been extensively researched and employed in access control systems to facilitate secure data sharing. However, this scheme requires very high computing resources for decryption, and users' attributes change frequently, which limits the use of CP-ABE in the Internet of Things where computing resources are insufficient. Many solutions adopt cloud proxy outsourcing decryption to solve the problem of insufficient computing power, but there are problems of distrust in outsourcing decryption or additional verification costs. User attribute updating is also more limited to attribute revocation and requires updating ciphertext at the same time to resist user collusion attacks. To address these issues, a blockchain-based access control scheme with Attribute change capability is proposed. The blockchain is leveraged to securely outsource complex computational tasks, while user attribute tokens are updated in conjunction with the blockchain to update user attributes. Finally, we conduct a performance analysis and comparison of this scheme.

articleTitle: Combining Forecasting and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Techniques on Power Grid Scheduling Task
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The continuous emission of greenhouse gases is causing global warming and the habitat of many animals is being affected. Efforts are constantly being made to mitigate this situation. In the field of electricity research, it is challenging to investigate how to operate and maintain the power grid economical, low-carbon and stable. In order to tackle the challenge, we propose grid scheduling techniques that combine forecasting and reinforcement learning techniques. Forecasting techniques can predict future electricity demand and solar power generation. Reinforcement learning uses the current state of the grid environment, future electricity demand and solar power generation to make charging and discharging decisions for energy storage devices. The result is economical, low-carbon electricity use and the grid is stable. We conduct a lot of experiments on a real dataset and the experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Design of Track Tracking Controller for Tracked Car Based on Pure Tracking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of excessive deviation from the reference path in the tracking process of the crawler car, a trajectory tracking controller based on pure tracking algorithm is proposed to reduce the lateral deviation and heading angle deviation. The controller mainly includes preview points. Solving module, pure trajectory algorithm module, kinematics and dynamics module, and build a controller model in Simulink to track the "figure" curve trajectory. The experimental results show that the trajectory tracker has a good tracking effect and can be ideal. Track the reference trajectory, and both the lateral deviation and the heading angle deviation are within the specified range.

articleTitle: Research on Technology and Standards of Underwater Sensing and Communication for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper is introducing the research on the technologies as well as the standards status of underwater sensing and communication from the IoT perspective, it will help to get understanding on the related progress and will also guide on how to move on especially on the underwater sensing and communication standardization work.

articleTitle: Formation Adjustment of Bearings-only Passive Location UAV Based on Triangulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the development and progress of science and technology, to maintain electromagnetic silence and reduce external interference as much as possible, the UAV cluster decided to use the method of bearing-only passive positioning to adjust the position of the UAV when carrying out formation flight. In This paper, the method of bearings-only passive location for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) formation flying is solved, the ideal coordinates are established based on the triangular model, and the conical formation of UAV is determined based on bearings-only passive location by discussing the case of known signal source information and considering the possibility of relative position between the signal source and UAV. Accord to that model established accord to the known direction information under various corresponding conditions, the ideal coordinate of the target point is sol, and a corresponding position adjustment scheme is determined, Realize the precise positioning and coordinate adjustment of the unmanned aerial vehicle receiving the signal, and finally quickly and accurately adjust the special formation.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Image Encryption Based on Chaotic Syste
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of the information age, the speed of information dissemination is accelerating, the channels of dissemination are increasing, and the scope of dissemination is increasing, which has greatly improved our lives and brought a lot of convenience. But at the same time, the information technology has also brought many problems. The security of information is undoubtedly the top priority we should consider.If the security of information dissemination and storage is not guaranteed, personal privacy and national security will be greatly violated. In this situation, the level of information encryption technology is also rising. This paper studies the principle and application of digital image encryption algorithm. In this paper, the chaotic system based on logistic map is used to encrypt the image. Firstly, the related knowledge of chaos and cryptography is briefly introduced, and the principle and steps of digital image encryption are described; Furthermore, the encryption process is based on Logistic map, generating a group of chaotic sequences, which are XOR processed with the original image pixels to obtain a new image. Finally, the new image’s original content cannot be recognized by the naked eye, that is, the encrypted image, and the original image can be decrypted. By changing the key parameters, the encryption characteristics are studied to test the feasibility and practical application of the encryption algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of HDB3 Clock Recovery Module with Large Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of the communication and information industry, the demand for high-speed data transmission is growing. One of the essential tasks of the receiver is to extract synchronization information from the received data polluted by noise and recover the data and clock accurately. Therefore, clock data recovery (CDR) is crucial in optical transmission systems and other digital transmission fields. However, the traditional bit synchronous clock recovery can only recover signals of a specific frequency. If a front-end frequency meter is added at the beginning of signal input to measure the input signal frequency, and the real-time control bit synchronization extraction circuit uses the input signal frequency as its working frequency, the operating range of the bit synchronization clock recovery circuit can be significantly improved. This will be the perfect combination of clock recovery performance and time cost. This paper studies the basic principles of bit synchronous clock recovery circuit and dynamic frequency meter. The HDB3 dynamic clock in a wide frequency range is extracted in FPGA using an all-digital design method. Through simulation and verification, the bit synchronous CDR with a pre-dynamic frequency meter has a more comprehensive recovery range, reaching 64Kb/s to 32.768Mb/s.

articleTitle: Missing Data Imputation in Bridge Monitoring System Based on the Prediction Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, combined with the popular prediction model in the field of artificial intelligence, experimental simulation and prediction of missing data of bridge health monitoring are carried out. The prediction models involved include support vector regression model SVM, neural network prediction model, Gaussian process regression model and time series prediction model. Firstly, by introducing the background and research status of BSHMS, the existing problems in the literature and the core work of this paper are proposed. Secondly, this paper introduces the basic principles of the related algorithms, which lays a foundation for the later model building. Third, the three groups of data were tested for normal distribution by the KPSS test method, and it was decided to use 3σ rule in order to identify abnormal data,while box chart rule is used for S2 and S3 measuring points. Then, the super parameters of the four models are optimized through several experiments, and the time series prediction model is simplified to AR model by using the characteristics of ACF and PACF images. Finally, the four models are simulated and the results are compared. The results show that SVR, BP and GPR all have good prediction effects, especially BP neural network, but the relative deviation of the prediction results of AR model is large, which may be due to the fact that only the impact of time series is considered in this case, and the limitation of reference data is not considered.

articleTitle: Research on Multifunctional Inspection System of Power Industry Equipment Based on Infrared Ultrasonic Integration Technology
