publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, based on infrared ultrasonic design based on TMS320F2812 digital processor combined with PC104 power inspection intelligent robot. Based on FPGA, the system can detect infrared thermal distribution, ultrasonic wave and transient ground voltage. In this paper, the system structure, work flow, electrical connection, patrol route planning and automatic data collection of two main functional modules design. It realizes the collection of inspection data of distribution network during the robot operation. The deep learning method is used to analyze the inspection principle and determine the image features of key equipment. Simulation results show that this method has the shortest decision-making time, the lowest repair cost and the best effect.

articleTitle: GAN-based image deblurring: A comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, image deblurring algorithms based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) have been proposed. The motion deblurring has been studied for some time. The multi-scale architecture of convolutional neural networks (CNN) can clearly recover blurred images, but the processing time is long. Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) performs well in style conversion and can clearly recover blurred images under a non-multi-scale architecture. The authors reviewed the popular papers related to DeblurGAN, compared the algorithm structure of different papers, related data sets and the accuracy of experimental results, which helped GAN based image deblur field to summarize and summarize, and enabled researchers to better promote the development of related fields. The authors review six papers, introduce their research motivation, research methods and experimental results, and show the differences of different deblur algorithms. Some excellent algorithms can work flexibly with a wide backbone, balancing performance and efficiency. They run faster than simple DeblurGAN while maintaining near-state of the art results.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of Greedy Projection Triangulation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of point cloud acquisition equipment, generating realistic 3D digital models based on various acquisition equipment has become one of the main means of acquiring object surface information, and has been widely used in computer vision, aerospace, 3D printing, terrain mapping, virtual Reality, archeology, reverse engineering and other fields. So the point cloud registration and 3D reconstruction technology are particularly important. This paper studies and improves point cloud registration algorithm and point cloud 3D reconstruction algorithm.

articleTitle: Preparation study of load spectrum of traction system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a load spectrum compilation method of shearer traction system is proposed, through the traction load analysis and pretreatment of three typical working conditions collected and synthesized in equal proportions, and further using the rainflow counting method to statistically fit the treated load and edge distribution, combined with the experience of probability and statistical distribution, it is concluded that the mean value and amplitude of the load of the right traction inverter follow the normal distribution and the three-parameter Weibull distribution respectively when the shearer is running in the left direction, and the two are independent of each other. The method and results of this paper can provide a theoretical basis and reference for the reliability loading test of shearer traction system, and lay a foundation for improving the reliability of the traction system and optimizing the inertial navigation and automatic cutting technology of shearer.

articleTitle: Research on a comprehensive evaluation method based on multi-indicator solitary network frequency control strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A comprehensive evaluation method of solitary network frequency control strategy based on multiple indicators is proposed to improve the accuracy of solitary network frequency control. Firstly, the evaluation index system of the orphaned network frequency control strategy is established, and on this basis, the single control strategy is evaluated. The objective and subjective weights of the indicators are determined by the entropy value method respectively, and the comprehensive evaluation value of the control strategy is obtained, and the orphaned network frequency control model is preferred. The experimental research is conducted through the actual data of an isolated network in a certain place, and the experimental results show that the method can effectively judge the control effect of each isolated network frequency control strategy, and the most suitable isolated network frequency control strategy can be selected in a targeted manner.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Twin Optimization Algorithm of Logistics Distribution Based on Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the basic concept of digital twinning and virtual reality, this paper constructs the five-dimensional structure model of logistics distribution digital twinning and the overall framework of logistics distribution system driven by digital twinning. At the same time, this paper studies and designs the intelligent scheduling management system and establishes the software system architecture and communication network. The system aims at the problem of simultaneous distribution vehicle routing with random cargo demand under multi-center joint distribution mode. At the same time, the width and depth of adaptive neighborhood search frequency strategy and adaptive inferior solution acceptance mechanism are proposed to balance population evolution. The experimental simulation shows that the system can effectively solve the road disturbance caused by vehicles or vehicles in the distribution process and achieve better logistics distribution.

articleTitle: Ionospheric Delay Inversion in the Working Area of Spacecraft TT&C Ship Based on BDS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Be directed against the problem that radio signals are susceptible to ionospheric delay interference, the BDS measurement information and ephemeris information are read through MATLAB, and the ionospheric delay over the sea area where the Spacecraft TT&C ship works is inversed. The results show that there is a signal delay of several nanoseconds to tens nanoseconds, and it is found that the ionospheric delay changes with time (day, night, season) and space (longitude and latitude).

articleTitle: Electric vehicle load optimization model considering peak and valley electricity price time
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The disorderly access of large-scale electric vehicles to the distribution network raises the grid's peak load. Firstly, by analyzing the driving characteristics of electric vehicles, this paper constructs the minimum load peak objective function according to the constraints of electric vehicle power demand and battery state of charge.By solving the genetic algorithm, the power grid load curve before and after optimization is obtained, and the changes in the power grid load curve at different peak and valley electricity price times and under different user response degrees are analyzed, and the load curve of the electric vehicle is compared with the load curve when the electric vehicle is charged in disorder, and the analysis is discussed. The consequence of electric vehicle charging mode and user responsiveness on peak grid load is evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-robot Material Picking and Autonomous Path Planning System in Industrial Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Industrial 4.0 has been proposed in 2014 and has received many achievements so far under the development of robotics and artificial intelligence. Among all of the research projects on smart factory, transfer robots are one of the most common applications for robotics in industrial field. To improve the navigation accuracy when locating products as well as complete more tasks such as picking materials, multi-robot path planning algorithms are necessary to combine with manipulators like mechanical arms. This work is focused on designing a transfer robot and a mechanical arm for industrial environment. Meanwhile, a modified A* algorithm named HCA algorithm is implemented into the multi-robot transfer system with PID controlled mechanical arm. The system can be used to finish transfer missions in large-scale warehouses or narrow industries. To further develop this system, continuous actions should be used instead of discrete ones. Moreover, computer vision methods can be added to the mechanical arm to increase the grasping accuracy and flexibility.

articleTitle: A Novel Modern Power System Stabilizer Tuning Approach on Site Using Multi-objective Lighting Flash Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the prominent nonlinear characteristics of the power grid system, power oscillation caused by the disturbance often occurs in the field. The injection of Power System Stabilizer (PSS) plays a certain role in suppressing low-frequency power oscillation. The on-site consideration of PSS tuning is mainly focused on phase compensation, ignoring the objective fact that PSS gain is insufficient in different frequency bands. In the research, it has been considered to increase the maximum system damping ratio and the optimal PSS phase compensation as the goal of PSS parameter tuning, which requires adding a model to simulate the load step. Simple simulation is easy to ignore the system characteristics and bring errors, refined modeling makes it difficult to realize the field test problem. Therefore, the PSS parameter tuning is abstracted into the form of mathematical optimization problem in this paper, and the Multi-Objective Lightning Flash Algorithm(MOLFA) is used as the solver to solve the PSS parameter tuning problem with an efficient, fast and accurate optimal parameter solving method that can be used for the needs of field tests.

articleTitle: Design of AD Conversion Controlled by Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces the control method of AD conversion with 51 microcontroller by taking ADS7825 as an example. Firstly, the digital output of ADS7825 is tested, then the display of analog voltage is tested, and finally the method of AD conversion sensor analog in practical application is explained, how to make linear correction of data to reduce the error, and the circuit and reference program are given.

articleTitle: Implementation of FPGA-based hardware acceleration system for U-Net networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of network technology in our country, neural network algorithm is widely recognized and applied to image. U-Net is one of them, which can effectively improve the efficiency of FPGA network hardware utilization, and thus enhance the acceleration system. The main principle of the U-Net is to accelerate the speed of convolutional computation by means of circular flow and circular unfolding, and to improve the performance of the network hardware. In order to learn more about it, this paper will discuss the relevant research.

articleTitle: Image analysis of crystallizer flux crystal sequence based on OCR model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Because of the oxidizability of molten steel and the conduction loss of heat in the metallurgical process, it will cause greater interference to the process of metal smelting. The performance of mold flux directly affects the casting speed and the quality of continuous casting production. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the dynamic characteristics of the melting and crystallization process of mold flux during continuous casting. In this paper, the automatic feature extraction technology of sequential images is studied to solve the problem that the high temperature, transient fluid flow, complex phase change and chemical reaction in the mold and the opacity of the mold wall bring difficulties to the batch direct observation of the crystallization behavior of the mold flux in the metal smelting process. The temperature-time relationship model was obtained based on the OCR model, and the relationship between crystallization agent temperature, melting rate and crystallization rate was obtained by using the nonlinear regression model to fit the characteristic change trend of the image corresponding to the heating time.

articleTitle: Research on Security Sandbox System Based on Computer Big Data Hyperledger Fabric Blockchain Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper designs an "institution-business-system" multi-level security sandbox system from the perspective of cross-department data sharing and combined with Fabric blockchain technology. The system makes full use of the characteristics of blockchain technology, such as decentralization, immutable and consensus mechanism, to achieve collaborative services of secure sandbox facilities. Then this paper proposes a distributed and regulated privacy protection scheme that combines group signature, private address protocol, zero-knowledge proof and attribute encryption. This algorithm improves the group manager mechanism of group signature. The experimental results show that the scheme can ensure the data traceability and realize the supervision of both sides of the transaction, and improve the level of privacy protection of data on the chain.

articleTitle: Design model of maximum output power of wave energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Traditional fuel is increasingly exhausted, and environmental problems are becoming more and more serious. Therefore, the development and utilization of low carbon, energy saving and green. Renewable energy is the theme of energy development in today's era. Wave energy has a high energy density and little energy loss during its propagation. In this paper, the force analysis of wave energy devices under different states is carried out, and the mathematical model is established to maximize the energy conversion efficiency of wave energy devices. The model established in this paper accords with the physical law, and the results obtained are in line with the objective reality. The output power of the wave energy device in one cycle is relatively ideal.

articleTitle: Research on Self-calibration Technology for Online Monitoring of Substation Boundary Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to obtain a long-time and accurate value of substation boundary noise, it is necessary to adopt self-calibration technology in online monitoring. This paper studies the principle of self-calibration technology (electrostatic actuators for determination of microphone’s frequency response). Considering the substation boundary noise characteristics, the actuator is set to operate only with AC voltage. The related principle is analyzed theoretically, and the circuit is designed. The practical application shows that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: Grid Load Forecasting Based on Dual Attention BiGRU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the attention mechanism and BIGRU are integrated into the SEQ2SEQ framework, and a new load forecasting model is proposed. In order to make the decoder predictive value more targeted at different time periods, The first attention mechanism makes the model no longer only output a unique intermediate state. The second self-attention mechanism is used to calculate the sequence internal correlation. The validity of the model is verified by simulation experiments based on real coincident data.

articleTitle: Design on Weak Supervision and Self-learning Spatiotemporal Data Annotation System for Large-scale Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: All kinds of news reports cover a large number of important social events, which are presented to readers in the form of images and texts. By tagging the time, locations, targets and events of texts and images, rich tagging data are generated, which can provide the data basis for analyzing and mining spatiotemporal events. The designed "weak supervision and self-learning spatial data annotation system for large-scale complex scenes" provides two ways for texts and images: weak supervision manual annotation and self-learning automatic batch annotation. The system does not only realize the automatic annotation of batch data, but also supports for manually tagging the data with recommendation. At the same time, it can be applied to teaching and learning, so that students can better understand the principle and process of annotation.

articleTitle: Research on EMC simplified analysis method of coupling communication cable between EMUs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at crosstalk and radiation sensitivity of coupling communication cable of Electric Multiple Unit (EMU), a harness simplified analysis method is proposed, which is based on the equivalent wave impedance of transmission line. According to the relationship between the impedance of common-mode load in cable terminal and the equivalent wave impedance of harness, cables are grouped and simplified. Simulation results show that calculation results of cable electromagnetic interference are basically the same before and after simplification, and simulation time is reduced and calculation resource is saved.

articleTitle: A simulation study of passengers with disabilities of security screening in airport based on AnyLogic
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: this paper is based on the pedestrian library simulation developing platform of AnyLogic, we build the simulation models about passengers with disabilities passing the security screening channel in airports. According to related ratios by using object-oriented simulation technology and a social force model. The big challenge found in the passengers with disabilities security screening process is the lack of space for passengers to organize their luggage, or the airport security staff have not been trained on how to check some special things such as audiphones and so on, all of which leads to a low passing rate per unit time while passengers going through the security channel. The optimization scheme, namely, increasing the space for passengers to organize the luggage or training airport security staff is put forward and then verified by simulation modeling method to significantly improve the efficiency of passengers with disabilities security screening.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization of same-city fresh food delivery path based on improved Hopfield neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and smart logistics, people's consumption patterns are undergoing significant changes, and same-city fresh food delivery has rapidly developed into the mainstream of short-distance delivery in recent years. In order to optimize the delivery path, improve delivery efficiency and enhance consumers' experience, this paper uses neural network algorithms in computer technology, combined with the characteristics of fresh produce, to design a path optimization scheme for same-city fresh produce delivery, in order to promote the development of smart logistics.

articleTitle: Research of Automotive Ethernet Media Dependent Interface (MDI) Designing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of the times and users' demand for intelligent and connected vehicles, traditional in-vehicle networks can no longer meet these needs. More and more people are turning their attention to high-bandwidth, low-cost, and high-scalability automotive Ethernet, and it is particularly important to develop and test automotive Ethernet. This paper studies and analyzes the MDI interface of automotive Ethernet, and explains its composition and working principle. After the part selection analysis, the test verification is carried out, and the results show that the test sample passes the return loss test.

articleTitle: Building a Robot Path Optimization in Prefabricated Buildings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Intelligent robot technology can complete certain work in some construction enterprises. With the arrival of 5G era, its application will be more in-depth and extensive, and it is also a key factor for the sustainable development of the construction industry. In this paper, the hybrid algorithm of genetic ant colony is proposed, which improves the traditional two-dimensional path planning algorithm and three-dimensional path planning algorithm. The experimental test is carried out by using the robot embedding correlation algorithm. The experiment shows that the improved two-dimensional and three-dimensional path planning algorithm has advantages over the traditional algorithm. Moreover, the hybrid ant colony algorithm is obviously superior to the ant colony algorithm, genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm, which verifies the effectiveness of the hybrid algorithm and has certain feasibility in the application of prefabricated building environment.

articleTitle: Commercial load data anomaly detection based on LOWESS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To address the data quality problems of commercial load data, we propose data cleaning algorithm via sliced Locally Weighted Scatterplot Smoothing (LOWESS). The results show that compared with the box plot rule and Seasonal Trend decomposition using Loess (STL), the sliced LOWESS can better match the periodic characteristics of the data and achieve better results on the on office buildings and shopping malls datasets.

articleTitle: Image Classification for Pneumonia and the Normal Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Our model focused on distinguishing pneumonia X-ray images from normal ones. Based on VGGNet16, some layers were reduced in our model; meanwhile, the dropout function and batch normalization were added to avoid the overfitting. Adam was used as the optimizer, and Binary Cross Entropy was used as the loss function. Aiming to evaluate the model, we used different metrics based on the confusion matrix to analyze its performance, including the recall of model, the precision and the F1 score. Our model’s final accuracy reached 86.54%.

articleTitle: UAV Point-point Analysis Based on Analytic Geometric and Iterative Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Uav is the product of the new technology, and the application scope in life is increasing. However, its dependence on the environment is very high, and when the emitted electromagnetic wave signal is disturbed, it will deviate from the original route. In this paper, we study how to realize the pure azimuth and passive positioning of UAV in different situations through target planning, iterative algorithm and analytical geometry.Modify the angle of the offset point based on the three-point position in the space. Set the position of the three points in the space to adjust the position of the other points; to confirm the center point of a circle and the position of the equal points on the circle. From the initial position of the two points, determine the position of the point on the circle after the first round of adjustment, and then the position of the other points is deduced by these positions until the adjustment is completed.

articleTitle: Research on the fatigue detection method of operators in digital main control rooms of nuclear power plants based on multi-feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Timely waking up the operators in the digital main control rooms of nuclear power plants from fatigue can effectively prevent accidents in nuclear power plants. During the operator's work, real -time evaluation of the fatigue state of operators is very important. Because the operators needs to constantly receive and process information from the computer screen through their eyes, it is easy to make their eyes tired and causes mental fatigue to the operators, so we propose to conduct fatigue detection for the operators. By focusing on the state of eyes, combined with the state of mouth and head movement, the efficiency of fatigue detection for operators can be effectively improved. The fatigue detection method was designed to integrate the classification results of three machine learning classification algorithms, logistic regression (LR), random forest (RF), and support vector machine (SVM), by fusing multi- feature such as slow blinks, PERCLOS, yawns, and head movements. Through experimental comparison, this method has higher accuracy compared with the multi-feature fusion method also based on the NTHU-DDD video dataset.

Author Keywords: Operators in the digital main control rooms of nuclear power plants

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Power Electronic Monitoring System of Digital Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The monitoring and protection system of substation based on IEC 61850 is a hot research topic of digital substation. The system integrates the three-dimensional substation model and panoramic monitoring data organically from the perspective of three-dimensional space. In this way, the operation status and equipment monitoring information of smart substation are more intuitive, and the abstract and complex equipment operation information is easy to display. Users can view real-time data and key indicators of distribution network operation on the platform, and conduct statistical analysis to further improve the level of distribution network operation and maintenance management. In this paper, support vector machine (SVM) model is selected as the prediction model according to the characteristics of power network comprehensive information prediction. The monitoring data is decomposed into sub-sequences with different characteristics, and each sub-sequence data is predicted by different SVM models. Finally, the similarity between the data set and the clustering center is calculated, and the most similar data is selected to achieve data extraction. Based on the large amount of structured and unstructured information, this paper forms a multi-dimensional evaluation system. Finally, the prediction accuracy of the power grid fault prediction method based on VMD-SVM is 1.51% through the actual data verification of a regional power grid.

articleTitle: Spatial Electromagnetic Interference Calculation of Arc Discharge in High Voltage Transmission System Based on FDTD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to study the generation mechanism and distribution of spatial electromagnetic interference generated by arc discharge in high-voltage transmission system, a time-domain simulation model of arc discharge transient field is established and the electromagnetic field is simulated based on Finite Difference Time-Domain Method (FDTD). Firstly, the generation mechanism of transient electromagnetic field caused by arc discharge is analyzed, and the characteristics of transient pulse group generated by arc discharge are summarized. Secondly, in view of the advantages of FDTD method in the study of transient problems, the basic principle is briefly analyzed. Combined with the electric dipole method and antenna theory, the electromagnetic field of any single point in space caused by the transient current on the transmission line is analyzed.

articleTitle: Identifying interphase short circuits in the tator of a multi-phase generator using coils
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The interphase short circuits is a very destructive fault. The strong short-circuit current generated by this fault causes the winding to overheat burn but also generates destructive electromagnetic forces under the action of the generator’s magnetic field and causes irrecoverable damage to the rotor [1]. In this paper, the detection coil is buried in advance in a multi-phase generator. Identification of interphase short circuits faults by obtaining harmonic characteristics from the magnetomotive force generating in fault.

articleTitle: State Estimation of Distribution Network Equipment Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the economy and the acceleration of urbanization, people's material living standards have been continuously improved, the scale of the distribution network has become larger and larger, and users' requirements for the reliability of power supply have become more and more stringent. The contradiction between the traditional maintenance mode and the reliability of power supply and the shortage of inspection personnel has become increasingly prominent. This paper proposes a condition-based maintenance evaluation system for distribution network equipment based on genetic algorithm. Firstly, the system structure of condition maintenance of distribution network equipment is designed, then the strategy of equipment maintenance based on genetic algorithm is proposed, and finally the evaluation system of condition maintenance of distribution network is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Chip Level Inspection and Maintenance System of Electronic Products under Computer Digitization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a fixed fault model is established, and a digital chip tester is designed with HT46RU24 as the core. The FPGA+SDRAM high performance hardware processing platform is built according to the high efficiency of FPGA parallel processing. Using Quartus II software and Verilog HDL hardware description language to write a program to detect the edge of chip pins. In this paper, a chip detection algorithm based on generalized Hough transform is proposed to reduce the computational complexity. The main idea of this algorithm is to combine multi-scale analysis with generalized Hough transform. The algorithm is applied to the chip detection of automatic optical detection system. Then the system controls and tests the operation of the hardware through the test code and compares the test results with the exact values. The simulation results show that the system can automatically give the result of right or wrong judgment.

articleTitle: Research on Ventilation and Noise Reduction Technology of High-power Fast Charging Pile
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: For the power devices in the charging pile, taking effective cooling measures can promote the normal performance of the machine. At present, the main way of heat dissipation of the charging pile is forced air cooling. The forced air cooling fan uses the fan to dissipate heat, and uses the external forced power provided by the fan to make the air flow and take away the heat generated by the system. However, during the heat dissipation process of the fan, large noise pollution will be generated due to factors such as fan blade rotation. This paper analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of four methods to reduce the heat dissipation noise of the charging pile: installing fan muffler,) optimizing the number of fans and cooling ducts, optimizing the power module loss based on SiC devices, and new metal solid liquid phase change heat dissipation methods. Taking a charging station as an example, the design measures for ventilation and noise reduction are proposed, which can effectively meet the environmental requirements.

articleTitle: Research on People Counting Methods of Subway Cars Based on Improved Random Hough Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to count the number of subway cars, guiding passengers to choose the waiting car reasonably and improve the comfort of the car, a real-time number of subway cars based on improved random Hough transform (RHT) is proposed. This method collects the video image of the car after the subway starts. After the background difference and binarization, the canny operator is used to realize the edge detection and contour extraction. According to the characteristics of the human head like circle and its contour on the same curve edge, the improved RHT algorithm is used to detect the circle, and the circles with a radius of 8.0-10.0CM are selected for marking and counting. Experimental results show that this method can solve a large number of invalid accumulations caused by random sampling in traditional RHT algorithm and improve the detection speed.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent storage monitoring of power grid based on YOLOv5 converged attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the promulgation of Made in China 2025, as an important support for the realization of industrial informatization, smart warehousing has become the focus of current enterprises and scholars. In this paper, aiming at the real-time monitoring of large cargoes in the grid storage scenario, based on the target detection network YOLOv5, combined with the ECA channel attention mechanism and SIoU loss function, a real-time and efficient cargo detection method based on YOLOv5 fusion attention is proposed for the grid operation site. In order to alleviate the imbalance between positive and negative samples, make full use of the information of difficult samples and improve the detection effect of difficult samples, Focal loss function is introduced. At the same time, on the basis of the original SPP multi-scale fusion, the improved YOLOv7 multi-scale detection method was fused. In view of the lack of power cargoes data sets at home and abroad, we have built a small but high-quality power cargo datasets. The experiment shows that the method in this paper has significantly improved in accuracy, speed, accuracy and generalization ability, and can achieve effective detection in complex operation scenarios, which can provide technical reference for the safety of power grid operators and reduce the intensity of human monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Ore Processing Quality Prediction Based on XGBoost ESN Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Ore processing is an extremely complex process, in which temperature, raw ore parameters, processing flow, etc. will indirectly affect the quality of ore products. It will be of great significance to optimize the process rules in development. This paper mainly aims at the above problems, constructs the relevant models, uses factor analysis, boosting, and other knowledge, as well as Matlab, Python and other software programming to obtain the final optimized model and solve the relevant problems. Under the given raw ore parameters and system temperature, the product indexes are solved. At first, the four indexes (ABCD) of ore are horizontally compared by factor analysis; Secondly, integrate the data of the first ten days of the prediction as a training set, bring it into the XGBoost model for training, and constantly adjust the parameters; Finally, the temperature of the test set is brought in and the maximum possible solution of the index is obtained. Under the given raw ore parameters and target product quality, the maximum possible set temperature of the system is solved. Then the ESN echo state network model is added for synchronous prediction, and the minimum dichotomy method is used to combine the two models to form an XGBoost ESN optimization model. Finally, the model is brought into the test set to predict the system temperature.

articleTitle: Operation optimization of power and natural gas integrated energy system based on multi-objective optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the operation capability of the integrated energy system, an operation Evaluation of the integrated power and natural gas system based on multi-objective optimization is proposed. An electrical-pneumatic coupling system is established, and the operating characteristics and composition of the system are described. A model is established for the operation optimization of a comprehensive system including natural gas, considering the impact of cost and emissions, and modeling and analysis from the perspective of power system constraints, natural gas system constraints, and coupling system constraints. The solution is carried out using the multi-objective particle swarm method. Simulation analysis shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Study of Gibbs Sampling Selection Based on Information Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Feature selection is a key research direction in the current big data era, which can effectively reduce the dimension of data, simplify the time of model training and improve the prediction effect, attracting the attention of researchers in the field of statistics and informatics. In recent years, with the expansion of the application scope and field, the research on the feature selection method gradually approaches to the comprehensive index of time and efficiency. This paper applies the idea of Gibbs sampling based on the random search strategy, and improves the feature selection method based on the Gibbs sampling algorithm, analyzes the frequency of each feature as the important degree value of the corresponding feature, and selects a suitable threshold value to realize the feature selection according to the size of the important degree value.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for GNSS Timing Interference Analysis Based on Multi-Feature Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: GNSS timing is one of the main means to obtain accurate time and maintain precise time synchronization. However, GNSS signals are vulnerable to malicious human interference. In this paper, an algorithm for GNSS timing interference analysis based on multi-feature integration is proposed. By constructing a quality degradation model of the timing system, and comprehensively analyzing the multi-dimensional features of the timing system, such as timing deviation, timing offset rate, and timing offset acceleration, the algorithm can detect in real time whether the timing system is interfered, and moreover whether affected by GNSS timing suppressing interference or spoofing interference. Simulation experiments show that the algorithm can effectively detect GNSS timing interference and issue early warnings, which can provide support for the research and implementation of timing anti-interference technology in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Man-machine System Safety Auxiliary System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper studies lane keeping control system based on man-machine co-driving technology. Firstly, this paper proposes a lane keeping auxiliary system based on man-machine cooperative control. In this system, a two-degree-of-freedom vehicle dynamics model is established. The system obtains the optimal front wheel Angle through the optimal linear quadratic control algorithm. The system introduces the co-driving coefficient to allocate the control of the vehicle. In order to reduce the conflict between the auxiliary control system and the driver, the vehicle state error and the driver's steering moment are taken as the input variables of fuzzy control and the co-driving coefficient is taken as the output variables. Then the vehicle deviation safety assessment model torque control and safety exit strategy are presented. The system realizes man-machine friendly interaction and cooperative driving. Finally, this paper conducts joint functional simulation and verification tests on the system, and the results show that all functional requirements are realized and the test coverage reaches 100%.

articleTitle: Design of an Access Control System for Unmanned Bathroom Based on Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and intelligence of the access control management system, this paper uses image processing technology to identify the ID card number, and uses the gender results after identification as the basis for identifying the switch of the male and female bathroom access control system, and compares the membership information in the database with the chip information in the second-generation ID card and the image recognition information to verify the authenticity of the ID card. Therefore, an intelligent bathroom access control system based on image processing technology is developed. The system is mainly composed of image acquisition and reading module, image processing module, magnetic card induction module, signal processing module and signal execution module. The image processing module is based on image processing technology, and uses the powerful mathematical processing ability of MATLAB to complete a series of image processing processes such as eigenvalue data extraction. Identify whether it is a registered member by comparing with the data in the database. The signal processing module is based on server processing technology to realize unmanned automatic door opening.

articleTitle: Matching Analysis of Four-Wheel Drive Pure Electric Power System Based on Adhesion Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the research of the adhesion between the vehicle and the road, the vehicle makes full use of the ground adhesion to improve the vehicle dynamic performance as the research goal, and carries out the power system selection analysis of the front and rear dual motors, and obtains the peak power, torque, speed and The distribution interval of the main reduction ratio is to find the optimal distribution interval of power. The vehicle simulation model is established and the simulation test is carried out. The results show that the motor parameters based on the theoretical calculation and the feasible area of the main reduction ratio can meet the design requirements, and the optimized area of the motor power distribution can take into account the front and rear axle road surfaces during acceleration and climbing. The utilization rate of the adhesion coefficient can fully improve the dynamic performance of the whole vehicle and improve the stability of the acceleration and climbing process.

articleTitle: A Review of Point Cloud Registration Methods Based on Laser SLAM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Point cloud registration is one of the key technologies for Simultaneous Localization and Mapping of LiDAR. In the SLAM process, the LiDAR pose change leads to different poses of the point cloud data, resulting in motion distortion, and the multi-frame data point cloud is accurately registered to the same coordinate system through point cloud registration to form a completed point cloud. In this paper, the principle analysis of two different point cloud registration methods, Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm and Normal Distributions Transform (NDT) algorithm, summarizes and analyzes the corresponding improved algorithms and development status, and simulates the two algorithms in MATLAB. The results show that the accuracy and robustness of the NDT algorithm are higher than those of the ICP algorithm.

articleTitle: The application of embedded microcontroller in motor control system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The traditional motor control system has some shortcomings and cannot meet the needs of industrial production, while the application of embedded microcontroller chip can improve and upgrade the motor control system. dsPIC20F embedded microcontroller is a driver-type chip with high frequency and mature technology, which can be applied to the motor control system to improve its system functions and enhance the system control effect. In contrast, this paper takes dsPIC20F embedded microcontroller as an example and analyzes the application of embedded microcontroller in motor control system.

articleTitle: Blockchain Security Risk Monitoring of Power Supply Chain Based on Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development and progress of information technology, the information system has had a huge impact on people's daily work and life, and has become an irreplaceable factor in our work and life. With the increasing number of applications of information technology, the information industry revolution is sweeping the world. Almost all industries, including the power industry, have begun to pay attention to the construction and innovation of information systems, and building a "modern supply chain" has become China's new economic development direction. The main purpose of this paper is to conduct research on the security risk monitoring of power supply chain (PSC) blockchain based on fuzzy neural network (FNN). This paper takes the theory of supply chain and the application of information system in an electric power enterprise as the starting point, and analyzes and studies the application of information system in the supply chain of an electric power enterprise. Using the concepts and theories of information system and SCM, the application of the information system of a power enterprise in its supply chain is analyzed and studied in detail. Experiments show that in the matching process, smart contracts play an important role according to different situations. Once the energy matching is successful, both parties will complete the energy transaction according to the content of the smart contract, and the entire EBN-IESCOM can be solved using blockchain technologies such as consensus algorithms and smart contracts..

articleTitle: Research on Sports Video Image Teaching System Based on Computer 3D Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The use of 3D technology to simulate the movement of objects, so that objects in the real environment changes. The system consists of three modules: three-dimensional simulation database, virtual simulation model of motion capture and motion technology simulation. The motion process of the backspin ball, the front spin ball and the non-spin ball is simulated numerically, and the motion law of the ball's drop point and drop point is obtained. According to different situations of players, the appropriate shooting posture is proposed. At the same time, the system uses video technology to make students familiar with NBA players, basketball tactical points, audio and other materials into a tactical demonstration of animation. The paper can effectively improve the teaching effect of basketball skill and attack training and achieve the purpose of training. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can solve the problem of turning in basketball well.

articleTitle: Intelligent energy-saving parking system design based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To improve the efficiency and management of electricity consumption in indoor parking lots, an intelligent energy-saving parking lot based on deep learning is designed. Compared with traditional parking lots, this parking lot combined with deep learning algorithm can effectively solve the phenomenon of no one lights on and no car lights on. It adopts diverse data collection and optimized energy-saving control strategies to meet lighting needs while saving power resources and management costs, reducing human resource expenses, and significantly improving energy utilization. The system is lowcost, easy to debug and install and use, and has broad application prospects and market promotion value.

articleTitle: Research on the maximum output power of wave energy based on micro-amplitude wave theory and potential flow theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of economy and society, human demand for energy is increasing, and at the same time, the conflict between energy demand and environmental pollution is becoming more and more acute. The wave energy device, through a PTO system consisting of a spring and a damper, makes the float and the oscillator move relative to each other under the action of waves, which drives the damper to do work and output energy. In this paper, a floating body motion model based on the micro-amplitude wave theory and three-dimensional potential flow theory is established for the relative motion of float and oscillator in the wave energy device, and a single-objective optimization model is solved by using the traversal method, finite element analysis and Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Design of X-band all Metal Transmit Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a design scheme of X-band all-metal transmission array antenna is proposed. The core structure of the antenna basic unit is two symmetrical U-shaped grooves on the metal plate, the length of which is used to control the phase transition of the structural unit. Simulation calculations show that the transmission array antenna has good performance, the maximum gain at 9GHz is 26 dBi, the aperture efficiency reaches 46.5%, the 3dB bandwidth is 8.1GHz~10GHz, and the relative bandwidth is 20.9%.

articleTitle: Optimal Meter Configuration Based on Harmonic State Estimation Model and Binary Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The monitoring and estimation of harmonic is of great significance to maintain the stable operation of distribution networks. In order to determine the harmonic state level in network and reduce the investment and difficulty of installation, it is necessary to carry out research on the optimization of meter configuration. Therefore, this paper proposes a method of optimal meter configuration combining harmonic state estimation model and binary particle swarm optimization, which aims at estimating all harmonic state variables in the network while using fewer meters. Harmonic state estimation is the process of estimating the harmonic voltage and current state with limited data collected by meters according to the harmonic state estimation model. The rules of state estimation model are established based on the topology connection in network and Kirchhoff's law. IEEE-18 bus network is employed to apply the state estimation model and the result of optimization algorithm shows that only six meters are required to measure and estimate all the harmonic state variables. Finally, the real harmonic values of this network are obtained from Simulink/MATLAB to compare with the estimation values, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Nature-inspired Path Planning for Robot Swarms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the development of robotics technique, a raising number of scenarios call for coordination of large robotic swarms. One key problem for robotic swarms is distribution motion planning. This paper introduces some popular creature-inspired approaches for path optimization, which include Ant Colony System, Firefly algorithm, and Artificial Bee Colony. Their principle and methodology will be introduced specifically. Also, the author lists the final performance of these algorithms and has a systematic evaluation, and finally draws the conclusion that the ACO could find a nearly optimized but not rigorously optimized solution, ABC do the best work in minimizing the path length, and FA is the most practical algorithm in reality.

articleTitle: Network Information Resource Allocation under Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Established in the current era of rapid development of information technology, there are many shortcomings in the traditional Internet optimization methods for the allocation of information resources, such as low efficiency, long allocation time, and low demand satisfaction in the optimization process. However, under the current big data model, how to allocate the Internet information in a balanced way is one of the main problems to be faced at present. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a Nash equilibrium solution based on the network big data information resource allocation method. First, we describe the network phenomenon by establishing a non-cooperative game information resource allocation model, and prove the existence and uniqueness of the Nash equilibrium solution by solving the game model, and at the same time, we create a new big data information resource allocation method based on the Nash equilibrium solution The experimental results of the efficiency of the proposed information resource allocation method and the traditional information resource allocation method are compared, and the results show that the proposed information resource allocation method has the advantages of high efficiency and high utilization rate of network resources compared with the traditional method in terms of resource allocation efficiency, which can realize the rational use of network information resources with greater efficiency and The allocation of information resources can be reasonably optimized.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Saving System of Energy Controller Based on Ubiquitous Access of Electric Internet of Things Terminal to Low-Voltage Boutique Platform Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a holographic sensing technique for low voltage platform area is proposed. The system makes full use of the existing intelligent terminal upgrading, station division branch line installation monitoring module, intelligent fusion terminal and other devices to achieve the platform area holographic perception of side power failure, branch box power failure monitoring, table box power failure monitoring, indoor and outdoor power failure. At the same time, the system has realized the functions of stage line loss monitoring, phase recognition, household classification load recognition and so on. The system uses the existing power communication private network to realize the data return of operational level cloud end integration of energy and power iota solution, and realizes the integration of power communication private network and LPWAN Internet of Things technology. The protocol, with the assistance of licensed channels, determines the license-free channels available to D2D terminals and the slot resources available to corresponding channels. An optimization problem aiming to minimize the total power consumption of the system is established, considering the limitation of data rate and interference to the base station (BS) generated by D2D users. The numerical results show that the optimal allocation results can be obtained by using this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on HDR Display Halo Evaluation Algorithm Based on Image Local Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Two-dimensional Mini-LED local dimming can achieve high dynamic range (HDR) and better black state, greatly improving the display image quality. This paper analyzes the influence of the halo characteristics of Mini-LED backlight with different local dimming partitions on the display image, establishes a local dimming simulation algorithm model, and applies the evaluation function to the target image to find the local area where HVS (human vision system) is more likely to detect the halo artifact. These local areas were analyzed and numerical simulation and human eye perception limit were carried out to suppress the halo to a degree that is difficult to distinguish. The experimental results show that this halo evaluation algorithm can find the area with serious halo artifacts well, and has important theoretical guidance basis and application prospect for the design of Mini-LED backlight partition.

articleTitle: Research on Data Synchronization Consistency Comparison System Based on Computer Heterogeneous Database
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of heterogeneous data consistency verification, this paper proposes a verification method based on XML tools. The system determines the elements to be transformed in CIM/RDF through SAX parsing, and designs a deep search algorithm to get the mapping rule base of the classes and attributes to be transformed. Then we propose a hash retrieval algorithm based on CCA (canonical correlation Analysis) semantic consistency (CCA-SCH). In order to maintain the semantic consistency within the mode, the algorithm generates semantic models of text and image data respectively. By comparing the output results of multiple heterogeneous function executors, the abnormal detection of function executors was carried out. The system implements active defense of the routing system. The results in this paper provide a model mapping basis for heterogeneous model interaction and help to realize the identification and interaction of heterogeneous model on the information exchange bus.

articleTitle: Temperature Field Simulation of Partial Discharge in Oil-Paper Capacitor Bushing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: capacitor bushing is an important component of oil-immersed transformer. In this paper, the temperature rise of capacitor bushing with partial discharge defect is calculated with finite element method. The joule heat losses in different load conditions are analyzed using a 3D eddy current field model of a 126kV/630A capacitor bushing. The partial discharge energy is also calculated. A two-dimensional finite element thermal model was used to calculate the temperature rise of the bushing, taking into account Joule heat and partial discharge losses. The results of this analysis are of referential value for the safe operation of capacitor bushings.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Home System Based on Computer Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper mainly based on the concept of smart home system and the Internet of Things technology, smart home system technical requirements based on the Internet of things technology smart home system design and smart home system application realization. The hardware aspect of the system is mainly designed intelligent gateway. In this paper, one core board and two expansion boards are superimposed. In the aspect of system software, the grammar library of language input form is established. Then the line syntax is selected to divide different data structures and redefine independent semantic blocks. Finally, this paper introduces the composition and specific functional modules of the intelligent home application platform. The system takes LED application development as an example to verify that RESTful architecture platform has natural advantages in unified interface abstraction, security and user rights management, network transmission efficiency and other indicators.

articleTitle: Network Log Big Data Analysis Processing Based on Hadoop Cluster
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Analysis of large website log big data, can effectively get the user access website various related report data, such as website click rate, each country IP address, extract and splicing log key fields, etc., by refining valuable data information, realize the website intrusion detection and operation status monitoring, and can effectively provide basis for further development of user recommendation system.

articleTitle: A Real-time Logistics Scheduling Method of Digital Twin Workshop
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aiming at the low scheduling efficiency of discrete shop logistics, this paper starts from the current development of discrete shop logistics, digital twin shop architecture and shop logistics workflow. The architecture of discrete shop driven by digital twin is studied, the digital twin model of discrete shop is built, and the real-time scheduling optimization model of shop logistics is designed.

articleTitle: Study on motion characteristics and power of wave energy device based on Runge-Kutta algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Sea waves are a vast and largely unexplored new energy resource from which resources can be extracted for the survival and development of human society. However, research in this area is relatively immature compared to other renewable energy technologies, and obtaining the laws of motion of wave harvesting devices can be of great help in the construction and energy conversion efficiency of wave harvesting devices. In this paper, for an oscillating float type wave harvesting device, we first model the sea surface and the float when the float and oscillator are only in a pendulous oscillating motion, cleverly equating the combined forces of gravity and buoyancy to spring and the wave resistance to damping. The oscillator is connected to the float by a power take-off (PTO) device, the connection of which can also be considered as spring and damping. We set out the non-linear equations of motion for the float and oscillator. Then, when the float and oscillator are simultaneously pendularly oscillating and longitudinally rocking, we set out the non-linear equations of motion for the oscillator and float by establishing the equations of motion for the dynamic system and introducing the implied and coriolis acceleration. Finally, we solve the non-linear equations of motion using the fourth to fifth order Runge-Kutta algorithm and the results show that the laws of motion are periodic and simple harmonic.

Author Keywords: wave power Nonlinear equations of motion

articleTitle: Research of Irrigation Optimal Control for Green Island Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: the paper takes the irrigation for green island plants as the main research direction, control system and HMI platform can be designed for the irrigation based on two kinds of phytocommunities, the scientific irrigation algorithm can be established and the irrigation effect can be optimized. The accurate irrigation can be achieved by automatic control function which can change the irrigation program according to the different working situation, so as to improve the irrigation effect, save the labor force and protect the resource. Meanwhile the growth data of green island plants can be displayed and observed in real time by the system, of which the irrigation mode can be chosen flexibly by manual control function, the alarm of water shortage can be set up and the convenience and flexibility of usage can be improved finally.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy storage operation and configuration models for high ratio wind power systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The random and intermittent nature of wind power output has an increasingly prominent impact on grid planning and operation. For example, there is a power balance problem between wind turbines, thermal units and load, in which case there is a loss of load phenomenon, i.e. the total power generation is less than the load power, and a wind abandonment phenomenon, i.e. the power generation is greater than the load power and some wind energy is wasted. Peaking and energy storage are important tools to solve the system power balance problem. This paper has discussed the situation of regulating the power of thermal power units according to the load power and wind power output power without configuring energy storage system, and develop a 96-point curve of daily power generation plan.

articleTitle: The routing requirement analysis and scheme design of air communication AD hoc network in demonstration and training ground
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At the present stage, the exercise and training communication support mainly relies on the existing fixed network composed of base stations, optical cable backbone network and other infrastructure. The technology is reliable and the application is mature. However, this kind of exercise and training communication support mode also constrains the exercise and training of real troops to the fixed site facilities, which is difficult to adapt to the trend of the development to the all-field combat training. Therefore, it is urgent to carry out air communication AD hoc network research to provide communication support for exercise and training. Focusing on the requirements of the AD hoc network of air communication in the performance and training ground, this paper analyzes the typical application scenarios of the communication AD hoc network, summarizes and compares the traditional routing protocols and the two classical routing protocols of OLSR and AODV respectively, and selects the routing scheme suitable for the AD hoc network of air communication in the performance and training ground.

articleTitle: Intelligent Garbage Sorting Assistant Based on Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of society, people have higher and higher requirements for environmental sanitation. Therefore, vigorously promoting the construction of the ecological civilization circle is an important part of improving the living environment and constantly improving the quality of the city. At the same time, with the distribution of domestic waste sorting activities in the whole country, waste sorting has become a hot topic and work today. Aiming at the problem of garbage classification, this paper designs an intelligent garbage classification assistant based on mobile internet. In the implementation process, the classification network model is trained using deep learning method and deployed to the server. Finally, based on Android platform, using Java, XML and other languages, combined with MySQL and other technologies, the functions of garbage identification and classification are realized, which has certain practical significance.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of SCM Network Based on a New Symmetry Array with Five Feed Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Under unmanned, highly dynamic and low elevation conditions, SCM network based on a new symmetry array with five feed sources is an effective method to adapt with new requirements. Based on analysis of its application background, system design, feed array design and SCM network design, the realization approach is clarified with theory analysis and comparing with conventional methods.

articleTitle: Blind Lane Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of technology and society, there is a growing demand for Blindness aid devices. Detection algorithms for blind lanes are very important. In this paper, the network structure of YOLOv5s is used to greatly improve the recognition rate, and the CA is introduced to improve the network performance by considering both inter-channel relationships and long-distance location information without increasing the computational overhead. Changing PAN to BiFPN in the hope of achieving multi-scale feature fusion easily and quickly. In addition, considering that most of the Blindness aid devices are embedded, this paper also make lightweight improvements to the network replacing the traditional convolutional module with Ghost Module, which is intended to generate feature maps with less cost. Based on these improvements this paper improved the recognition rate of the network on the dataset to 98.3%, reduced model size by 26% and reduced FLOPS by 22% The FPS value reached 235Hz.

articleTitle: Research on the application of service choreography in the intelligent customer service system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The background of this paper is to study the situation that the intelligent customer service system needs different response processes in different scenarios, including the high cost of developing and managing these processes. This paper applies the process engine framework Zeebe, which configures the sequence of various question-and-answer processes and other automatically triggered external processes through flexible scheduling. This application enables the system to respond flexibly to business process changes and achieve rapid and agile responses to new requirements. This system can be customized for different scenarios. The advantages of this system are that it reduces development costs and improves system scalability.

articleTitle: Improved Topologies Towards Existing Types of Single Phase Rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Single phase rectifiers are electrical component that is widely used in different applications. Rectifiers are essential since it determines the amount of power transmission from the main power supplies to the individual part that uses DC power, like light bulbs. However, conventional rectifiers do contain some drawbacks that can cause deficiency problems. Therefore, this article summarizes some innovative circuits based on buck-boost and zeta topology, with modifications to existing designs or some additional electrical device, which can improve the performance of the circuit. From repeated experiments, it is found that these proposed circuits boost the performance and solve some problems compared with the conventional single phase rectifiers, like low efficiency and power factor problems. By fixing these common problems, rectifiers can save much wasted energy consumption and keep the best performance at the same time. These improved rectifiers can be more applicable and beneficial in the upcoming future.

articleTitle: Method of Clothing Image Retrieval Based on Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Brand clothing image retrieval has important application value in life. In view of the lack of accuracy of ordinary image retrieval methods, this paper proposes to fuse the deep and shallow features of convolutional neural network VGG16 model based on the feature fusion strategy. At the same time, it fuses the color features extracted separately by histogram, and measures the similarity to achieve brand clothing image retrieval. Comparative experiments show that the improved image retrieval method improves the retrieval accuracy to 84.63%, with about 2 percentage points higher than the original VGG16 model on the clothing image data set, and has certain application value.

articleTitle: A Method of Radar HRRP Aircraft Type Identification and Rejection Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Aircraft type recognition refers to the identification of aircraft type by analyzing the characteristics of target echo data obtained from radar scanning. Aircraft type rejection refers to a judgment on the acquired high-resolution range profile data to determine whether the data belongs to the current model to be classified. In order to effectively use multiple feature fusion to improve the recognition performance, this paper proposes a model of aircraft type recognition and rejection based on LSTM. This model analyzes the HRRP features of aircraft through LSTM network, and classifies targets by full connection layer network. From the point of view of confidence of classification results, a method of aircraft type rejection based on softmax is proposed.

articleTitle: A 5G-Based Big Data Security Access Processing Method and Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the opportunity of the digital transformation of the vertical industry represented by the power grid in the 5G era, in order to meet the communication needs of all kinds of new services in the power grid application scene, in order to adapt to the comprehensive perception and intelligent interconnection development of the future power grid under the new situation, the intelligence of the power Internet of things supporting Yunbian collaboration needs to be improved urgently. Under the 5G architecture, how to effectively protect the business data of communication terminals has become the focus of relevant developers in the security industry. In order to solve the problem of illegal intrusion of equipment and secure data transmission, a big data security access processing device based on 5G is designed in this paper. In this device, the access terminal authentication module authenticates the user identity information through audio and video, two-dimensional code and other technologies; the data trust verification module confirms the data security through whitelist, data scanning and other methods; the data software and hardware encryption module encrypts the data through encryption chip and IPSEC protocol and other technologies. Combining these technologies, the secure transmission of network data is realized. In addition, by testing the throughput of the encryption algorithm, it is found that the smaller the key value of the encryption algorithm, the greater the throughput.

articleTitle: A novel method for micro-nano channel alignment with automatic features based on reconstructed Hough transform theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A novel method for micro-nano channel alignment with automatic features is presented. Hough transform theory at the micro-nano scale is reconstructed to investigate the effect of Hough parameters including Hough angle and Threshold on alignment accuracy. The results demonstrate that for a given angle of 100, the number of lines and intersection points is increased by decreasing the value of the Threshold. When angle and Threshold are 100 and 125 respectively, the number of lines and intersection points are 5 and 4, meanwhile, the range of angle is 89-90. Furthermore, the recognition time of the micro-nano channel is 0.18s.
