Compared to some conventional alignment methods of the chip, this paper’s method based on the Hough transform theory avoids the error and time-consuming process.

articleTitle: Research on Sports Live Broadcast System under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the computer big data technology, this paper designs a system to realize the unattended live broadcast through the steps of video stitching, hot spot area determination, hot spot area tracking and so on. Then this paper designs the software and hardware environment of the system and determines the final implementation scheme and parameters through experiments. Secondly, this paper studies various related technologies involved in video stitching. In this paper, the concept of hot spot region is proposed and the detection algorithm of hot spot region is designed. The video splicing function is designed based on SURF feature point detection technology. After video fusion processing, the video Mosaic subsystem is finally realized. Finally, this paper designs the function and implementation of the video live relay subsystem. The simulation results show that this method can smoothly track the hot spots and extract them to realize real-time retransmission.

articleTitle: Research on Simple Power Consumption Based on AES Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper simply analyzes the basic principle of the AES algorithm, designs a simple attack method, and implements the SPA attack energy consumption analysis of the RSA algorithm. From the experimental analysis waveform, we can see that the SPA attack is unidirectional and irreversible. At the same time, this attack method is more commonly used, and is suitable for verifying the encryption stability of the key.

articleTitle: Analysis of Deicing Jump Characteristics of Double Circuit Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The conductor of double circuit overhead transmission lines mostly adopt vertical alignment. The conductor and earthwire will jump during deicing, which will reduce the air gap and cause line outages. This paper analyzes the deicing jump characteristics of 500kV EHV lines and 1000kV UHV double circuit overhead transmission lines in 10mm and 15mm ice areas. The analysis shows that the electrical distance of conductor and earthwire required by uneven icing and deicing jump has less influence on tower size in light ice area. The double circuit tower of 1000kV could be designed without horizontal offset in 10mm and 15mm ice areas.

articleTitle: Network Monitoring and Security Protection Design of Wind Farm Centralized Control Center
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, it is an urgent need for the rapid development of China's current wind power industry to transform and improve the operation and management level of large-scale wind farm (WF) with information technology. In order to upload the monitoring data of the WF to the centralized monitoring center safely and reliably, a network with a high safety factor needs to be built, and the center should be able to adjust the operation of the equipment to achieve the best state. In this regard, this paper establishes a network monitoring system for the centralized control center of the WF, which encrypts the collected information during the data collection process, and realizes the security protection of the monitoring data transmission. This paper tests the concurrent performance of the system, and the test results show that the system designed in this paper meets the needs of users. The system in this paper can not only improve the management level of wind power enterprises to optimize the personnel structure and improve the efficiency of WFs, but also realize centralized monitoring and management of equipment in each WF.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Time Domain Broadening of Laser Propagation in Seawater
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Starting from the scattering of laser pulse by suspended solids and various impurities in seawater, this paper analyzes the time-domain broadening of seawater laser pulse from the aspects of transmission distance, wavelength and initial pulse, uses the small angle approximation method, analyzes the time-domain waveform model of laser pulse through Henyey Greenstein scattering phase function, and obtains that the longer wavelength should be selected as far as possible in the selection of communication wavelength; The conclusion is to improve the tracking accuracy of free space optical communication system, reduce the tracking error and control the beam tracking error within 15μrad.

articleTitle: Research on application of 3D modeling in oil and gas field development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: 3D reservoir geological modeling is an advanced reservoir description method that runs through oil and gas field exploration and development. The three-dimensional model characterizes the reservoir's geometric shape and heterogeneous reservoir property and plays an increasingly important role in determining the reservoir distribution, internal configuration, and reservoir quality. Geostatistics is an essential tool for reservoir description and modeling. A precise and accurate 3D reservoir model is significant for oil and gas exploration and development. After years of development, reservoir geological modeling technology has changed from direct conversion of geological data to two-point geostatistics driven by variogram to multipoint geostatistics. The three-dimensional geological model can indicate the spatial distribution direction and development of sand bodies; Guided by the stochastic modeling theory and variogram model theory, the 3D geological model establishes the physical property model of the reservoir under the control of the facies control model. This method can provide essential geological data for numerical simulation research, guide the distribution of remaining oil, and formulate development plans.

articleTitle: Production model based on the combined prediction of time series and XGBoost neural networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper discusses the production problem of multi-variety materials. With the continuous development of economic globalization, the production and operation mode of many varieties of small batch materials has been loved by the company, and the market demand for materials determines the quantity of our production materials. In the code of small-batch materials in the given sample, we first use Python data to analyze the trend level of the material, establish the entropy right Topsis model to objectively score the material, and screen out the six materials that should be paid attention to in the materials that meet the requirements. Secondly, with the week as the time unit, the time series and XGBoost neural network are used to establish a weekly prediction model to predict the six material demand, and the reciprocal mean square error method is used to combine the two models to ensure the accuracy of the model and improve the credibility of the model, to build the combined prediction model.

articleTitle: Research on trajectory tracking control algorithm in 4WS mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In indoor shooting training, most of targets are fixed targets or tracked target vehicles that move on a fixed track,while in actual combat, most of targets are moving targets with uncertain orientation.This paper designs a four-rudder wheel moving target vehicles chassis and proposes chassis kinematics model in view of the omnidirectional moving targets,and achieves four-rudder wheel chassis trajectory tracking control model by using model predictive control algorithm,and deduces the mobile chassis trajectory tracking control algorithm according to the technical performance indicators and constraints of the vehicle motion,and proves that applying the model predictive control algorithm to the four- rudder wheel chassis to realize trajectory tracking has feasibility in the locomotion mode of 4WS according to the simulation experimental results,and conducts trajectory tracking comparative simulation experiments by selecting different prediction time domain,control time domain and sampling time.The experimental results shows that the model predictive controller with less sampling time and lower control time domain has better effect on target path tracking.

articleTitle: Study on the maximum output power of wave energy under vertical oscillation and longitudinal rocking motion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The wave energy device, which is composed of float, oscillator, central shaft and energy output system, can make better use of wave energy, a renewable resource in the ocean, and has considerable development prospects under the dual challenges of energy demand and environmental pollution. This paper investigates the influence of the maximum output power of wave energy on the scale utilization of wave energy, which is of great significance to the development of renewable energy industry. In this paper, the maximum output power of wave energy is solved by considering only the case of floating body doing pendulum motion and adding the analysis of longitudinal rocking motion on the basis of doing pendulum motion in two cases, establishing nonlinear differential equation model and objective planning model, etc. The fourth-order Longe-Kuta and adaptive particle swarm algorithms are mainly used.

articleTitle: Base station planning problem based on genetic algorithm and K-Means clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Network planning, particularly site selection, is becoming more and more crucial as 5G and other communication technologies advance and make communication networks more complicated. Choose a certain number of sites to establish a new base station based on the current network's coverage area in order to address the issue of the network's patchy coverage. In order to solve the single objective optimization model and increase the service completion rate to 90%, genetic algorithms are used in this research. The evolutionary algorithm is still employed to solve the multi-objective programming issue and determine the base station's optimum cost in the presence of growing restrictions. The areas were clustered using the k means approach, and the time complexity was calculated.

articleTitle: Structure Design of Self-service Data Governance about Sea-based Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Definition of Data Governance (DG) is introduced first. And the difference between data management and DG is presented for analysis. Also the parts of DG are elaborated. Then sea-based DG system and auto self-service structure are designed. Finally, the key technology and typical DG application scenarios are introduced about auto self-service platform.

articleTitle: Research on Location Decision Optimization of Communication Station Based on Simulated Annealing Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the fast expansion of communication technology, the location of base stations becomes more and more complex. In this paper, aiming at the existing problems of base station location, the address and type of base station are planned scientifically and the regional clustering is carried out. We solve the location problem of base stations with innovative optimization algorithms. In order to make the newly-built base station meet 90% of the total traffic of weak coverage points, we set up a biobjective programming model with cost and traffic as the objective function, and constraints such as the threshold between base stations and the coverage range of base stations. Secondly, the effective coverage area of the base station and the changes in the Angle between the main direction of the sector are simplified, which is equivalent to six kinds of circular coverage, and the new coverage area of the base station is calculated. Then, according to the new coverage area, the objective function and constraints are changed to reconstruct the biobjective programming model, and the biobjective programming function is transformed into a single objective programming function.Monte Carlo simulation is used to obtain the initial solution of the objective function.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies of high precision post processing kinematics based on multi system and multi frequency GNSS data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces a high-precision post-processing kinematics method of Beidou includes GPS/ GLONASS/QZSS/Galileo with independent intellectual property rights. As the deployment of Beidou navigation satellite system (BDS) constellation completed, the increase of the number of satellites is conducive to improving the accuracy and reliability of high-precision post-processing kinematics method. In order to solve the problem that the ambiguity fixed rate is low due to the increase of ambiguity dimension, observation noise and atmospheric residual error, the integrity judgment of satellite is added in this method, the integer linear relationship between ambiguity of multi frequency carrier phase which is not affected by error is used to improve the ambiguity candidate value The strategy of row constraint and determination, and partial ambiguity fixed. The results show that the method can effectively improve the positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: UAV passive positioning model based on multi-objective iterative optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of pure orientation passive positioning of UAV, by discussing and geometrically analyzing the numbering information and orientation information of UAVs affecting the positioning system, establishing a hidden circle model, a three-point positioning model, a multi-objective iterative optimization model, and finally realizing pure orientation passive positioning of UAVs and a reasonable adjustment scheme. The orientation of the central UAV is known, two more UAVs are needed to transmit signals to make the system complete positioning, establish the polar coordinate system and make the orientation expressions of the transmitting UAV and the receiving UAV, and finally find out the expressions of all the orientation information by means of calculation and error analysis to achieve UAV positioning with the three-point positioning method; the orientation and number of two transmitting UAVs are known, at least one more to complete the positioning, establish the neighboring point positioning method, designate another UAV transmitting signals whose orientation is adjacent to the UAV passively receiving signals, and make the expression of orientation information provided by three UAVs transmitting signals, and then analyze the size relationship between the orientation information to achieve positioning.

articleTitle: Design of Monitoring System for Wind-Solar Hybrid Power Supply System in Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A monitoring system is studied and designed in this paper for the wind-solar hybrid power supply system in laboratory. The monitoring system is mainly composed of wind power generation unit, photovoltaic power generation unit, battery energy storage unit, load unit and control unit. The core controllers used in wind-solar hybrid power supply system are Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) and Digital Signal Processor (DSP). The monitoring system adopts serial port communication mode Recommend Standard 232 (RS232) and Recommend Standard 485 (RS485) communication modes. At the same time, based on the three-dimensional force control configuration software, different monitoring interfaces are designed, including Identity Login Management Interface, Complementary Operation Interface, Data Acquisition Interface and Load Unit Monitoring Interface. The important information can be real-time detected, collected and displayed, such as the data and information of photovoltaic power station, wind power station, energy storage battery, load, and the communication status during the operation of the system. The complementary scheduling operation and control of the wind-solar hybrid power supply system are realized by controlling the corresponding operation buttons on the monitoring interfaces. The effective control and monitor of the designed monitoring system are verified through experiments, and the intelligent management of the wind-solar hybrid power supply system is realized.

articleTitle: Motion and Power Study of Wave Energy Devices Based on Runge-Kutta Method and Variable Step Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As an important renewable resource in the ocean, wave energy has considerable application prospects. In this paper, the motion state and power problems of wave energy conversion device are studied. Firstly, according to the motion state of float and oscillator, the motion model is established by force analysis and initial conditions, and the model is solved by Runge-Kutta method to derive the motion trajectory. On this basis, the calculation methods of two different indicators are established to solve for the maximum power and the optimal damping coefficient of the device. Finally, more indicators are introduced, and the motion trajectory and power scheme for the device under more complex conditions are solved using the variable step search algorithm, and stability analysis is performed.

articleTitle: Analysis of ATC-type Stair Structure by Axonometric Projection Drawing Demo
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the teaching of architectural engineering drawing, beginners usually need a sense of space and help to understand the graphic expression content and building entities. The typical way to solve this problem is to use software to build a three-dimensional model for demonstration. However, this method has some disadvantages, such as difficulty operating a single demonstration, lack of change, and test demonstrating according to the cognitive process. In this paper, axial projection drawing is used for demonstration in the teaching of architectural engineering drawing recognition. Take ATC-type stairs as an example; step-by-step analysis is carried out with the help of MSPaint drawing tools. As a result, the drawing rules of progressive cognition, the study of factor changes can be carried out from easy to complex in line with the cognitive habits of the human brain-friendly to beginners and has achieved good results in actual teaching.

articleTitle: Research of high voltage permanent magnet synchronous frequency converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing installed power of large mining equipment in fully mechanized coal mining face, the main cutting and coal transportation equipment such as scraper conveyor and belt conveyor often work under heavy load. At present, the coal mine adopts the traditional two speed motor drive system and uses the power frequency direct start, which is particularly easy to cause the rapid start of the equipment, resulting in large mechanical and electrical impact, which not only consumes the service life of the equipment, but also brings great impact to the power grid. Therefore, the use of frequency conversion all-in-one machine solves this problem with high efficiency, It reduces the mechanical damage of starting mechanical torque to the equipment, reduces the equipment failure rate, and improves the production efficiency of coal mine.

articleTitle: Research on the design of maximum output power of wave energy device under the condition of pendulum motion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the face of energy demand and environmental pollution, wave energy as a new type of renewable energy has a very promising future, and the wave energy device for energy conversion has also become a key issue in the use of ocean energy. In this paper, the initial position of the float and the oscillator in the vertical direction is calculated according to the initial state of the wave energy device; an optimization model is established. With the average maximum output power as the objective function, the model is established and solved by taking the range of vertical swing displacement and the range of damping of the float and the oscillator as the constraints.

articleTitle: Research on oil painting recommendation algorithm based on collaborative filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The traditional oil painting search method is to use search engines like Baidu and Google to find useful oil painting information based on the oil painting keywords entered by users, such as oil painting name, author and other information. As the data volume of oil painting works is increasing, it is increasingly difficult for people to find information that they are interested in and useful to themselves. On the one hand, the keywords of oil paintings entered by users into search engines may be inaccurate or too long; On the other hand, because of the differences in the information content of oil paintings, some oil paintings cannot be accurately searched by search engines, resulting in the flooding of oil paintings that users are interested in. With the rapid increase of the amount of data shared on the Internet, it is more important to use human feedback when retrieving information. Collaborative filtering of information is a promising method for retrieving useful information. Since a single system that provides the best performance for each type of object is unlikely, or at least may be too complex in terms of implementation, it is more practical to use multiple systems, each of which handles a specific goal. This design is to design an oil painting recommendation algorithm based on collaborative filtering based on the research of collaborative filtering algorithm. This algorithm implements user based collaborative filtering algorithm and project scoring prediction based collaborative filtering algorithm, and can show users the results of personalized recommendations.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Search Technology and Student Diagnostic Evaluation in Distance Education System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The resources of distance education system based on P2P mode are distributed in each node, and are in constant dynamic change. The resource search technology of distance education system based on P2P mode is discussed. Aiming at the distance education system based on double loop structured P2P mode, the search algorithm of target resource node is realized, which further improves the stability and resource utilization efficiency of distance education system. At the same time, an intelligent tutoring platform for educational assessment (ITPEA) is proposed and implemented to analyze students ‘ mastery of knowledge points and give personalized students ‘ cognitive diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Security and Electronic Countermeasure of Wireless Quantum Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the successful launch of quantum communication satellite, the boom of wireless quantum research and application is rising all over the world, and the security of quantum communication has reached a new height in battlefield communication, but from an objective point of view, this is a misunderstanding of it. Based on this, this paper analyzes the structure of the quantum communication system, and on this basis, makes necessary distinctions between the security, effectiveness and reliability of the communication system. It points out that eavesdropping can still be realized by utilizing the defects of the wireless quantum communication engineering, especially the suppression and interference of wireless quantum communication transmission can greatly affect the effectiveness of communication. Finally, the electronic countermeasures method of wireless quantum communication is summarized through research, which has important reference significance for promoting the application and expansion of quantum countermeasures in electronic countermeasures.

articleTitle: Cloud API Oriented Analysis on Rolling Upgrade Dependability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: When cloud operators conduct rolling upgrade operation on AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud applications, they interact with the cloud platform by indirectly calling rolling upgrade related cloud API functions provided in cloud platform, such as "UpdateAutoScalingGroup". Hence, rolling upgrade operation can be viewed as a series of rolling upgrade related cloud API calls. When calling those API functions in certain occasions, some errors might occur, e.g. the error of "ScalingActivityInProgress". These errors somehow account for the operation failures. This paper summarizes the possible errors for all the rolling upgrade related cloud API functions, and addresses when the errors would occur. We derive these research outcomes from an empirical study on these API functions. The empirical study is conducted by using AWS EC2 platform and AWS SDK for .NET. Our research provides a summarization for the error/failure scenarios of rolling upgrade related cloud APIs, and it can facilitate any other researches related to the dependability of cloud computing.

articleTitle: Estimating Hurricane Intensity from Satellite Imagery Using Deep CNNs Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: An important scientific goal of climate science research is to describe extreme events in current and future climate predictions. Extreme climate events (such as hurricanes and heat waves) pose a huge potential threat to infrastructure, human property, and even life safety. Satellites capture ten trillion terabytes of global data each year, providing powerful analytical data on the evolution of the climate system. It is extremely beneficial to use the extreme climate analysis toolkit to detect the cyclone, pressure and other characteristics of a tropical cyclone (TC). With the development of AI technology, the latest progress of deep learning has shown exciting and promising results on pattern recognition tasks, and deep learning is expected to help us better predict the image-based potential TC. We will use various deep networks etc. to predict and analyze hurricane events and the strength of tropical cyclone.

articleTitle: Application of mutual information and improved support vector machine in power load forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: So as to improve the accuracy of power load-forecast, the author first uses mutual information to determine the correlation between power load and other factors, and then uses Skyhawk optimization algorithm to optimize the kernel function and penalty coefficient in the support vector machine, which is verified by experiments. The results show that the power load has a strong correlation with temperature and atmospheric pressure, and the mutual information values are 1.5638 and 1.1042 respectively; Taking these two variables as the input characteristics of the forecasting model, the R2 value of power load-forecast is above 0.9, and good results are achieved. This research method provides a new idea for power load-forecast.

articleTitle: Research on Network Information Security Model Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a security assessment method based on rough set theory for flood DDoS attacks. It realizes real-time quantitative assessment of security threats. The hardware structure of network communication early warning system is designed by taking FTGUI-20003-1B processor and warning signal lamp as an example. In this paper, the sensor technology is introduced to acquire the state characteristics of the communication network. Rough set theory is introduced to identify network security state. It divides the communication network link into the communication channel composed of multiple nodes and identifies the security state of the communication network. The simulation results show that the intrusion detection capability of this method is strong and the reliability and stability of security detection are good.

articleTitle: Application Research of Microcomputer Relay Protection in Power System Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: According to the requirements and characteristics of performance test in the process of research and development of relay protection device, a general automatic test system for relay protection device is introduced. The system adopts distributed architecture and modular design idea, and uses Python language to construct real-time test script, which can realize closed-loop automatic test and regression test of protection device. A PC controlled process bus adapter is designed to solve the communication problem between devices with heterogeneous communication ports. Finally, taking GOOSE and SMV message transmission relay protection instruction as an example, the application of IEC61850 on the experimental platform is introduced. This paper provides a test flow of standard language, which promotes the safe and stable operation of microcomputer relay protection device.

articleTitle: Edge Cloud Manufacturing Service Platform and the Resource Allocation Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At present, direct installation or running programs on the cloud platform cannot balance real-time and convenient maintenance requirements of manufacturing companies. Therefore, this paper proposes an edge cloud manufacturing service platform and an optimization model for edge resource allocation. Finally, a large-scale manufacturing digital twin system case is realized on a multi-node virtual machine cluster, which shows that the method can effectively realize the remote deployment and long-term maintenance of edge cloud manufacturing services.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Portrait Construction of Online Platform Learners Based on Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The accurate profile of learners on the online platform based on data analysis refers to the comparison of users with certain behavioral characteristics and existing in the database and not discovered, and then determine the potential interests and concerns of the group based on this information, and recommend specific groups or products for them to meet the needs of users. Accurate profiling based on data analysis refers to the comparison of users with certain behavioral characteristics that do not exist or have not been discovered in the database to determine the potential interests and concerns of this group, which can provide a basis for recommending specific groups of people and products. First of all, this paper studies the data analysis technology, mainly expounds the data preprocessing, data visualization, behavior image processing and xAPI research, of which xAPI is a standard for collecting and storing data, mainly referring to data preprocessing and mining, statistical analysis, etc. Secondly, the characteristic analysis of the online learning platform is carried out, and finally the accurate portrait of online learners based on xAPI is constructed.

articleTitle: Research on third-order damping technology of ESGN vertical channel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Vertical channel is an important channel in electrostatic suspended gyroscope navigator (ESGN), and the design of depth damping network is an important issue to ensure its proper operation. Due to the unstable vertical channel of the inertial system, external test information must be introduced for damping. In this paper, the damping design and network parameter design of the vertical channel are analyzed through the theoretical analysis of the ESGN system, and the results are given through static semi-physical simulation and vehicle-mounted dynamic experiments.

articleTitle: Research on GPS Spoofing Signal Identification Technology Based on Inertial Information Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Under spoofing attacks, the positioning results of GPS receivers will be towed away. Thus, it is necessary to improve the anti-spoofing capability of receivers to ensure the authenticity of the positioning result. In this study, a GPS spoofing signal identification technology is proposed. The differences of the pseudorange information obtained by the GPS signal, the spoofing signal and the inertial navigation system are also discussed respectively. Simulation results show that, for a certain deceptive strategy, the use of INS for spoofing assistance can reduce the false detection rate of spoofing signal identification. When the spoofing traction speed is above 1.5m/s, the proposed method works.

articleTitle: Discussion on the setting of double-density magnetic recording belt speed for high-orbit satellites
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper analyzes and discusses the speed setting of high-orbit satellite measurement double-density magnetic recorders in terms of accuracy and record integrity. The basic working principle of the magnetic head is elaborated, the frequency response curve of the magnetic head is drawn, the calculation formula of the gap loss is given, and the gap loss of the playback head is the main reason for the limitation of the frequency response range of the magnetic recording. Finally, according to the relationship between the belt speed, the recording frequency and the optimal recording wavelength, the optimal belt speed setting of the high-orbit satellite is calculated and finally the basic principles of the belt speed setting are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on intention management and intention switching technology of task-based dialogue based on hierarchical attention network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the context of informatization, the electric power field is also undergoing continuous digital transformation. In the face of the redundancy problem in daily operation and maintenance and customer service, an intelligent and efficient dialogue system can play an essential role in it. In the dialogue system, task-oriented multi-round dialogue for complex scenes is the focus of research. For an actual conversation scenario, the system should first identify the user's intention and give feedback according to the identification results. At the same time, there are situations where users ask multiple questions simultaneously. Maintaining multiple intentions and judging the current conversation's intention attribution based on the corresponding conversation history is the key to whether the system can cover more conversation scenarios. Aiming at the problems in the current task-based dialogue system, this paper studies intention management and intention switching methods. In terms of solution strategy, this paper turns the problem into a semantic matching problem and uses a hierarchical attention network to fuse the dialog history and current input to achieve accurate intention matching. The experimental results show that this method effectively manages intention and switching tasks.

articleTitle: Optimization of Vehicle Blind Zone Monitoring (BSD) Evaluation Scheme Based on Image Processing and Radar Ranging Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, the country has gradually paid attention to the intelligent and connected automobile industry, from emergency driving to the current auxiliary driving, the blind spot detection system is also gradually upgraded. For the early warning BSD system, how to have a better alarm signal definition and a higher accuracy is the basis of upgrade direction. In the actual driving process, the change in road conditions and the driver’s negligence make the BSD system has the upgrade space. First of all, according to the BSD test of GB / T 39265-2020, evaluates its rationality and propose an improvement plan. The evaluation scheme of key functions that can be applied to blind spot monitoring in L2 driving assistance is designed to effectively guarantee the further standardization and upgrading of the blind spot detection system.

articleTitle: 5G Access Protocol for EMU Terminals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The intelligent Electric Multiple Units(EMU) is composed of more and more subsystems and on-board equipment. With the diversification of train functions and the increase of transmission data, the needs of flexible networking and high scalability need to be satisfied by wireless network. Therefore, this paper studies a terminal access tunneling protocol for EMU 5G terminals. A T-GRE(Train General Routing Encapsulation) protocol for EMU terminal has been designed. It can support both unicast and multicast communications, which complement the 5G networks capability. The end-to-end tests have also been done to verify the performance of T-GRE for EMU terminal communication.

articleTitle: Long-term Power Generation Forecasting Method Based on BAS-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the context of global warming, the issue of carbon neutrality is being paid more attention. As one of the main sources of carbon emissions, the demand and supply of electricity can be precisely controlled by exploring the trend of power generation. Adequate forecasting of future power generation has far-reaching implications for the development and implementation of emission reduction measures in the power industry. However, the current research on power generation is mainly focused on traditional statistical models, and the forecasting accuracy of forecasting models is low and influenced by other objective factors. In order to improve the accuracy of electricity generation prediction models, this paper introduces an optimized prediction model based on BAS-BP neural network and conducts an empirical study using the national power generation data in India. The results show that the MAPE of the BAS-BP neural network is 0.006661, which is about 68.14% less than the error of pure BP model, about 92.29% less than the KNN model, and about 78.34% and 68.21% less than the LSTM and LSTM-SSA models respectively. It shows that the model is able to achieve accurate prediction of future fluctuations in electricity generation, providing a new and feasible method for future electricity forecasting.

articleTitle: Optimal parking research based on path and power optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Auto-parking refers to the process of parking a car in a parking lot through autonomous planning and automatic driving, which is important to solve the problem of "difficult parking" in big cities. It is a major challenge for the autonomous vehicle industry to establish a universal automatic parking model and adapt it to different sizes of parking spaces and different models of vehicles. In this paper, the path optimization model and power optimization model are established based on reasonable assumptions, and applied to three parking scenarios: "parallel parking", "vertical parking" and "diagonal parking". At the same time, the optimal parking space planning model is established by combining it with specific parking scenarios. Finally, the planning path and the corresponding dynamics parameters of the whole process from the initial position to the target parking space are given in this paper. The innovation of this paper is that three different parking scenarios are summarized and combined with the actual situation of the parking lot with an optimized path and related dynamic parameters of the whole process of auto-parking.

articleTitle: Research on proportional parameter of random propagation algorithm with noisy labels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Label noise in hyperspectral image data is unavoidable and can confuse the training process of hyperspectral image classification algorithms, affecting classification performance. Among the proposed noisy label robust classification algorithms, the more general one is to use the prior knowledge of the training samples to clean the label noise. The random label propagation algorithm reduces the noise label level by using a spectral-spatial probability transformation matrix, randomly selecting some training samples as "clean" samples, and spreading the label information from the "clean" samples to the remaining unmarked samples. This paper investigates the proportion of "clean" labeled samples in the random label propagation algorithm and finds the optimal parameter settings through experiments. The results show that the best cleansing effect on the label noise and the best classifier performance are achieved with a proportional parameter η of 0.7 when the actual label noise level does not exceed 50%.

articleTitle: Research on Data Communication Delay Prediction Method for Flight Simulators Based on ARIMA-LSTM Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In flight simulator group network operation, video images and control commands need to be transmitted, which will pose an immediate flight safety risk to the ground pilot (VFP) in accurately controlling the remote flight simulator due to transmission delay jitter. This paper develops a hybrid model of delay prediction based on Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) by analyzing the delay data generated by flight simulator communication. The simulation results show that the hybrid ARIMA-LSTM model can predict the delay more accurately than the single regression and neural network models.

articleTitle: Recognition of Italian Gesture Language Based on Augmented YoloV5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In practical production applications, the efficiency and success rate of gesture recognition directly affect the user’s experience and work efficiency. To address the difficulties of existing gesture recognition in meeting practicality while ensuring a high accuracy rate, this paper proposes a method based on the YOLO+Keep Augment model for the Italian gesture public data sets. Because the experimental dataset is small, the data is first augmented using Keep Augment, then the processed dataset is trained using the YOLOv5 model and tested on a dataset of runtime video streams. The random enhanced hyperparameters are determined through pre-training in the public data set. The experimental data shows that N=4 and M=8 are the best parameters, and the training accuracy is maintained at 97.56 ± 0.2 under the best parameters. The analysis results show that the YOLO+Keep model has good recognition efficiency and practicability.

articleTitle: Antarctic Temperature Prediction Based on the Long Short Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the context of global warming, Antarctic temperature prediction plays a significant role in global warming and the environment, which deserves more attention due to the rapid melting of the ice sheet in Antarctica as temperatures rise. In this study, the temperature tables of 18 stations in Antarctica are collected firstly on the Kaggle website, and secondly, the features of each data are staggered using a double layer cycle to process the missing values and extract the complete Antarctic temperature values. And the data are processed as training and samples using LSTM, ARIMA, SARIMA, linear regression, and decision regression tree modules. Through the experimental results, the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of Antarctic temperature prediction by LSTM is 1.91 and the Mean Squared Error (MSE) is 4.71. Compared with the other four models, the model prediction effect of LSTM is better and more suitable for predicting Antarctic temperature, and the last part concludes that the advantages and disadvantages of LSTM, ARIMA, SARIMA, linear regression, and decision regression tree modules are analyzed. The significance of this study is LSTM prediction of Antarctic temperature prediction can help people to understand and recognize the global warming trend intuitively and the prediction models in this paper are meaningful in predicting temperatures more quickly than traditional prediction models. In addition, the data from this analysis can be applied to various fields and prompt people to pay attention to the change in the Antarctic temperature.

articleTitle: Optical Remote Sensing Ship Object Detector Based on Improved GWD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of remote sensing ship object detection technology, object detection technology based on the horizontal bounding box has made huge progress. However, in the optical remote sensing ship image dataset, the ship orientations are different and densely arranged, thus the horizontal bounding box is not suitable for this situation. Therefore, in order to solve the problem that the horizontal bounding boxes cannot accurately detect rotated ships, this paper proposes a remote sensing ship object detector based on IGWD (an improved Gaussian Wasserstain distance network), which adopts the data augmentation strategy of Cutout to simulate the situation where ships are occluded by clouds and fog, and improve the detection robustness of the overall network. To give a differentiable mathematical model to serve for BP algorithm for the positioning of rotated rectangle boxes, a loss model GWD (Gaussian Wasserstain distance) based on the Gaussian Wasserstain distance is used to simulate the deviation of the positions of two rotated rectangle boxes. In addition, this paper also introduces deformable convolutional networks in the backbone for arbitrarily oriented ships detection. Many ablation studies show that our method can achieve excellent performance on the famous ship dataset HRSC2016.

articleTitle: UAV positioning based on pure azimuth passive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In modern society, UAVs have a wide range of applications in various industries, and the pure azimuth passive localization technique is well suited to be promoted in the UAV field. In this paper, algorithms such as greedy algorithm, recursive algorithm and partitioning method are combined with mathematics to obtain the adjustment scheme for UAVs by analyzing the pure orientation passive positioning. Using the partitioning and subtraction methods, the localization model of the passively received signal UAV is built into three parts. A framework is established to synthesize the positioning model obtained from the sub-scale to build the positioning model of the passively received signal UAV. Mathematical analysis is used to solve that if only the two send signals, the receiving UAV can only receive directional information from one angle. If another UAV sends the signal, the passive receiving UAV can receive 2 position signals. Since all the UAVs in the initial moment have position deviation and the error is unavoidable, the solution with the least error is searched for. First, the brute force method is applied to find out the error for all cases. After that, after selecting a group of transmitting signal UAVs, the greedy algorithm is applied to select only the UAV with the smallest deviation to transmit the angle signal to the UAV with the smallest deviation for correction each time, and then the corrected UAVs are put into the reference UAV queue. Repeat the above operation with recursive method until all UAVs are corrected, and finally obtain the UAV adjustment scheme with the smallest error.

articleTitle: Attribute prediction of Pokémon images based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Image recognition has long been a fundamental research problem in computer vision, where the goal is to predict the class of a given image. Existing researches have focused on the category level while pay no attention on predicting object fine attribute information of object. To this end, in this paper, in order to investigate the classification effect of convolution neural network on Pokémon image data set, we use convolution neural network to classify the attributes of Pokémon, which can judge the attributes of a certain elf by its image. We used the pictures of the Pokémon in a scorching game "Pokémon " on the market as our data set. Specifically, we first a structure of the convolutional neural network and apply it to the Pokémon image data set, which can realize automatic recognition and attribute classification of elf images. Then the data enhancement method is used to preprocess the image data, which is combined with a convolutional neural network to improve the effect of attribute recognition and classification. Results show the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Intelligent control system of waste gas treatment based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of science the waste gas treatment equipment had the intelligent control function. In this paper the intelligent control system of waste gas treatment equipment based on the technology of Internet of Things was proposed. The system was adopted to achieve the accurate control of treatment process, which asked to match the need of the practical application. It had the functions of the real-time perception and check of emission indicators and transmitted the condition information of waste gas treatment equipment to the center in wireless mode. The data was provided to intelligent analysis and to user by the Internet. According to the results of intelligent analysis the system had automatic control to the actuator to adjust exhaust gas absorption and emission. The exhaust gas after treatment from the chemical raw material plant was handled and the purification efficiency reached 90%. The control system improved the accuracy control and the presentation of results was intuitive and interactive. It can promote the effective disposal and carry out the process transformation and improvement.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation Analysis Applied in Intelligent Lightweight Sorting Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Based on the actual situation that the manipulator has relatively large resistance during the sorting of auto parts, this work designs a lightweight manipulator based on glass fiber composite materials, which makes the manipulator consume less energy due to its own weight in the process of sorting and reduces the energy consumption in the process of sorting.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Information Security System Based on Chaos Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Since Pecora and Carroll of the US Naval Laboratory discovered chaos synchronization in 1990, chaos and its research and development in the field of information security have become an upsurge. After more than 30 years of research and development, chaotic secure communication and chaotic cryptography are becoming new growth points of high-tech in the field of information security technology. In this paper, the information security system based on chaos algorithm will be briefly studied to provide theoretical reference for relevant staff to further strengthen the construction of information security system.

articleTitle: A Study on Improved Face Recognition Method Based on Multi-Detection Network and Facial Abnormal Part Beautification Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper designs a modified face recognition method based on RetinaFace and RetinaNet fusion networks and facial abnormal part beautification technology to address the privacy protection issues involved in face recognition technology. The method uses fusion networks and face feature point localization to achieve the extraction of the implied pose information and the localization of facial skin abnormal targets for facial abnormality recognition. After extracting the coordinates of facial abnormal parts, the parts are replaced by using small face elements, and at the same time, for skin abnormalities, the image local beauty method based on the inverse cut Gamma light compensation is used to beautify the abnormal parts of the face. Finally, this paper implements face recognition based on the modified FaceNet with the hybrid attention mechanism CBAM. The improved face recognition method designed in this paper ensures the smooth operation of the basic functions of face recognition, achieves the beautification of abnormal facial parts and data privacy protection based on information encryption technology and abnormal part beautification algorithm, and avoids the problem of face information leakage during the application of face recognition technology.

articleTitle: An oil painting image retrieval strategy based on feedback mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Image retrieval is mainly a text-based image retrieval technology, which uses text description to describe the characteristics of images, such as the author, age, genre and size of paintings. Later, image retrieval techniques that analyze and retrieve the content semantics of images, such as color, texture, layout, etc. Feedback technology has become an important technology to improve retrieval efficiency in content-based image retrieval. However, in oil painting image retrieval, there is a huge semantic difference between high-level semantics and low-level features. The traditional relevance feedback technology requires multiple feedbacks to obtain satisfactory results, which makes the retrieval task of users time-consuming and cumbersome. In order to further improve the accuracy of retrieval, many systems combine relevant feedback technology to collect the feedback information of users on retrieval results. What they achieve is a gradual refinement of image retrieval process. In the same retrieval process, they need to constantly interact with users. Therefore, this paper proposes a retrieval technology of oil painting image through the feedback mechanism of oil painting image retrieval. On the one hand, the analysis and transformation of user needs form questions that can be retrieved from the index database. On the other hand, collect and process oil painting image resources, extract features, analyze and index, and establish image index database. The last aspect is to calculate the similarity between user questions and records in the index database according to the similarity algorithm, extract records that meet the threshold as the result, and output them in descending order of similarity.

articleTitle: Data Recovery of Power Plant Platform Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The integrity of the data gathered by the power grid platform is very important to promote the construction of the intelligent management and control platform of the power grid. However, in reality, it is almost impossible to obtain complete data because of the damage of equipment, the failure of data acquisition process, the loss of records and other reasons. In this paper, the structure of the traditional GAN is improved, and a lost data repair model of the power grid platform based on the generative adversarial network is proposed, which provides additional information for the discriminator (D) in the form of "hints" to ensure that the generator (G) generates samples according to the true underlying data distribution. Experiments show that the model can run in an unsupervised environment even the data is incomplete, and can better repair the data of the power grid platform.

articleTitle: Query performance optimization method for blockchain carbon footprint data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Block chain can be used as a new kind of distributed database system, can be applied in areas such as carbon footprint. However, its practical application generally faces problems such as simple query function and low query performance due to the limitation of data storage mode. Therefore, for the application scenario of blockchain in carbon footprint, query performance optimization is a research topic that cannot be ignored. In this paper, we first introduce the current popular blockchain query schemes. Then we adopt a query optimization method based on MySQL, an external database, to support more complex and efficient query requirements. Finally, we verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed scheme through experiments.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of the power generation floor based on the mechanical conversion method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the world economy today, energy consumption is enormous, and non-renewable energy sources, such as oil and coal, are increasingly depleted. New energy development has become a hot topic in the world today. The energy has been stretched out, which has worsened the situation. As a convenient energy source with a vary wide use area, electricity is also in short supply. This paper studies the power generation floor, which depends on the exercises in the park to generate electricity for the park system and use the generated electricity to ensure the power supply for the street lights and landscapes in the park. Moreover, every ten steps can collect enough power and make the small bulb light up.

articleTitle: Modeling Method of Dynamic Knowledge Graph for Distributed Manufacturing Resources in Cloud Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As a service-oriented manufacturing mode, cloud manufacturing has made great progress and technological innovation in recent years by encapsulating manufacturing resources into services. However, the construction of manufacturing resource model basically stays in a static model which lacks authenticity for resources with dynamic properties. This paper establishes the real-time data acquisition and transmission framework of manufacturing resources, and puts forward a dynamic modeling method based on knowledge graph. By building a prototype system of cloud manufacturing platform, the feasibility and effectiveness of data transmission and model construction are verified.

articleTitle: Research on noise control technology of 110kV indoor substation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, the demand for electrical load increases, and more and more substation locations are located near residential areas. The ensuing noise problem has also attracted increasing public attention. In order to prevent the noise nuisance of 110 kV substation, different noise control schemes are designed based on the measured noise levels around the substation and the setting of control objectives. SoundPLAN is used to model and simulate the noise distribution around the 110 kV substation under different schemes. Finally, the optimal scheme of the glotte-flap, muffler and fan muffler is selected. The actual noise is controlled below 60 dB(A) during the day and 50 dB(A) at night.

articleTitle: Research on a simplified algorithm for large-scale microstrip antenna array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces an equivalent source algorithm for the electromagnetic parameters of triangular periodic microstrip array antennas. The algorithm first needs to determine the active element pattern (AEP) of the smallest element in the large-scale antenna array to be calculated, and reconstruct the array antenna through the equivalent source method. After reducing the antenna size, calculate the simplified array pattern, and derive the required calculated microstrip array antenna pattern based on the simplified array pattern. The simplified algorithm is mainly aimed at large-scale periodic array antennas, which can greatly reduce the calculation of electromagnetic parameters and reduce the calculation difficulty.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in 3D Modeling System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a visual 3D architectural modeling method for scene design based on virtual reality technology. Firstly, this paper establishes scene visualization by immersive visualization modeling method based on realistic model and optimizes the three-dimensional sense of scene visualization. Then, this paper presents a method to interpret the exterior damage of buildings by using fractional difference equation. The Smart3D model was used to model the virtual reality scene. The DP-Modeler was used to analyze the model in detail. Finally, the paper uses LocaSpace Viewer for virtual design. The simulation results show that this technique is feasible in establishing a 3D real scene finishing model based on virtual city.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence, Big Data and Cloud Computing in Optimizing Elevator Safety Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of society, the number of elevators is increasing, and optimizing the safety performance of elevators has become an urgent need for social safety management. Artificial intelligence, big data and other emerging technologies are gradually applied to all walks of life. Its application in the elevator industry has also attracted the attention of the industry and academia, but the related research is still in its infancy. Based on artificial intelligence, big data and cloud computing, this paper designs the elevator safety performance optimization scheme from five aspects respectively, reduces the possibility of failure before the accident, responds quickly after the accident, reduces the loss, and then collects the fault information to cooperate with the cloud to further optimize the fault prediction algorithm. These solutions can be cycled to continuously improve the safety performance of the elevator.

articleTitle: Research on application scenarios of operation and maintenance technology based on business perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper will explore the main business application scenarios of power internet applications from the perspective of business from the perspective of multi-dimensional innovation, such as grid side, enterprise side and client side, and use the construction and operation models of smart cities for reference to deeply analyze the feasible construction and operation models, so as to help the demonstration application and industrialization of power internet application services from the perspective of business.

articleTitle: Displacement Calculation and Simulation Study under Body Frame System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Inertial strapdown navigation system is a system based on Newtonian mechanical principles for navigation data acquisition, and has a very wide range of applications in ships and other fields. Since the inertial strapdown navigation system is coupled with the movement of the carrier during the working process, therefore, the error analysis and measurement parameter calibration of the inertial strapdown navigation system are very important, among which the conversion of latitude and longitude into the displacement under the carrier coordinate system is an important problem in the solution of inertial conduction position information, this paper derives the conversion process with a strict formula, and compares with the actual data through experimental simulation to verify the correctness of the process.

articleTitle: Recent progress of infrared stealth technology for ships
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the basic principle of infrared stealth technology was introduced, and the method of infrared stealth was briefly discussed. Then, two kinds of commonly used infrared stealth technology are analyzed in detail, and the application of infrared stealth technology in naval ships is introduced. Finally, the future development direction of ship infrared stealth technology is prospected.

articleTitle: Active noise control of refrigerator based on improved notch algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to reduce the low-frequency narrowband noise generated by the vibration of the refrigerator compressor, and reduce the interference of irrelevant signals at the same time. Therefore, an improved notch algorithm with attenuation of incoherent signal interference is proposed. The algorithm consists of two delayed notch and an adaptive notch algorithm. The two adaptive notch delay algorithms are used to process the original noise and the signals irrelevant to the original noise, such as harmonic signals and environmental noise signals. The adaptive notch algorithm provides an accurate error signal for the delayed notch algorithm. Through simulation and experiment, it is proved that the improved notch algorithm can reduce the original noise of refrigerator and weaken the interference of incoherent signals.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Features Fusion Classification Method Based on Stockwell Transform and Deep Learning for Power Quality Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Although renewable energy such as photovoltaic and wind power can be integrated into the grid to meet the growing power demand, the unpredictable changes of renewable energy and the large number of non-linear loads resulting in complex power quality disturbances (PQDs). The robust and accurate classification of complex PQDs signals in this situation is considered to be challenged. In this paper, a novel multimodal feature fusion method for PQDs classification method based on the Stockwell transform (ST) and deep learning (DL) is proposed, which can combine both the time and frequency domain features of PQDs signals. Specifically, the ST is performed on PQDs signals to obtain corresponding ST contour images, which are fed into a channel and spatial attention mechanism integrated ResNet18 network to extract frequency domain features. Meanwhile, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is adopted to extract time domain features of reshaped PQDs signals. Finally, the extracted time and frequency domain features are fused to compensate the transform errors and boost PQDs recognition accuracy. The simulation results demonstrate the robustness and high accuracy of the proposed multimodal feature fusion method compared with benchmark methods.

articleTitle: Research on Advanced Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) Testing Algorithm and Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Advanced Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) is an important part of ADAS intelligent driving assistance system, and companies are paying more and more attention to this system, but the algorithm tuning of ACC system is inconsistent from company to company, which leads to differences in ACC of different brands. Moreover, there is no unified test method to verify the ACC system, which leads to different means to verify the ACC system by each company. In this paper, we focus on ACC system verification method and build different test scenarios to verify ACC function.

articleTitle: Design and realization of measuring total harmonic distortion of periodic signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A test scheme for total harmonic distortion of periodic signals is designed in this paper. The scheme includes automatic gain control circuit, sampling signal conditioning circuit, micro-controller circuit, waveform conversion circuit, implementation of fast discrete Fourier transform (FFT) algorithm and so on. The scheme items integrates hardware circuit design technology such as analog electronic circuit, digital electronic circuit and embedded system design, following the sampling theorem and Fourier transform principle , and also complete algorithm implementation with C language, select new mainstream devices, circuit design pays attention to practicality. In the scheme, various circuit forms and software algorithms are comprehensively applied, and the software and hardware are combined to realize the high-precision distortion measurement of sinusoidal signal in the frequency range of 1khz-100khz.

articleTitle: Research on optimal route planning and delivery strategy of multiple robots using HCA algorithm in a restaurant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As science and technology advance quickly,, many machines are gradually replacing labor, such as intelligent catering robots with some advanced functions (automatic meal delivery, voice output, and power detection functions etc.) can gradually replace waiters to serve customers. I This essay investigates the issue of multi-robot collaborative delivery in a restaurant setting. The paper analyzes the optimal delivery path from the perspectives of restaurant environment, robot morphology, algorithm selection and the comparison of road planning. And in order to be more realistic, experiments were conducted by changing some obstacles in the restaurant environment to find the optimal delivery strategy for robots. From this article, it shows that multi-robots work in restaurants can solve the artificially shortages, reduce labor costs, improve the service efficiency and quality of restaurants and bring more benefits to restaurants.

articleTitle: Research on Load Forecasting and Early Warning System of Distribution Network Equipment Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the load prediction and early warning system of distribution network equipment is constructed by using remote monitoring technology, power network fault pattern recognition, high-speed system diagnosis technology and power network monitoring and evaluation system. Then, a heavy overload warning framework is established to screen out the components of the distribution network with short term heavy overload risk. The fuzzy monitoring method is used to control the overflow of abnormal data in power dispatching system. Secondly, this paper carries out load distribution prediction and determines the user load superposition result based on the user cluster analysis results. By analyzing the main functions and software and hardware of the intelligent scheduling visualization system, the visualization display based on SVG technology is realized. This paper analyzes the implementation scheme of the early warning system, the prediction of the power network state and the real-time monitoring method of the power network fault. It illustrates the experimental results of system operation.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Media Tourism Publicity System under Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation of the development of virtual tourism on the Internet and puts forward the function and technical requirements of virtual tourism system. At the same time, this paper designs a set of JSP mode architecture of virtual tourism system. In this paper, ArcGIS and 3DSMax are used to establish virtual ground model and virtual ground object model with different morphological characteristics, and all models are converted into VRML file format and optimized, which not only effectively integrates virtual ground model and virtual ground object model, but also takes into account the fidelity and display speed of the model. The system is divided into four functional modules: virtual scene roaming, exchange discussion area, online shopping area, system management and maintenance. The feasibility of this method is verified by the realization of virtual tourist landscape in the park.

articleTitle: YOLOv5-based Object Detection for Food Freezer Warehouses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the expansion of the scale of the food freezer warehouse, the traditional warehouse management method can no longer adapt to the safety management requirements of frozen food, the detection of warehouse staff and forklifts is an essential element of intelligent management of the food freezer warehouse. The paper uses the YOLOv5 algorithm to implement the detection of staff work clothes and forklifts on a food freezer warehouse dataset created by oneself to comply with the safety management requirements of the food freezer warehouse. The experimental results show that the YOLOv5x-SGD-med model can effectively identify the classes detected in the dataset with P (precision) of 0.985, R (recall) of 0.95, and mAP0.5 of 0.976, which can meet the object detection requirements of the food freezer warehouse.

articleTitle: Research on keywords extraction technology in intelligent evaluation scheme for airport emergency plan
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Airport emergency plan is difficult for airport security professionals to write because of its professionalism and high standardization. At the same time, the evaluation of airport emergency plan also consumes a lot of time and energy for airport security professionals. This paper proposes an intelligent evaluation method for airport emergency plans, in detail, first, it extracts the important indicators related to chapters of emergency plan from existing classic emergency plans, then it hits these indicators with the plans written by professionals, formulates hit rules, and at last it obtains the scores of evaluated plans in each indicator. According to evaluation results, the emergency plan is gradually improved. In process of emergency plan evaluation, keywords extraction technology is essential, because keywords can more intensively express the indicators of plans, it also can improve the accuracy of hit efficiency, and it can speed up the evaluation process.
