Therefore, this paper studies keywords extraction technology of airport emergency plan based on machine learning to help emergency plan writers save time and energy. The experimental results show that TF-IDF extraction technology has obvious advantages over other technologies in intelligent evaluation of emergency plans.

articleTitle: Electric heating optimization strategy and economic comparison based on heat load demand regulation capability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, more and more users in northern areas choose electric heating to replace traditional heating methods. The flexibility of electric heating, the energy consumption characteristics of buildings, the elasticity of users' heat demand and the time division characteristics of electricity price provide a large space for the optimization of electric heating. In the existing electric heating control system, the environmental temperature suitable for human life and work is used as the only temperature setting value, which leads to unnecessary consumption of a large amount of energy in some areas with low heat demand. Based on an office building in Jinan, Shandong Province, this paper establishes its thermal characteristic model, and analyzes and compares the electric heating output under different heat demand scenarios of users. There are 6 distributed electric heating units in the building. Based on the parameters and output characteristics of electric heating equipment, the heating source model is built; According to the building itself, the situation of building energy consumption and thermal inertia is analyzed; Finally, combined with the local electricity price curve, the electric heating intelligent control system is proposed, and the characteristics of different control strategies are analyzed and compared from the perspective of feasibility and economy.

articleTitle: Analysis of simultaneous localization and mapping technology for mobile robot based on binocular vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for intelligent robot applications over the years, SLAM technology is also developing rapidly as an essential part of robot perception modality. SLAM is a vast system that involves multi-domain knowledge such as image pre-processing, matching, and camera pose estimation. In this paper, the basic architecture of SLAM based on binocular vision is elaborated, and some applications of its methods are presented in conjunction with new methods in recent years. The primary approach is to separate the front-end and back-end and achieve good tracking and map-building results using a multi-threaded approach. The front-end uses the SHI-Tomasi algorithm in OpenCV to detect the feature points, triangulation to calculate the landmark depth, and Lucas-Kanade optical flow method for tracking from one frame to the next and computing the pose transformation. G2O is used in the SLAM back-end to optimize the poses and nonlinearities. The analysis of SLAM based on binocular vision also provides an essential reference for people new to visual SLAM.

articleTitle: Application of Pure Azimuth Passive Positioning in UAV Formation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: When flying in formation, the UAV cluster should maintain its own flight line. However, in order to avoid outside interference, electromagnetic silence needs to be maintained as much as possible, and few electromagnetic wave signals are emitted to the outside world. Therefore, pure azimuthal passive positioning is used to adjust the position of the UAVs. In this paper, according to some models and specific requirements of transmitting UAVs, the standard positioning of UAV flight, UAV number, the positioning model of passive receiving signal UAV is established, and then the final accurate positioning is achieved by limiting the relationship between the size of the top angle and the angle of the transmitter. In the case that only the location and number of two UAVs, FY01 and FY02, are known, it is determined that several more UAVs with unknown numbers are needed to accurately locate the UAVs receiving signals. On this basis, this paper designs an adjustment scheme to adjust nine aircraft to a certain circumference with uniform distribution, ideally with a radius of 100m and the point FY00 as the origin, but only one of the initial positions of the nine UAVs is located in this circumference. A local optimal solution is selected, and the optimal solution is continuously updated through iteration, and finally the value with variance less than 0.5 is regarded as the optimal solution.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-Obscure Target Tracking Method Based on Feature Adaptive Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Target tracking is a branch of computer vision. To solve the problem in tracking, a method of adaptive fusion of multiple features is proposed, which extracts HOG and CNs features and assigns weights adaptively. A scale adaptive method is proposed to adapt to the change of target scale. An occlusion weight detection method is proposed, APCE is tracked to determine whether occlusion occurs in the target, and SVM classifier is used for re-detection. Using OTB dataset, the overall tracking accuracy and success are 0.797 and 0.728 respectively, which are 35% and 51% higher than traditional KCF algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on scheduling strategy of virtual power plant based on multi-objective optimization of load-generating side
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Due to the strong volatility of renewable energy, there is a certain deviation between the actual output and the planned output. Therefore, two-way interaction between the generation side and the demand side is considered, which has important guiding significance for realizing the economic operation of virtual power plant. Therefore, the composition structure and operation mode of the virtual power plant are studied. By analyzing the effects of load side and generation side on the optimal scheduling of virtual power plant, an optimal scheduling model of virtual power plant based on multi-objective optimization of load - generation side was established. The results of example analysis fully prove that the optimized scheduling strategy of virtual power plant built in this paper can enhance the capacity of new energy consumption and reduce the operation cost of power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Label Recognition Method of Power Grid Item Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative method of item label construction based on knowledge modeling. The model is based on BiLSTM-CRF sequence labeling model to identify the label of short power grid item. At the same time, Word2vec+SVM model and multi-label classification technology are used to extract and model long power grid item labels. Improve the knowledge extraction for the system mining model of company item. At the same time, on the basis of a large number of item structured data, this paper uses supervised algorithm to automatically mine the item system based on a small amount of labeled data. The purpose of this paper is to manage the existing item by multi-dimensional and multi-level tag system, and to dynamically adjust and configure the trained model and support the dynamic expansion of rules. This method can adapt the data of new item well.

articleTitle: Short-term PV Power Generation Prediction Based on QFWA-SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation, which occupies an important position in new energy power generation, is clean and pollution-free. Solar radiation, clear sky index, cloud cover and other natural conditions have a great impact on photovoltaic power generation, so photovoltaic power generation has randomness and volatility, accurate prediction of photovoltaic power generation is very important for grid dispatching. In this paper, a photovoltaic power prediction method of quantum fireworks optimization support vector machine (QFWA-SVM) is proposed. The power of a photovoltaic power plant in Longyan area of Fujian Province is verified by example, and the results show that the method has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: AC current online calibration device based on digital image recognition and fiber optic sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In situations using small alternate currents, for example, small signal transmission and measurement, the problems of measurement error due to current leakage and fluctuation, and many sensors using AC currents that do not reserve enough calibration interfaces are inevitable. In view of these problems, this paper designs an online calibration device for AC current. The device is based on digital image recognition technology and fiber optic current sensor technology, taking the fiber-optic current sensor as the standard to compare real-time numbers displayed by Hall current sensor. The image recognition technology uses a CMOS image sensor to collect the data displayed on Hall current sensor, and then uses digital image technology such as grayscale conversion, median filtering, binarization, and closed operation for preprocessing. Finally, the sampling value of the Hall current sensor obtained in the host computer will be compared to the standard measurement value obtained by the fiber-optic current sensor, and the measurement error with the controlled Hall current sensor will be calculated.

articleTitle: Distributed Data Multi-Level Storage Encryption Method Based on Full-Flow Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper firstly proposes a multi-level storage encryption method model for distributed data based on security-marked objects by taking advantage of the respective advantages of mandatory access control, attribute-based encryption and object storage. Then this paper designs a detailed multi-level trusted management model for collaborative storage security model, key management and data synchronization schemes. Again, this paper transforms the original ciphertext into coupled ciphertext by means of coupling and extraction method and further decomposes it into extraction ciphertext and encapsulation ciphertext. Finally, a multi-copy generation and damaged data recovery algorithm based on multi-level network coding is proposed. The algorithm improves the coding matrix of erasure codes based on multi-level network coding to form a multi-level coding matrix. Simulation experiment analysis shows that the performance loss caused by data security management is within an acceptable range. At the same time, the system has good scalability and can adapt to the application environment of large-scale distributed storage system.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Interference Protection Method of Beidou Positioning Terminal Near High Voltage Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, the electromagnetic compatibility of Beidou positioning terminal in the Internet of Things of transmission lines is studied by combining modeling simulation and laboratory measurement test, and effective anti-interference technology suggestions are put forward by analyzing its anti-interference characteristics. Experiments have been carried out in the laboratory, including electromagnetic interference space radiation test, partial discharge test, communication test of different antenna polarization directions, and shielding effect test of large-size metal frame electrical equipment on Beidou positioning terminal communication. On the basis of these test results, the anti-interference analysis model of Beidou positioning terminal is established through simulation, which reveals the influence of electromagnetic disturbance on communication of Beidou positioning terminal in different situations, evaluates the electromagnetic compatibility of Beidou positioning terminal in transmission line, and puts forward the layout strategy and anti-interference technology of Beidou positioning terminal in transmission line. The research results of this paper provide theoretical support, experience and technical support for the wide application of Beidou positioning terminal in smart grid.

articleTitle: Mask Wear Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv5m
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Wearing a mask during the COVID-19 epidemic can effectively prevent the spread of the virus. In view of the problems of small target size, crowd blocking each other and dense arrangement of targets in crowded places, a target detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv5m model is proposed to achieve efficient detection of whether a mask is worn or not. This paper introduces four attention mechanisms in the feature extraction network based on the YOLOv5m model to suppress irrelevant information, enhance the information representation of the feature map, and improve the detection capability of the model for small-scale targets. The experimental results showed that the introduction of the SE module increased the mAP value of the original network by 9.3 percentage points, the most significant increase among the four attention mechanisms. And then a dual-scale feature fusion network is used in the Neck layer, giving different weights to the feature layers to convey more effective feature information. In the image pre-processing, the Mosaic method was used for data enhancement, and the CIoU loss function was used for coordinate frame positioning in the prediction layer. Experiments on the improved YOLOv5m algorithm demonstrate that the mean recognition accuracy of the method improves by 10.7 percentage points over the original method while maintaining the original model size and detection speed, and better solves the problems of small scale, dense arrangement and mutual occlusion of targets in mask wearing detection tasks in crowded places.

articleTitle: Comparative study on model based test of automotive automatic control system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In today’s automotive industry, due to the increasingly complex nature of ECUs, there is a great need to create a model that can be tested early to maintain functional functioning. However, there are not many solutions that teach us how to organize and run these tests for maximum coverage. This article evaluates prototype CANoe+, which maximizes the coverage of test cases generated using the CANoe and GraphWalker tools from the perspective of software developers and software testers. CANoe+ was significantly more effective than CANOE alone when the Mann-Whitney Wilcoxon statistical test was used in the experiment. Such experimental results add to the existing evidence and demonstrate the irreplaceable advantages of using model-based testing techniques such as C..

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Safety Protection Risks of Intelligent Power Terminals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the security problems arising from the access of intelligent power terminals to the power Internet of Things, through the security test of intelligent power terminals, the security risks of intelligent power terminals are analyzed and summarized, and security protection suggestions are given. The energy controller is designed, and key technologies such as fully separated modular structure, unified operating system, multi-channel compatibility and exchange are applied to improve the intelligent level and flexible access capability of the terminal. Through the safety test of intelligent power terminals, safety risk analysis is carried out, and terminal safety protection measures are improved for risks.

articleTitle: Application of data mining in logistics industry in the era of big data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the era of big data, more and more data and information are flooding into people's vision. In order to seek useful information from massive information, data mining technology should be adopted to ensure that information can be effectively mined and utilized. Logistics enterprises want to improve the service level and their own strength, it is necessary to make full use of data mining technology to ensure that the logistics information can be fully mined, meet people's needs for logistics, to create high-quality logistics services for people. Big data technology can effectively integrate all kinds of information generated in the logistics industry, provide people with more accurate logistics information, and provide strong technical support for the development of the logistics industry.

articleTitle: Research on Heterogeneous Data Consistency Comparison System Based on Computer Mobile Database
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper introduces heterogeneous redundant function executor based on mimicry defense technology in router architecture. Through dynamic scheduling mechanism, the system randomly selects multiple heterogeneous executor jobs. The database space management architecture is designed and the consistent hash algorithm is applied to the constructed database space management architecture. The output results of multiple heterogeneous function performers are compared under the same external excitation. In this paper, the abnormal detection of the function executor is carried out. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified by experiments. This method can provide a reference for 3D model conversion between various heterogeneous systems.

articleTitle: Pipe scale cleaning device based on YOLO algorithm and Carmen vortex street
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The device is based on the mechanism that the water flow will be divided into two streams with different pressure after flowing through the cylinder, and the two streams will be separated and developed, and the cycle will be repeated to form a Carmen vortex, and a bionic wedge-shaped pendulum chain structure will be placed behind the divided water flow. At the same time, the device uses the computer vision YOLO series algorithm to detect the target of scale in the pipe, and completes the scale detection in real time by capturing the screen with the camera in the head of the device to improve the scale detection and cleaning efficiency. There is also an impeller structure in the head of the device, which can run under the action of the drive module when encountering unexpected conditions, and the bionic fin part of the device will release acetic acid when the pipe is working to achieve the purpose of cleaning the scale in the pipe.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition Technology Based on Depth Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of computer hardware capabilities and machine learning and other related disciplines, gesture recognition based on computer vision has become a hot topic and is widely used in virtual reality, remote communication, driving safety, medical surgery and other fields. In order to meet the needs of real-time and accuracy of gesture recognition, a gesture recognition method based on deep convolutional neural network is designed in this paper, which automatically carries out feature extraction, classification and iterative training on gesture samples. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy of the trained model on the test set can reach 98.60% and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Web Random Token Generation Technology Based on Asymmetric Encryption Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the progress and development of the world, the improvement of various hardware speeds and the rapid development of networks, especially distributed applications, the current encryption algorithms are very likely to be cracked one day in the future. At that time, more advanced algorithms should be sought to ensure the security of data. Therefore, the encryption algorithm of asymmetric encryption technology (AET) is only safe at this stage, and needs to be improved continuously to provide faster speed and stronger security. With the background of enterprise after-sale service project, this paper makes a detailed and in-depth study on the construction of web-based enterprise information network system, and attempts to develop a web-based enterprise information network system using AET on the new generation of WEB random token generation technology (RTGT) to realize the networked management of enterprise information. First of all, based on the review and summary of the basic technology research of the Web information network system, this paper deeply studies the DES and AET data encryption technology used in the data security design of the enterprise information network, proposes the WEB RTGT based on AET, and introduces its implementation process in detail.

articleTitle: Short-term power load forecasting based on similar day selection and improved LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The electric power industry is the most important basic energy industry in the development of the national economy. The operation control and dispatch of the electric power system is of great significance in ensuring the planning of the electric power system, industrial development, economic operation and environmental protection. Short-term power load forecasting plays an important role in power system operation control and dispatch. This paper proposes a combined power load forecasting model based on similar day selection and improved LSTM. First, a combined similar day screening model based on grey relational analysis and cosine similarity is constructed, which makes up for the shortcomings of the single selection method. The training set and test set ensure the quality of the input data of the model; then use the single-feature time series training to increase the dropout layer of the LSTM model for power load prediction, reduce the resource consumption of training and prediction, and effectively alleviate the occurrence of overfitting., to improve the robustness of the model. The prediction results of the two examples basically coincide with the real value in trend, which confirms that the similar daily screening and improved LSTM combined prediction model constructed in this paper can provide reliable support for power load forecasting and other time-series data forecasting applications.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact dual-wavelength-dual-mode (de)multiplexer utilizing topology optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A novel ultra-compact dual-wavelength-dual-mode (de)multiplexer is demonstrated for highly integrated on-chip hybrid mode and wavelength division multiplexing systems. This device is designed on Silicon on Insulator (SOI) and optimized using an inverse design method, which named topology optimization. The proposed device occupied a footprint of only 4.8 × 4.8 µm2, which is the smallest device implementing hybrid multiplexing technology as is known to all. Then, the device enables signal (de)multiplexing of modes TE0 and TE1 at 1525 nm and 1575 nm. Besides, the simulated insertion loss and crosstalk were less than 0.2918 dB and –17.23 dB for each channel, respectively. Furthermore, this scheme could also be expanded to include more channels.

articleTitle: Test Report of Power System Stabilizer (PSS) of the 2nd unit in a Certain Thermal Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The No. 2 generator of a thermal power plant is a 25MW extraction generator produced by Nanjing Turbomotor (Group) Co., LTD. The excitation regulator of this unit uses DVR-2000B digital excitation regulator provided by Nanjing Turbomotor (Group) Co., LTD. This report describes the parameter selection and field test results of the power system stabilizer (PSS) of the unit, and determines the operating parameters of the PSS according to the test results.

articleTitle: An Improved Pointer Chinese Text Summarization Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The pointer generation network solves the problem of unregistered words in generative text summaries by extending unregistered words directly into the dictionary to enable the copying of unregistered words from the input sequence to the generated sequence. However, it suffers from the problems of insufficient semantic understanding, low accuracy rate and repetition of summary words. To address these problems, a pointer generation network improvement model is proposed, which firstly introduced a self-attention mechanism to obtain more contextual semantic information; secondly introduced Convolutional Gated Unit to extract and filter the features of contextual semantic information; finally proposed a coverage mechanism to reduce the re-attention of the same words and solve the problem of word repetition in the generation sequence. The experimental results on the LCSTS text summarization dataset show that the improved model obtains higher ROUGE scores, the accuracy and readability of the generated summaries are improved.

articleTitle: Enterprise User Data Governance Based on Crawler and Text Similarity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Enterprise users' social unified credit code data governance often relies on ready-made third-party data for calibration, but how to carry out data governance without direct third-party data reference is the main problem to be solved in this paper. Based on the user name and social unified credit code data of power enterprise users, this paper carries out web crawler and text similarity analysis, and uses web crawler technology to obtain the social unified credit code, user name and enterprise label attribute of enterprises in "Sky Eye Search"; The text similarity analysis is used to calculate the similarity between the user name of electric power enterprise and the name of enterprise in "Sky Eye Search" to realize the data governance. Finally, this paper builds the enterprise user data governance achievement set, and deploits the data governance result set to the tag library to form the enterprise portrait, and shares it to the data supermarket to realize the sharing of results.

articleTitle: A multi-objective traffic flow detection system based on an improved yolov4 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper uses deep learning related algorithms to solve the multi-target tracking and traffic statistics problems in the field of intelligent transportation. Firstly, the advantages of YOLOv4 algorithm are introduced, and then the YOLOv4 algorithm is used for field target detection, and selecting the statistical area to identify, track and count traffic targets in the video. Finally, comparing the detected traffic flow and the actual traffic flow results are analyzed, and then the improvement scheme of increasing Deepsort tracker is proposed for the problem that the algorithm produces repeated identification of the same target. After several rounds of testing, the combined algorithm can basically meet the needs of target tracking detection and traffic statistics in intelligent traffic scenarios.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cultural Group Communication Behavior Based on Deep Belief Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Research on spectrum behavior analysis of cultural group communication has gradually changed from the traditional method based on manual feature extraction to the intelligent method based on deep learning. In this paper, a communication behavior analysis model of cultural groups is established based on deep belief network algorithm. In this paper, the constrained Boltzmann machine in each layer is pretrained by layer-by-layer training, and the weight and bias parameters are updated by mapping between the multi-layer constrained Boltzmann machines. Then this paper uses deep belief network to fine-tune the updated parameters. Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy and speed of cultural group communication anomaly data acquisition.

articleTitle: Sound Field Simulation and Excessive Noise Analysis of Station Boundary for Two Typical 220kV Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Two typical 220kVfull indoor and half indoor substations were selected as the research objects to study the sound source formation and sound field distribution through SoundPlan software simulation, and to carry out the analysis of excessive noise standard at the station boundary. The analysis results show that for HN-220-a2-9 type full indoor substation, the substation plant boundary noise does not meet the noise emission limit requirements under the current layout conditions. Its main sound source is the axial flow fan noise of ventilation and heat dissipation, which leads to the exceeding of the standard at the factory boundary, and the air volume, quantity and location of the fan need to be optimized. For HN-220-a3-4 semi-indoor substations, the noise at the substation plant boundary does not meet the noise emission limit requirements under the current layout conditions. The general design is mainly due to the axial flow fan is too close to the wall and the number is large, resulting in the factory boundary exceeds the standard, the air volume, quantity and location of the fan need to be optimized. And the high altitude noise near the substation is large, especially the east and west section, if there are high-rise buildings next to exceed the standard, it is necessary to take firewall, sound insulation barrier or sound insulation protection measures for the outdoor main transformer. The conclusions of this paper can guide the substation construction and substation noise control.

articleTitle: To prevent the LAN IP address from being preempted and conflict resolution countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Due to the Wireless LAN of its own network protocol, it also affects the effectiveness of the LAN application process. There are many problems, such as the shortage of IP address resources, the random change of IP address and the intrusion of IP address, these problems will also affect the local scope of the operation of the computer, and even the local area network paralysis. Therefore, in the process of LAN operation, how to guard against IP address, to ensure that IP address will not be a problem, is an important content of computer security. Based on the theories of Wireless LAN and IP addresses, this study takes the IP address assignment of a company's LAN as an example to explore the causes of IP address conflicts in the operation of a LAN, and specific solutions to provide theoretical and technical reference for the effective operation of the Wireless LAN.

articleTitle: Thermal analysis and design of solar heat pump drying wheat system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: China is a large agricultural country, and the traditional grain drying operation has high energy consumption. As a clean and renewable energy, solar energy has been studied and promoted in the drying operation. The heat pump drying device has the advantages of energy saving, safety and environmental protection. Solar drying and heat pump drying can not only save energy and reduce emissions, but also overcome their shortcomings and improve the drying quality by organically working together. Based on this, a solar energy heat pump combined drying wheat system is designed, and its thermal calculation and design analysis are carried out.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy storage operation and configuration of high-proportion wind power system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Wind power affects the power balance of the system, and energy storage devices are used to absorb wind energy to achieve the optimal allocation of generator sets and energy storage device resources to meet economic needs. This paper mainly uses single-objective nonlinear programming to solve the optimal solution by the objective function with the least constraint and power generation cost. First, horizontal planning is carried out to find the optimal solution for each time period. In order to reduce wind curtailment without losing load, this paper performs longitudinal planning, and uses the traversal algorithm in Matlab to plan horizontally for each new wind power installed capacity coefficient value, which can filter out the best coefficient. On this basis, the change curve of abandoned air volume, cost and other indicators with the installed probability of wind power can be solved, which intuitively reflects the influence of wind power installation rate on the power balance and cost of the system.

articleTitle: OS-Net: A novel oriented ship detector based on RetinaNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Ship inspection plays an important role in maritime traffic management and the maintenance of national maritime security. However, the different bow orientations and dense arrangement of vessels make horizontal frame detection inappropriate for ship detection. Therefore, in this paper, a rotating frame detection network based on RetinaNet [1], named OS-Net, is proposed. In order to cope with the situation of obscured vessels such as clouds, the data enhancement strategy represented by Cutout [2] is used in this paper to improve the network generalization and learn to cope with the situation of obscured pictures. In order to fully extract the ship features to improve the detection accuracy, this paper adopts the ConvNext [3] network as the backbone network and explores the improvement effect on the detection accuracy by deepening the ConvNext depth. The well-known HRSC2016 dataset is used in the paper, and through a large number of ablation experiments, we can find that the detection accuracy of OS-Net is more excellent.

articleTitle: Aggregation test of public power load under peak power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the peak load of electricity consumption in China rises, the public electricity problem is gradually paid attention to, and the importance of the corresponding public electricity demand is gradually responded to. In this paper, a two-level game method based on clustering results is chosen to aggregate the public electricity load for testing. The clustering method based on fuzzy C-means is used to cluster the public electric loads and establish scenarios such as automatic control of residential environment and temperature, smart home, and remote control of smart home appliances. According to the demand response requirements of the grid, the optimal public electricity consumption strategy is solved by using the low-level energy game model. The results show that the method not only effectively improves the interoperability between public electricity consumption and grid loads, but also improves the interaction level to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Application Research on the Measurement of Unintended Car Movement Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: By the end of 2021, the elevators retention in our country has exceeded 8.7 million, which still maintains a steady growth of more than 10% after 2019, but the elevator injury accidents have not reduced in recent years under such circumstances of the manufacturing technology and maintenance. Most of the injury accidents result from the unintended car movement given rise to the failure of door system and breaks which causes shear and squeeze injury in the landing zone according to the statistics, so it is significant to stop the car within safe area by the unintended car movement protection system (UCMP) to prevent the accidents from happening. In this paper, the operating principle of breaking system of UCMP is simply analyzed, and the measuring method of stopping distance of the breaking subsystem is discussed.

articleTitle: The Xiangshan IOUT Digital Branch Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the demand for ocean exploration continues to increase, the construction scale of the observation network gradually expands and the reliability of the seafloor observation network decreases accordingly. Any node and cable failure will cause the whole underwater network paralysis. To control natural disaster and water pollution control in an efficient way, a new era name Internet of Underwater Things is introduced. This paper mainly develops a digital branch unit suitable for IOUT. The current on the power line is used as the low frequency digital signal to broadcast information contains address and command to the network. The corresponding DBU can decode and execute the command, and its function is tested in the sea trial.

articleTitle: Research on Effect of High Temperature on SiC MOSFET Electrical Characteristic Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the social economy gets better, the development of power electronic systems is increasing rapidly and the application of urban rail transit and high-speed railway is more and more. The traction power system of locomotive and the power system of platform door are particularly important. As the core component of the two systems, high-temperature characteristics of SiC MOSFET is imminent to study. In this paper, the working principle of SiC MOSFET is introduced firstly, the physical factors that affect the high temperature characteristics of the device are theoretically derived, and then the trend of the threshold voltage, transconductance and on resistance of the device changing with the temperature is obtained. Finally, the simulation and experimental verification are carried out. This research lays a foundation for the application of devices in rail transit.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Model of Explosion Impulse Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To calculate sound pressure level of near-field and far-field explosion impulse noise, the simulation model of near-field and far-field explosion impulse noise with joint simulation method of finite element and self-programming. Near-field explosion model is established with finite element method and fluid structure interaction method. Calculation model of far-field impulse noise is established with attenuation formula of sound pressure level, conversion formula of shock wave overpressure and impulse noise, and self-programming method. Sound pressure level of impulse noise can be calculated automatically at any distance from the explosion center. The results show that the simulation results of near-field and far-field impulse noise are in good agreement with static explosion test, and the error is less than 14%. The joint simulation method of finite element and self-programming can also provide a feasible method for the near-field and far-field power calculation, effectiveness evaluation and safety analysis of various explosive ammunition.

articleTitle: Application of Automatic Degassing Unit in Dissolved Gas Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of dissolved gas analysis(DGA) in transformer oil, reduce manual operation and make full use of the current test equipment, a kind of automatic degassing unit was established in this research and combined with the gas chromatograph in laboratory to realize the automatic degassing and sample analysis of the characteristic gases in transformer oil. The tests of detection time, sensitivity, accuracy and repeatability show that the the automatic degassing unit meets the requirements and can effectively improve the detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Game Image Detection and Application Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid technological innovation in the field of deep learning and computer vision, convolutional neural networks have gained good results in target detection and image recognition, but there are fewer research applications for game images. In this paper, a deep learning based AIMBOT is proposed. The YOLOv5 model with fast detection speed and high accuracy is used to construct the model. In order to solve the problem of uneven training samples in the data, the Focal-EIoU loss function is introduced, so that the high IoU positive samples have greater loss and the network may learn the parameters of the excellent samples more easily. The experiments show that the model with Focal-EIoU loss has 5 percentage points higher mean average precision and 3 percentage points higher recall. Additionally, the CPU-based OpenVINO acceleration scheme and the GPU-based TensorRT acceleration scheme are used. The comparison experiments show that the inference speedup is 2 times higher after the OpenVINO framework acceleration and 10 times higher after the TensorRT acceleration. Finally, based on the above model scheme, the AI vision-based self-targeting system is designed and optimized using FOV principle. Aimbot game platform is used for testing, results show that tracking function of the model reached the first place in the test with 1,672 people, with a lost target time of 0 milliseconds. It also reached the first place in single-target shooting test with 30,017 people, with a hit rate of 100%, far exceeding the second place. The optimized system based on FOV principle reached the first place in multi-target shooting with 19,811 people with 97.4% hit rate.

articleTitle: Bearing health monitoring based on SSA optimization of AlexNet hyperparameter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Due to the randomness and one-sidedness of the artificially parameter setting, it is single only for a specific problem resulting the weak generalization ability. if there is a human error factor in parameters, it will lead to network construction training and diagnosis is not sufficient, high error. Based on this, a convolutional neural network (CNN) based on Sparrow Optimization Algorithm (SSA) optimization is proposed to search for a network with d lower error. First, the signal is transformed into a time-frequency domain signal, and the test error target of CNN is used as optimization search, and the optimization search uses SSA to search for its learning rate and the number of batches learned. The best parameters are obtained by searching and adopting its best parameters to set up the CNN for training and testing. We conducted a cross-sectional comparison by GWO, SSA marine biota optimization algorithm and SSA sparrow flock optimization algorithm, etc, and concluded that the optimization algorithm with the best results is SSA sparrow optimization algorithm because of its fast convergence and small number of required populations. In contrast the problem of the SSA ocean optimization algorithm is that the convergence is not fast enough independent of the population size; the problem of the GWO algorithm is that a certain population size is required for fast convergence. The SSA sparrow optimization algorithm has higher diagnostic performance, better generalization performance and self-adaptability compared with other optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Virtual Reality Technology in Digital Media System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a kind of computer simulation system that can create and experience virtual world. This paper designs a digital media virtual resource system based on Structured Query language (SQL) service framework. The purpose is to improve the efficiency of centralized management and storage of digital media virtual resources. The hardware of the system uses SQL service architecture combined with physical servers and other hardware devices to provide a good foundation for the stable operation of the system. The system software adopts plug-in architecture to develop image plug-in, video plug-in and sound plug-in, and all functional modules are integrated into the main framework of the system in the form of plug-in. Software and hardware are combined to complete the design of digital media art design system based on virtual reality technology. This paper designs digital media interaction algorithm based on virtual reality technology, and finally designs digital media function module. The simulation results show that the interactive time of digital media system is short and the performance is good. It meets the interactive needs of digital media.

articleTitle: Firewall Technology Strategy Analysis and Application Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper first analyzes the network security evaluation method PDDR model, and makes an in-depth study of the firewall technology in the PDDR model, compares the characteristics of different firewalls, takes the stateful firewall as an example to analyze its workflow and security characteristics, and focuses on the key applications of dualchannel protocol, security zone policy, VPN technology, NAT technology and so on. Finally, the ENSP simulator simulates the configuration process of the firewall in the secure network, studies the application scenarios of the firewall in the network security, and provides reliable security technology methods for the protection of network information.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Model of Ship Wakes on Rough Sea Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To solve the problem of ship wake electromagnetic scattering modeling under rough sea, it is analyzed the rough surface generation method and ship wake generation mechanism. Several electromagnetic scattering models are analyzed, such as the two-dimensional dynamic sea surface, the Kelvin wake and internal wave wake, which are under typical modeling parameters of sea surface, ship operating and structure. The electromagnetic scattering characteristics of Kelvin wake and internal wave wake in their typical situation are calculated respectively.

articleTitle: Research of the Routing Strategy under the Constraint of Privileged Load in Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: there are loads with different properties in the real network, such as a small number of ambulances, express mail and other special loads in the transportation network and logistics network. This kind of load that defined as privileged load with higher real-time requirements introduced into the complex network. Combined with the reality that the existing routing strategies cannot meet the privileged load network, we improve the existing traffic model. We establish the privileged load network model. On the premise that the nodes give priority to the privileged load, we deduce the key parameters affecting the transmission capacity through theoretical derivation. Around this parameter, we propose a complex network routing optimization strategy for privileged load. Finally, we use MATLAB simulate the proposed routing strategy and compared with the existing classical routing strategy. The experimental results show that the routing strategy proposed in this paper maximizes the overall transmission capacity of the network on the premise of ensuring the real-time transmission of privileged load.

articleTitle: Pure orientation passive positioning of UAVs in different formations and initial positions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: UAV positioning plays an important role in UAV formation flight. UAV positioning requires transmitting and receiving electromagnetic signals to complete, and electromagnetic signals are subject to external interference, and in order to reduce this effect, pure azimuth passive positioning is mostly used to adjust UAV positions in fleet formation positioning. In this question, a simulation model is constructed to achieve effective positioning of UAVs. The initial position of the UAV is often deviated from the ideal state. The problem is solved by using the representation of polar coordinates and the idea of greedy algorithm, the triangulation method for positioning, the idea of optimization algorithm, the adjustment of control variables one by one, and the dynamic planning algorithm, setting the adjustment step and adjustment rules to build a simulation model. The UAVs are adjusted to a cone formation with an unknown initial position, and the position of each UAV cannot be measured directly by the unknown information of passive positioning. The distance and angle between neighboring UAVs are used to measure the position deviation of the UAVs and the symmetric position relationship in the formation, and the position of the UAVs is adjusted. Then, by optimizing the strategy, as little as possible at a time to choose the transmitter. The number of UAVs that transmit signals is adjusted to the remaining UAV positions, and the dynamic planning model is used to find a solution that minimizes the deviation of the UAVs in the adjustment process, so as to obtain the optimal solution in terms of the global situation.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Network Technology in Electronic Wireless Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, a wireless remote communication system based on STM32 microcontroller and RS485 bus network is proposed. In the design, STM32 MCU is used as controller and WIFI module ESP8266 as wireless network access chip. Through hardware circuit design and software programming, the system realizes data upload and control command downlink transmission between sensor terminal and data center. Then this paper proposes a low power wide area Internet of Things full duplex algorithm based on antenna selection. This algorithm introduces a novel multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna selection technology into LoRa technology of low power wide area Internet of Things. The wireless module is connected with the host computer through the communication protocol to realize the remote communication of data. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed system design is verified by practical test.

articleTitle: Research on emergency supplies distribution in 5G network environment based on K-class mean value algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to reduce the impact of emergencies on people's production and life, it is an important issue to study the distribution routes of emergency supplies to quickly improve the efficiency of emergency supplies distribution. At present, with the continuous development of 5G network environment, "vehicle-drone" joint delivery will continue to replace the vehicle delivery mode. In this paper By building mathematical model, using k-mean clustering algorithm This paper investigates the route problem of tandem "vehicle-drone" distribution, which improves the efficiency of emergency material distribution and effectively solves the problem of adverse effects of complex road conditions on material distribution.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Deterioration of the Withstand Voltage Level of HVDC Thyristors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper analyzes a DC blocking event caused by the reduction of the voltage withstand level of the thyristor of the converter valve in the DC transmission system, It is found that the influence of the adhesion force of silicon seal on the withstand voltage characteristics of thyristor components provides a reference for the fault location and rectification of the decline in the withstand voltage ability of similar thyristors in DC transmission projects.

articleTitle: Research on fuzzy comprehensive forecasting of large user power unproductive load based on demand response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to effectively control the overfrequency power consumption behavior of large users during the period of centralized power supply, a fuzzy comprehensive forecasting model of large users’ power unproductive load based on demand response is designed. In the distributed large user power node network, the large user active power analysis based on demand response is completed by calculating the demand response parameters of active power nodes. On this basis, according to the process of obtaining power fuzzy forecasting indicators, determining and dividing multi time load scales and comprehensive processing of power load forecasting data, the establishment of power unproductive load fuzzy comprehensive forecasting model is completed, and the research on fuzzy comprehensive forecasting of power load for large users based on demand response is realized. Change the comprehensive power load parameters and carry out many comparative experiments. The analysis and experiment results show that when the comprehensive power load parameter is 0.56, the optimal situation is achieved.

articleTitle: Design of a Vessel Dynamic Location System Observer Using the Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This research develops a neural network observer for a vessel dynamic positioning system with unknown dynamics and disturbances. The location readings for vessel dynamic positioning systems are often accessible, but the velocity values are not. Additionally, sounds often tamper with the measured location and heading data, which might hurt the effectiveness of the dynamic location system. With the use of the corrupted location data, the developed observer is shown to be able to estimate full of the dynamic system's state, which including location and velocity data. It is shown that the observer estimating errors for the DP system's state are uniformly finally limited using the Lyapunov theory. Additionally, the results show that the constructed neural network observer can provide accurate velocity and location estimations from distorted location data. The efficacy and performance of the suggested neural network observer is shown using an example.

articleTitle: Fractional Fourier Transform Based Channel Estimation in Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is important for the 5G communications nowadays, which can improve the spectral efficiency through beamforming or multiplexing. However, with the increasement of antenna numbers, a lot of users are very near to the BS, which means the change in the electromagnetic structure. Spherical wave must be considered in during the channel estimation. Traditional channel estimation schemes assume the planar wave. The channel is sparse in angles. This characteristic can be used to estimate the parameters of the system. However, in a spherical wave system, the sparsity in angle domain no longer exists. In this paper, we propose a fractional fourier transform (FrFT) based channel estimation scheme, which can accurately extract the sparsity in near-field communication systems and thus estimating the whole channel. Specifically, the channel estimation scheme is divided into two steps. Firstly, we estimate the parameters of the multiple paths. Secondly, the whole channel are recovered based on the estimated parameters in the first step. Simulation results reveal that the proposed FrFT based channel estimation schemes outperforms the existing schemes.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-Border E-Commerce Customer Service System under the Integration of Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Today's cross-border e-commerce already has new development conditions. It not only helps enterprises to reduce production costs but also dramatically improves the economic benefits enterprises. In international e-commerce, how to make consumers inquire about the logistics status of orders more conveniently and quickly is the crucial point that affects the user's shopping experience. Combined with the distributed file storage technology in the Hadoop framework, this paper designs a cross-border e-commerce user behavior analysis system. This paper first establishes cross-border e-commerce customer profiles according to data characteristics and then analyzes user access behavior data offline. Calculate the conversion rate of website pages and statistics of popular products, and finally analyze the real-time advertising data. The test results show that the e-commerce user behavior analysis system based on the Spark framework can significantly improve the running speed and stability and increase the data processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Decentralized observer based output tracking for linear time-invariant interconnected systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A decentralized observer based output tracking method for linear time-invariant interconnected systems with unmeasurable states is proposed. These interactions imposed on each subsystem are all the subsystem outputs and through all affected subsystem inputs. Since only the subsystem outputs is available, we develop observation models to obtain good estimations of states by optimal control techniques. For the output tracking, by introducing some extra states, the decentralized feedback law is solved by solving the optimal performance index subjected to the augmented subsystems. The interaction term from its own subsystem can be considered as some uncertainty of the subsystem. The overall system formed by the original states and reconstructional errors are conducted and proved exponentially stable.

articleTitle: Research on a network covert channel based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Covert channel refers to the channel where malicious communication parties encode and transmit information by modifying the value, characteristics or status of shared resources. With the birth of blockchain technology serving Bitcoin, its characteristics of decentralization, anonymity and non tamper make blockchain as a covert communication carrier superior to traditional networks, databases and operating systems. We summarized the development process of covert channels, and compared traditional network covert channels with blockchain based network covert channels. The blockchain network covert channels are divided into four types: transaction address type, smart contract type, signature algorithm type and P2P broadcast mechanism type, and the modeling definitions are given. Three evaluation indexes are proposed for the concealment, transmission efficiency and communication cost of the hidden channel in the blockchain network.

articleTitle: Application of cloud computing technology and standard dictionary in elevator Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Elevator has been widely used in buildings with its own diversified advantages. The emergence and application of data information processing technology has brought substantial breakthroughs to the core technology of the traditional Internet of Things. In this paper through the cloud computing technology, cloud computing, standard dictionary and elevator Internet of things technology effective application launched a comprehensive exploration, through the technical optimization and improvement, to ensure that cloud computing technology and the use of elevator Internet needs highly fit, standard dictionary data unified, make people enjoy the goal of intelligent elevator service effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Short-term Voltage Stability with Dynamic Load and Short-circuit Location
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A large number of dynamic loads are incorporated in modern power systems, and their types are not the same. Dynamic loading its own volatility will inevitably have a certain degree of impact on modern power system dynamics, and ultimately affect voltage stability. In order to explore the number of dynamic loads and their impact on the power grid, this article uses the DIGSILENT POWERFACTORY 2022 as the platform to establish a large-capacity Nordic power system model. The load is replaced with different proportions, which aims to determine the relationship between the details of various power distribution systems and the large-capacity power system STVS. The RMS simulation and results data analysis reveal the mutual coupling effects of more details between the dynamic load, and at the same time show the necessity of the polymerization model on dynamic characteristics. Based on an inspiration method that generates a large data set by performing a large number of simulations, the impact of the dynamic load on short-term voltage stability, and which type of dynamic load is beneficial or harmful to the modern power system. And the unstable results are analyzed in detail to further explore the impact of the stability of short-term voltage stability of the additional failure position, and also verify the impact of dynamic load type on short-term voltage stability. The study enhances the impact of dynamic load interactions in modern power systems on short-term voltage stability and emphasizes the importance of more accurate future modeling and data analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis and examination of instrumentation tape recorder’s flutter and time base error
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the mechanism of parasitic frequency modulation caused by measuring tape drive jitter and gives the calculation model of jitter and time base error, which points out that increasing the signal-to-noise ratio in daily detection is not obvious for improving the playback signal. the reason. Combining with the widely used YJ2-18 double-density tape drive, the main working principle of this type of measuring tape drive is discussed, and the main components that cause jitter-the control process of the steady speed part of the spindle motor are analyzed according to the requirements of the jitter index. Quantitatively calculated the detection index of the time base error, and finally introduced two common detection methods of jitter and time base error qualitative and quantitative.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of New Energy Vehicle Battery Pack under Different Working Conditions Based on PCM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, in order to explore the work efficiency of the thermal management system of new energy vehicles using PHASE CHANGE Material (PCM-Phase Change Material) for cooling and insulation, the 18650 lithium-ion battery pack is numerically simulated, and the working performance of phase change materials under different discharge rates and different temperature conditions is studied. The results show that the PCM thermal management system has a good cooling effect under low discharge rate and high temperature conditions, good battery temperature uniformity, and the efficiency needs to be improved under high discharge rate and low temperature conditions.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation Design of New Energy Digital Trackless Train System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, the development process of Beijing Tianjin Hebei integration has been gradually accelerated, which has also promoted the industrial transformation of Tangshan, Hebei Province to a large extent, accelerated the pace of transformation, and further strengthened the position of transportation hub. This paper based on the research and practice of new energy digital trackless train, mainly studies the computer modeling and design of new energy digital trackless train. By establishing a computer model, we can realize the indoor and outdoor full simulation of new energy digital trackless train, in order to facilitate and quickly promote the actual results of the future new energy digital trackless train project in Jing-Jin-Ji.

articleTitle: Improved clustering analysis algorithm for density grid data streams
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: An improved density grid data stream clustering analysis algorithm was proposed to cope with the characteristics of high speed, real-time and continuous real-time data stream. The traditional density grid data clustering method is difficult to popularize because of rough boundary processing, which leads to low clustering accuracy and single grid division. A mesh partitioning method with different grain sizes is proposed to make the boundary mesh and internal mesh more clear. The inner grid adopts coarse-grained clustering method, and the boundary grid adopts fine-grained clustering method. The improved density grid clustering method and the traditional method were respectively used for cluster analysis, and the results show that the proposed method has a fast clustering speed and a high clustering accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the design of a target control platform for engineering projects under big data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Big data has great advantages in scientific management, and this technical means also provides new space for the improvement of engineering project management. From the perspective of system analysis and design, the core architecture and big data application framework of the engineering project target control platform under the environment of big data are studied. Through identifying project risk factors and analyzing and processing project data, the target control platform of big data in three aspects of project progress, quality and cost is constructed. The engineering project target control platform based on big data can effectively warn the problems such as delayed progress, hidden quality and excessive cost, and provide project managers with decision-making ideas, so as to promote the reasonable realization of the basic project goals.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Hybrid Impact Tester Based on Hydraulic Servo System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel hybrid impact tester which is driven by hydraulic servo system to simulate the actual impact environment. Compared with the traditional drop hammer tester, the highest impact velocity of the novel tester is significantly increased in the same vertical space. To satisfy the high precision requirements of impact velocity, a high performance controller based on extened state observer is designed. The impact tester designed in this paper has been verified by experiments and can accurately track the impact velocity command.

articleTitle: Research on the Evolution Scale of Network Topology Based on FlexE
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: At the moment, China and even the rest of the world are making rapid advancements in the development of new energy vehicles. To satisfy the users’ charging needs when the power consumption raises rapidly, a secure and dependable "charging network" must be implemented. This research researches the unique characteristics of network topology, simulates the method of establishing network topology, and models the evolution of network topology. As a result, the network topology evolution can be applied to optimize the installation and distribution locations for power equipment as well as the secure charging requirements of users.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting based on PSO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Seeking more accurate load forecasting method is the research frontier. A short - term load forecasting method based on particle swarm optimized extreme learning machine (ELM) is proposed. The traditional ELM is difficult to obtain accurate prediction results for randomly initializes the weights and thresholds. The input weight and threshold of the ELM are taken as the information contained in the particle swarm optimization (PSO, and the solving error of the ELM is taken as the fitness function in the PSO. Through the global optimization process of the particle swarm optimization, the optimal weight and threshold of the ELM are obtained. The PSO-ELM is established short-term load prediction model. Simulation results verified the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Bearing Health Detection Method Based on Wavelet Time-Frequency Spectrum and Parametric Improved CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of bearing fault diagnosis and the problem of slow training speed, this paper proposes a bearing health detection method based on wavelet time-frequency spectrum and Alexnet framework of CNN. Firstly, the bearing signals of different parts are continuously wavelet transformed, which are converted into two-dimensional time-frequency maps. Next, Gaussian white noise is added to the transformed results. We test the ability of anti-noise and verification accuracy under Alexnet, restnet and shufflenet networks respectively. Finally, the network with the best ability of anti-noise and accuracy is selected for a 10×10 grid search to determine its best parameter settings. This paper validates the method using the Case Western Reserve University bearing data center set, and the experimental results show that Alexnet based on wavelet time-frequency spectrum and grid method parameter optimization has high accuracy and ability of anti-noise.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Vehicle Driverless Test System Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In this paper, based on computer big data technology and modular design method, a set of high-power, wide-speed electric vehicle powertrain unmanned test platform is developed. In this paper, a set of unmanned driving test platform is designed and implemented by using vehicle accessories, driving motor and sensor. The system is composed of four subsystems: steering control, braking control, speed control and gear control. The results show that the developed test platform can meet the requirements of the vehicle plant for the performance and durability of the power motor system.

articleTitle: Pure Azimuth Passive Positioning in Attempted UAV Formation Flight
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the pure orientation passive positioning problem in the attempted formation flight of UAVs. By establishing the geometric relationship between the UAV receiving signals and the UAV transmitting signals in the flight state, the triangular positioning model and the dynamic planning model are constructed, and the least squares-based triangular positioning algorithm, the least squares-based cross positioning algorithm, the greedy algorithm and the ant colony algorithm are used to determine the position of UAVs under different conditions. The pure azimuth passive positioning system in UAV attempted formation flight is studied to obtain the determination of UAV positions under different states. The formation is composed of 10 UAVs, forming a circular formation. The UAVs all keep flying at the same altitude based on their perceived altitude information. Modeling solves the positioning model of the UAV passively receiving the signal when the position of the UAV transmitting the signal has no deviation and the number is known. If there is no deviation in the position of the UAVs transmitting signals, except two of them transmitting signals, find to achieve effective positioning of UAVs. And give the UAV adjustment scheme under different strategies.

articleTitle: Rev-RetinaNet: PCB defect detection algorithm based on improved RetinaNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: PCBs are important electronic components and are used in a wide range of industries. The efficient detection of defects in PCBs can improve the yield of PCB production, and this research direction has a wide range of prospects for development. Nowadays, the increase in hardware computing power and rapid advances in imaging technology continue to facilitate the development of deep learning, and the use of convolutional neural networks for defect detection has become possible. Defect detection faces the following challenges: small target size, more difficult feature extraction, and low detection accuracy using generic target detectors. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a network called Rev-RetinaNet, which uses the well-known single-stage network RetinaNet as the baseline network with improvements and ConvNext as the backbone network part, effectively improving the adequacy of the network for feature extraction. In addition, to avoid overfitting, this paper uses the Drop Path method to randomly "remove" the sub-paths of the multi-branch structure in the deep learning model, and adopt the YOLOXHSVRandomAug random luminance adjustment strategy to simulate the situation of PCB boards under different lighting conditions, so that the network can adapt to different situations of PCB detection, thus improving the accuracy of defect detection. This enables the network to adapt to different situations of PCB inspection, thus improving the accuracy of defect detection. This paper conducted detailed ablation experiments on a publicly available PCB dataset from Peking University. The results show that the Rev-RetinaNet achieves a mAP of 89.74% compared to the baseline network, an improvement of 3.1%, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed network.

articleTitle: An Optimized CNN-SVM Algorithm for UAV Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, drones have been widely used in various fields and have achieved remarkable results. However, due to the particularity of the tasks performed by drones, the staff cannot even take effective repair measures when the drone fails. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an optimized UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) anomaly detection algorithm based on CNN-SVM (Convolutional Neural Network-Support Vector Machine). Using the public drone anomaly detection data set to simplify the feature engineering construction process and model calculation time, we use the CNN model to organize the feature data of the drone failure into a time-series form and input it to the model convolution layer and pooling Floor. Meanwhile, due to the complex working environment, the fault characteristic data of drones is often not obvious. To further improve the fault identification ability, this paper proposes to add SVM for algorithm optimization.
