The current difference when the drone fails is considered, and the characteristic sequence of the drone when it is not faulty is input into the SVM model to assist in the judgment of abnormal data. To further verify performance, AUC (Area Under Curve) is used for model performance testing. The experimental results prove that the accuracy of the algorithm proposed in this paper is higher than other common deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Real-time Video Fire Detection via Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Existing fire alarm mainly relies on traditional smoke and heat-based systems, yet their monitoring range is limited, which leads to serious security risks. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel method for video fire detection, in which the suspected areas are firstly segmented via a cascaded judgement by using dynamic segmentation, color model and Gaussian model, and then the obtained suspected regions are input into a transfer learning-based CNN model for fine judgement whether it is a true flame. Since pre-processing methods can filter out large non-flame area, and which can greatly optimize calculation of CNN model. We finally migrated the proposed approach into embedded IMX.6 platform and test on the collected dataset. The experimental results show that, the algorithm can achieve a detection of 15fps and more than 90% recognition rate with an input of 960*720.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method of fan bearing at non- extended end of motor based on resonant sparse decomposition and variational modal decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A fan is usually installed at the non-extended end of the motor to cool down the motor during operation. When this fan bearing fails, there is interference of high amplitude accidental shock in the vibration signal, and the difficulty of obtaining fault characteristic frequencies is thus greatly increased. With the aim of achieving a steady acquisition of failure frequency characteristics, a combination of resonant sparse and variational modal decomposition is suggested to determine the fault condition of the fan bearing at the non- extended end of the motor. Resonance-based sparse signal decomposition method isolates the low resonance components from the vibration signal that carry fault information, based on the different quality factors of the individual components of the signal, and then broken down into a number of modal elements using the variational modal discretization method, with the highest cliff element selected to conduct a Hilbert transformation envelope spectrum and select the fault characteristic frequencies. Results of the experiments have demonstrated that the present presented algorithm mitigates the distraction of the man-made empirical adaptation of the quality faction in the Resonant Sparse Decomposition, which is difficult to remove the more non periodic high magnitude shock elements in the low frequencies components. In addition, the experiments also compare the bearing fault diagnosis method of resonant sparse decomposition combined with wavelet decomposition, and the results show that the selection of variational modal decomposition in the envelope demodulation session can highlight the fault characteristic frequencies better than the selection of traditional wavelet decomposition, which distinguishes more precisely between types of bearing failures and has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Temporal Convolutional Knowledge Tracking Model with Embedded Graph Association Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In recent years, deep knowledge tracking (DKT) and other deep learning-based knowledge tracking work has achieved relatively good results in terms of performance compared with traditional methods, but there are also some shortcomings: first, the existing methods fail to effectively use the deep information between question and knowledge points for effective mining, and the model interpretability needs to be improved; second, the original DKT model has long-term dependency problems, and it cannot use more previous interaction sequence to model students’ knowledge state more accurately. Based on this, a temporal convolutional knowledge tracking method with embeded graph association information is proposed in this paper, using graph attention network to mine the high-dimensional graph correlation information between knowledge points embedded in the input of the original model to enhance its interpretability, and then using temporal convolutional network (TCN) to extract students’ dynamically changing knowledge states, using expanded convolution and deep neural network to expand the sequence learning range and alleviate the long sequence dependence problem. The results show that the model outperforms traditional deep knowledge tracking methods in terms of AUC evaluation metrics under public dataset conditions, captures students’ knowledge states more accurately, and predicts students’ future performance more efficiently.

articleTitle: A high available and strong generalization capability data-driven-based wireless fingerprint positioning model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The demand for indoor location-based services is far greater than supply, and many novel indoor localization technologies are emerging. Wi-Fi fingerprint-based method has drawn much attention by virtue of its user-friendliness and no extra device deployment. However, the traditional methods based on signal similarity or received-signal-strength-based (RSS-based) machine learning face their bottlenecks, such as the performance bottleneck or the generalization capability. Thus, a binary-classification model based on sample differences is proposed, which divides the original fingerprint data into positive and negative samples. Then, new relative features are proposed to replace the traditional media-access-control(MAC)-RSS features. Finally, the classification models are trained using decision tree (DT), support vector machine (SVM), and random forest (RF) algorithms, and several sets of controlled experiments are performed to evaluate the proposed method. It is noticeable that the proposed method has better performance in floor detection accuracy and point matching accuracy, and the mean error can reach 2.9m (DT), 3.09m (SVM), and 2.96 m(RF). Besides, the proposed method shows a very excellent model generalization capability, and the model trained by one building's data can still work well in another building. Those advantages have enormous potential in many large indoor localization scenes, like mall, theme park, airports, museums and exhibition halls.

articleTitle: Multivariate Network Intrusion Detection Methods Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Recent years, it is a spurt of progress in the Internet, network security problems such as cyber-attacks have emerged in an endless stream. The activity of an attacker to illegally use and destroy resources on the Internet called Intrusion. To keep the security of network, it is necessary to detect before the intrusion has caused damages. Intrusion detection is a technology that identifies the use of resources and gives early warning of abnormalities, which is an effective complement to firewalls. Early researches were mostly based on statistical and rule-based approaches, using Pattern Recognition. With the development of machine learning, there are two methods, the first methods use conventional machine learning algorithms such as decision trees, KNN and SVM, and the second methods are based on Neural Network models such as CNN. To further improve the feature extraction ability of the model, this paper combines the advantages of traditional machine learning and neural network, applies them to intrusion detection and 2 models with better training effects are finally obtained. We also use different network architectures in the second scheme such as ResNet and DenseNet to verify the validity of the results, using Dropout strategy to improve the generalization ability and reduce the over-fit phenomena.

articleTitle: A multi-modal decision fusion neural network for emotion recognition using facial information and EEG
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the development of computer vision (CV), the technology of expression recognition has been improved by intelligent recognition of human face images. At the same time, mood detection using EEG signals is also being developed. The multi-layer network algorithm has a good performance in CV and EEG emotion recognition. However, the multi-layer network algorithm leads to high computing power and energy consumption in the calculation process. Therefore, this paper proposes a lightweight Multi-modal algorithm for both CV and EEG emotion recognition: Multi-modal decision fusion neural network (MDFNN). The innovative points of this algorithm are as follows. The frequency spectrum features were extracted from EEG by the power spectral density (PSD), and then the features were classified into emotions by Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU) with attention mechanism. The sequential characteristic of CV and the sequential information of EEG signal are fused for multi-mode decision making. In this paper, lightweight residual network and depth-separable convolution are used as CV sub-classifier, and a single-layer GRU with attention mechanism is used as EEG sub-classifier. Then, the performance of these two sub-classifiers is integrated through enumeration or Adaboost. Based on a single i5-6500 CPU, the MDFNN enumeration algorithm achieved a mean accuracy of 61 percents in the Arousal dimension and a mean accuracy of 68 percents in the Valence dimension. In particular, the MDFNN Adaboost algorithm achieved a mean accuracy of 70.5 percents in the Arousal dimension and a mean accuracy of 70 percents in the Valence dimension. These results show the effectiveness of lightweight MDFNN algorithm in single CPU emotion recognition.

articleTitle: Construction and Accurate Retrieval Method of Knowledge Graph of Automobile Engine Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of automobile engine fault maintenance, an accurate retrieval method of automobile engine fault driven by knowledge graph was proposed. Firstly, the definition and framework of knowledge graph are discussed. The entity extraction of engine fault features was carried out by multi-source neural network, and the disambiguation of fault entities was carried out by integrating entity link technologies; Secondly, fault knowledge reasoning is carried out to eliminate the wrong knowledge in the knowledge base and infer new knowledge to form a complete knowledge graph.. On this basis, the retrieval subgraph of engine fault semantics is designed. Combined with the influence of physical distance and proximity, the retrieval result evaluation model is established, and the subgraph matching was carried out based on the similarity calculation of graph structure and semantic information. Finally, four knowledge graphs including entity equipment graph, ontology graph, maintenance rule graph and history graph were constructed by selecting some automobile engine fault cases from 2017 to 2020. Finally, the process architecture of engine fault search and analysis is constructed and the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified by precision rate and recall rata, which provides a new idea for accurate and efficient engine maintenance.

articleTitle: Visual Local Path Planning Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Traditional local path planning methods for robots are mostly designed with prior maps, which leads to poor results in navigation combined with visual SLAM. Therefore, most of the traditional robot local path planning methods are designed with prior maps, which leads to poor results in navigation combined with visual SLAM. Therefore, this paper proposes a visual local path planning strategy based on deep reinforcement learning. Firstly, A raster map of the surrounding environment was built based on visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) technology, and A* algorithm was used to plan the global path. Secondly, a local path planning strategy based on deep reinforcement learning is constructed by comprehensively considering the problems of obstacle avoidance, robot walking efficiency and pose tracking, and discrete action spaces with forward, left and right turning into basic elements are designed, as well as state Spaces based on visual observations such as color map, depth map and feature point map. Using Proximal Policy optimization (PPO) algorithm to learn and explore the best state action mapping network. The results of Habitat simulation platform show that the proposed local path planning strategy can plan an optimal or suboptimal path on the real-time map. Compared with the traditional local path planning algorithm, the average success rate is increased by 53.9%, the loss rate of pose tracking is reduced by 66.5%, and the collision rate is reduced by 30.1%.

articleTitle: Knowledge Encapsulation and Application Based on Domain Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to speed up the training of high-tech equipment R&D talents, promote the auxiliary of knowledge reuse for product design and development, we take the liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen engine domain as the application scenario, and proposes a knowledge encapsulation and application technology based on the domain knowledge graph. According to the complexity of knowledge application scenarios, a knowledge encapsulation technology is proposed, and reusable professional knowledge services are provided to designers through a standardized knowledge service platform. According to the intelligent application scenarios of professional technical materials and knowledge, we proposed a label clustering method and an intelligent information recommendation technology, for improving the efficiency of information and knowledge acquisition in scientific research and production. The practical application results show that based on domain knowledge graph can effectively accelerate the transformation of aerospace product design platform to openness, standardization and intelligence.

articleTitle: Pavement crack identification and detection based on multi-task learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Existing detection methods for pavement cracks are difficult to handle many different noises and interferences at the same time due to the limitations of hand-designed feature extraction algorithms. Aiming at the above problems, a multi-task learning detection model based on U-Net for road crack detection images is proposed. First, using the well-trained YOLO crack detection model, the crack image is detected, and the crack image in the recognition box is cropped, so the model has a positioning function; Secondly, for the judgment of crack type and other information, a pavement fracture segmentation method based on U-Net model is proposed, and the fracture type is judged and the length, width and area of the crack are calculated according to the segmentation results. And the use of adaptive weight parameters to optimize the loss function value, improve model performance, with stronger robustness and generalization ability. The experimental results show that the error rates of the proposed pavement crack detection model for transverse cracks, longitudinal cracks and alligator cracks are 0.02, 0.08 and 0.07, respectively, and the method can not only accurately locate, but also read out the crack type and geometric parameter information, which effectively solves the actual needs.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal configuration of two-stage reactive power compensation in power grids with power loss index
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the fact that the current distribution network reactive power optimization problem has poor solution time and is easily trapped in a local optimum search, this paper carries out a study on the multi-objective optimal configuration of two-stage reactive power compensation for power loss indices. A multi-objective optimal configuration model for two-stage reactive power compensation devices in power grids based on the power loss index is developed with the objective functions of minimizing loss cost, purchase cost, installation cost, and operation cost, and introducing penalty functions to solve the optimal installation location and capacity of reactive power compensation devices in power grids under constrained conditions using the remora optimization algorithm. The proposed method is validated by simulation based on IEEE-34 and PG-69 systems. The simulations of the proposed method are validated by IEEE-34 and PG-69 systems. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper has advantages over the multi-objective optimization without power loss index in reducing loss, improving node voltage distribution, reducing cost, and optimizing time, and the remora optimization algorithm can achieve the global search optimization better than particle swarm optimization algorithm and whale optimization algorithm. The accuracy and applicability of multi-objective optimal configuration of reactive power compensation in power grid are improved.

articleTitle: Research on Nondestructive Testing Technology of Grounding Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: A state of grounding mesh conductor nondestructive testing system and method, injection of a certain frequency and signal emission system to ground net.through must have the strength of the current sine wave signal, the signal receiving system of remote control of unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) to carry signal collecting device, detection in ground surface fast cruise for data collection, complete branch conductor of grounding systems located in the space area nearby the surface excitation magnetic field detection. The Beidou BDS/GPS dual-mode satellite positioning and navigation system, magnetic field detection unit and data wireless transmission system carried by the remote-controlled UAV wirelessly transmit space coordinate data information and synchronous magnetic field data information to the terminal host computer system composed of wireless receiving unit, computer and software. By receiving, storing, summarizing and analyzing the data in real time, the magnetic field distribution on the ground surface of the ground grid can be obtained quickly, the state of the ground grid can be transmitted and the safety performance of the ground grid can be evaluated. The technique studied in this paper is characterized by simple operation, high efficiency and accurate diagnosis.

articleTitle: Wavelength division multiplexers and some experimental analysis in the field of optical communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Light shunting is becoming increasingly popular as the bandwidth required for information transmission in people’s daily lives increases. The main subject of current information research is how to transmit information more efficiently through light. Therefore, wavelength division multiplexing technology appeared. This article will describe the basic principles and some applications of wavelength division multiplexing and then compare the application of partial multiplexing technology in different fields of wavelength division multiplexing technology according to some of the latest three practical experiments. Based on research and comparison, wavelength division multiplexing technology has the advantages of easy reconstruction and good scalability. Still, problems such as immature technology of some required optical components and blurred industry standards make data difficult between experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Deduplication Technology Based on B+ Tree Index and Hash Index
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology and improve data has become decided to enterprise survival and the development of one of the key factors. However, with the increasing amount of data information, the storage and backup of massive data bring great pressure to the enterprise data center. Statistics show that there is a lot of duplicate data between the growing mass data, so the deduplication technology is put forward. As a new data compression technology, deduplication still faces many problems and challenges. In this paper, the repeated detection rate and performance metadata size of deduplication system are studied, and two solutions based on B+ tree Index and Hash Index are proposed, and their respective advantages and disadvantages are quantitatively evaluated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Elastic-Net Regularized Online Portfolio Selection with Transaction Costs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Online portfolio selection via machine learning systems attracts considerable amount of attentions recently. This paper focus on online portfolio optimization with transaction costs. The objective of the proposed minimization problem over the simplex contains three terms: negative expected return, transaction cost controlled term and regularization term for portfolio. Specifically, we use the elastic-net regularization of the difference between the portfolios of the next and the last periods to attack transaction costs. We additionally apply the elastic-net regularization to the portfolio variable, which due to the simplex constraint reduces to the square of the L2 norm of the variable, in order to improve the generalization of the model. We solve the proposed model by linearized augmented Lagrangian method, and its convergence is proved mathematically. Further, we obtain closed-form solutions of subproblem in each iteration, which increase the algorithm’s efficiency. Numerical experiments on four benchmark data-sets demonstrate that our algorithm outperforms the compared state-of-the-art algorithms in most case in a higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of restaurant intelligent seat-seeking system based on ESP32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In view of the recent increase in the number of colleges and universities, the university campus is more open than before, which makes it difficult for students to find seats in public places. This paper puts forward a restaurant intelligent seat finding system based on ESP32 to solve this kind of phenomenon. Through the combination of software and hardware of the system, using edge AI technology, cloud platform, Internet of Things platform and WeChat applet, the function of real-time monitoring the seating situation of restaurant seats and feeding the dynamic data of real-time restaurant seating information back to the user’s WeChat applet through the cloud platform is realized by assisting data visualization. Through the delivery of real-time information, students can arrange meals more efficiently, and solve the problem of finding seats during meals. This work can also be applied to library, study room and other application scenes.

articleTitle: Multi-label Image Transient Background Information Recognition Based on Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Transient background label recognition is an important computer vision application technology in daily life. However, most of the previous work regards transient background recognition as a single label classification task. Due to the complex co-occurrence dependencies between different transient background labels, single-label classification cannot fully describe the image background information. In this paper, we propose a new end-to-end attention-driven memory graph convolutional network (AM-GCN) model for multi-label image transient background information recognition. AM-GCN adopts the content-aware categories generated by semantic attention module (SAM), and obtains rough label dependencies of transient background through the static graph convolution network (S-GCN). Finally, the dynamic graph convolution network (D-GCN) obtains accurate classification information. Compare to other models, this model results in better performance by the experiment of AM-GCN on the transient background label dataset.

articleTitle: Pursuit-escape Strategy for Autonomous Agents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The pursuit-escape strategy is the cutting-edge research related to autonomous vehicle. This paper focuses on training 2 agents based on the Q-Learning algorithm model in reinforce learning, in a pursuit-escape game confrontation to solve the game strategy selection problem for a single pursuer and a single escapee in a simulation environment. First of all, the simulation model uses the gym API library provided by the OpenAI research organization to call the pre-defined environment to build the simulation environment. At the same time, the training model of the pursuit-escape game would be built and trained in the cloud computing platform of Baidu PaddlePaddle, and the final training effect that meets the expectation proves that the algorithm is verified. This research also introduces the current interference in to increase the realism of the simulation and optimizes the algorithm related to obstacle judgment. The simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the sensor model can assist in providing "rewards and punishments" in the pursuit process of an agent, which can be applied to improve the autonomous motion strategy selection of the agent.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Feature Extraction Method Based on Improved MFCC and IMFCC Fusion Features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: To address the problem that MFCC cannot better characterize the high frequency features in speech signals, this paper proposes a VMD-based feature extraction algorithm for the fusion of MFCC and IMFCC speech emotions. First, the original speech signal is processed using Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) to obtain a relatively smooth subsequence containing several different frequency scales, solving the problems of high complexity, strong nonlinearity and non-smoothness of time series. Then, Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and Inverse Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficients (IMFCC) are extracted from the speech signal, the first-order difference coefficients of the two features are calculated, and feature fusion is performed to obtain VMIMFCC speech emotion features, which can more comprehensively characterize the emotion in the speech signal. Finally, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to reduce the dimensionality of VM-IMFCC features and select the feature dimensions with high relevance to improve the accuracy of the features. The experimental results show that the emotion recognition rate of this feature is better than the emotion recognition rate of traditional speech emotion features.

articleTitle: A review of the virtual power plant with the vehicle to grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to reduce carbon emissions and prevent the rapid depletion of fossil energy, the number of electric vehicles (EVs) has risen rapidly in recent years. With distributed renewable energy gradually replacing traditional power generation energy, virtual power plant (VPP) has become a hot technology concern for researchers in recent years. VPP integrates power generation, power consumption, and EV to achieve more efficient energy utilisation. As a distributed energy storage unit, EVs can present various forms of VPP in the local VPP network. The vehicle to grid (V2G) means bidirectional energy transmission mode from EV to the power grid. In the V2G operation mode, EVs can play an auxiliary role in shaving peak and fil valley to balance the supply and demand side and adjust the voltage (V) and frequency (f). The operation of the V2G system has many challenges at the level of battery aging and grid infrastructure. This paper proposes two optimisation schemes by analysing VPP architecture in V2G mode.

articleTitle: A Survey of Database Knob Tuning with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: As the scale of modern database management systems (DBMSs) becomes larger and larger, the configuration knobs have reached hundreds, which makes the traditional knob tuning methods can’t meet the demand. It is urgent to use the latest technology to study more intelligent and perfect knob tuning technology to ensure the high-performance operation of DBMS. In this paper, we first analyze the limitations of the traditional knob tuning methods. After that, we discuss the research status and challenges of Bayesian Optimization (BO), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Deep Learning (DL) applied to database knob tuning problems.

articleTitle: Research on power customer service composite intention recognition based on dependency syntax and graph attention network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, intelligent task-based dialogue systems emerge in endlessly. Among them, intention recognition is an essential task of natural language understanding in human-computer dialogue. Aiming at the difficulty of composite intention recognition in the power customer service field, this paper combines the advantages of dependency syntax analysis and graph attention neural network. It adopts a graph attention neural network model integrating the dependency matrix. This model uses dependency information and its relationship types for context information modeling, distinguishes the importance of context features through the attention mechanism, and has flexible calculation, high accuracy, and good generalization.

articleTitle: A Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Branch Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Rolling bearings are one of the most important components of rotating machinery, to ensure stability, reliability, and safety of its operation, intelligent fault diagnosis plays a vital role. In the industry, the condition of class imbalance and few fault samples exists widely in the fault diagnosis field. In order to diagnose the state of bearings accurately under the kind of conditions, this paper proposes a one-dimensional Branch Convolutional Neural Network with Wide first-layer kernel (BWCNN) to reduce the impact of data imbalance and few fault samples. First, the normalization was applied to the original time-domain data to attenuate the effect of distribution differences of different features on the model and improve the convergence speed of the model. Then, using a two-branch network constructed by a one-dimensional convolutional network with a first-layer wide convolutional kernel, the model parameters was iteratively updated during the training phase of the network with resampling strategy and a cumulative learning strategy, making it possible for the model to learn generic patterns for all classes of samples and fault patterns for a few classes. Finally, the trained model was used for fault diagnosis. The proposed method's performance was evaluated using two widely used experimental datasets. On the selected datasets, the average macro F1 score reaches 99.5% when the healthy samples on the training set divided by the sum of all fault samples on the training set equals 20, and the number of samples for each class of faults on the training set is 10.

articleTitle: Distributed log collection for business processes based on ELK architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: When it comes to executing service solutions in a distributed environment, the service solution is considered as a workflow split into many sub-processes that are scheduled to run independently and autonomously on each processing engine. Each organization’s machines have its own set of limitations. They can't write too much code or rebuild the system, so they'll have to rely on a lightweight, low-code strategy to expand the service solution’s process activities to collect valuable logs. As a result, we created a log collection system for the case, as mentioned earlier. The listener class is used to insert some functional code that sends the logs to the messaging middleware. Then, the service call records, or log data, are transmitted to the central administration platform. The ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) framework, commonly used in log analysis nowadays, is then used to perform real-time data processing. Finally, the logs are visually displayed to provide intuitive feedback on log information and to make system maintenance and adjustment easier.

articleTitle: Method of Continuous Electrolytic Loop-closing for 30° Phase-angle Difference Line Based on Three-Level Protection of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: With the continuous development of the distribution network automation technology, the primary and secondary integration technology standards and equipment are becoming more mature, the reliability requirements of the distribution network are further improved, the protection range is extended from the switch inside the station to the switch on the column outside the station or the ring network cabinet, and the three-level differential protection mode of "station+branch+boundary" is gradually promoted, and "three-level protection" comes into being. Under the three-level protection of the distribution network, each section and branch switch of the distribution line is a circuit breaker, which does not rely on the action of the switch in the station to realize the local short-circuit current removal. At the same time, the extreme difference is formed through the protection settings, which further reduces the fault judgment and isolation interval, and improves the power supply reliability. On this basis, the three-level protection is also an important premise to solve the continuous electrolytic ring closing of the 30 ° phase angle difference line at the contact point: for the line load transfer with 30 ° phase angle difference at the contact point, the "break before make" power outage mode is generally adopted, which will cause power outage to users and greatly increase the workload of operation and maintenance personnel. Based on the actual work, this paper first describes the distribution automation and distribution network three-level protection mode, introduces the three-level protection coordination mode and line switch action mode under different faults through typical structural lines, and then proposes a 30 ° phase angle difference solution loop method for distribution line contact points based on the distribution network three-level protection method. Finally, the correctness of the proposed method is verified through theoretical and practical analysis.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Supply Chain Financial Ciphertext Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: There are various types of enterprises involved in supply chain finance. The content and standard of internal information data disclosure of each enterprise are different, and the information quality of enterprises with different qualifications is uneven, so it is impossible to provide comparable credit data for financial entities. We propose a blockchain-based supply chain financial ciphertext retrieval system, which is a multi-keyword fuzzy search based on blockchain. In this paper, blockchain technology is used to ensure the security of index, and intelligent contract is used to realize permission control, which ensures the privacy protection of users. Bloom filter is used to generate fixed-length index vectors corresponding to keyword sets, thus reducing the storage complexity of keyword indexes. The elements in the index vector are randomized by permutation, and this permutation is shared by attribute encryption technology. Only legitimate users can obtain this permutation and construct the trap of query keywords. Finally, the security analysis shows that this algorithm can not only resist the selective plaintext attack and selective ciphertext attack, but also has good practicality.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Relationship Prediction Model for Intelligent Search
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Intelligent search system can effectively realize the integration of multi-source heterogeneous data resources. In the intelligent search and question answering system based on knowledge graph, the questions are usually asked by some simple questions, which are processed in a pipeline way, and then the subject entity and predicate relationship of the question are selected, and then the most likely answer entity is selected by information integration. Entity relation extraction is the difficulty of knowledge graph. We found that in traditional information processing models, neural network models usually only utilize question sentences for relation classification. But such question sentences often lack context, making it difficult to fully utilize the computational power of neural networks. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes a knowledge graph relationship prediction model (BXS) for intelligent search systems, which uses sentence subject headings and entity background information as auxiliary reasoning information to obtain sufficient context for the problem. We utilize two attention mechanism models to fuse auxiliary information with questions for semantic matching. The experimental results on the data set prove that the model can effectively improve the accuracy of relation extraction, and effectively improve the accuracy of the final question and answer.

articleTitle: High-precision GPS Signal Tracking Method Based on TDOA/FDOA Phase Fringes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of complex tracking loop structure of traditional GPS receivers, and poor tracking performance in the environment of low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and high dynamic, a new GPS signal tracking algorithm based on phase slope stripe detection is proposed, in which the pseudo-code delay can be accurately estimated by the Frequency domain phase of Time Difference Of Arrival (TDOA), and the carrier Doppler frequency offset can be accurately estimated by the Time domain phase of Frequency Difference Of Arrival (FDOA).The loop structure is simplified and the tracking accuracy is improved, compared with the traditional method, the code phase measurement accuracy is improved by 60% and the carrier Doppler measurement accuracy is improved by 31% when the SCNR is 32 dB-Hz. In addition, accurate tracking can be achieved in high dynamic environment, which has research significance for improving the performance of GPS receiver.

articleTitle: A disturbance localization method for power system based on group sparse representation of compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new disturbance localization method for power system based on group sparse representation of compressed sensing. Based on the analysis of disturbance characteristics of power system, the sparse dictionary of compressed sensing group is constructed by the admittance matrix, impedance matrix, and power variation matrix. In addition, the traditional generalized orthogonal matching pursuit reconstruction algorithm is improved to obtain the group sparse coefficients corresponding to the above dictionaries for compressive sensing sparse reconstruction, and the corresponding weights of each class in the group sparse dictionary are determined based on the entropy weight method to realize the accurate location of power system disturbances. In this paper, the IEEE 39 node power systems are built on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform for experimental verification, and three common disturbances of cutting generator capacity, cutting load capacity and single-phase grounding short circuit are analyzed respectively. The simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve the accurate location of common disturbances in power systems with limited measurement device configurations, and has the advantages of less computation and strong robustness to noise.

articleTitle: A Chinese Implicit Sentiment Analysis Model Based on Relational Weighted Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: Implicit sentiment analysis is used to deal with text corpora that are devoid of sentiment words, which is a difficult task for text sentiment analysis. Implicit sentiment statements in the Chinese corpus are dominated by euphemistic and implicit expressions, and implicit sentiment analysis research can aid in improving the performance of Chinese sentiment analysis tasks. We propose a Chinese Implicit Sentiment Analysis Based on Relational Weighted Graph Convolutional Network (CISA-RWGCN) in this paper, which builds a model with RWGCN, sets different weight mapping matrices for different types of edge relations on GCN, and calculates the weights of neighbor nodes using node representation, node labels, and edge relation types of target and neighbor nodes. On the SMP-ECISA 2019 dataset, the results of comparison and ablation experiments show that the model's full utilization of syntactic information can help the Chinese sentiment classification task achieve 87.4% on the F1 score.

articleTitle: ECLSTM: An Efficient Channel Attention-based Spatio-temporal Fusion Method for Fault Detection of Instruments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The instrument fault detection has the problems of incomplete temporal and spatial feature extraction and poor feature expression ability of instrument data. To solve the above-mentioned, this research proposed a new intelligent fault detection method for instruments with an efficient channel attention-based convolutional neural network and long short- term memory neural network (ECLSTM). Firstly, the convolutional neural network (CNN) was used to extract the spatial features of different instruments, and the long short- term memory neural network (LSTM) was applied to extract the temporal features of the sequence. Secondly, to improve the expression ability of the features extracted by the CNN, the efficient channel attention was used to selectively weight the spatial features. At last, the healthy indicator was constructed by predicting the value of the instrument through the network model, calculating the threshold value by the exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA), and comparing with the threshold value to achieve instrument fault detection. The effectiveness and progressiveness of the method were verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Multi-stage dynamic evaluation method of distribution network with renewable energy based on hierarchical incentive control line
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: The construction of new power system is steadily advancing, and the proportion of renewable energy power generation is also increasing. The high permeability of renewable energy will become one of the characteristics of the new power system. It is difficult to consider the impact of high permeability of renewable energy in the traditional power system construction planning process. In this paper, a distribution network planning evaluation index system is built to record the characteristics of high permeability renewable energy access and operation and maintenance, and a set of static comprehensive evaluation method for distribution network planning case under high permeability renewable energy access based on CRITIC is designed. In addition, considering that distribution network planning is a long-term dynamic process, static assessment methods are difficult to assess the specific situation of the actual distribution network construction process. Therefore, this paper designs a set of multi-stage dynamic evaluation method of distribution network with renewable energy based on hierarchical incentive control lines, and finally analyzes four 20 kV distribution network planning cases of a power supply bureau to prove the effectiveness of this method.

Author Keywords: Distribution network with high permeability renewable energy
Distribution network planning evaluation index system

articleTitle: A multi-index comprehensive evaluation method for key technology development of AC-DC distribution network based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electrical Engineering, Big Data and Algorithms (EEBDA)
abstract: In the context of China's goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, the 14th Five-Year Plan calls for the evolution of the power system to accommodate the large-scale and high proportion use of new energy sources. In order to adapt to the new energy grid access, many emerging AC-DC distribution network technologies are being developed. In order to know the development of these technologies, this paper proposes an evaluation method of key technology development based on BPNN by multi-index comprehensive analysis. Firstly, a total of 16 sub-indexes are constructed from the four aspects of current development, technology status, policy environment and economic benefit, and the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive analysis method is adopted to evaluate them. Combining with the nine widely used technology maturity levels, the current technology maturity levels of key technologies are obtained, and the development status of technology is quantified. Secondly, by establishing BPNN and learning the expert thought in the subjective evaluation process, the evaluation process is modeled to improve the accuracy of evaluation and achieve the effect of easy to use. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the index system and evaluation method proposed in this paper are proved through an example analysis, which can provide guidance and support for the development and planning of AC/DC power distribution network in the future.
